### [131] [Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15973)
*Ling Yang,Zhenfei Yin,Yingcheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出"Discovery Intelligence"与"Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs)"框架，并实例化为Zetema与GALILEO系统，力求将"发现"变为基础模型可学习、可执行、可评测的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型已从对既有知识的学习与推理，发展到通过行动、工具使用和结果反馈进行学习。作者认为下一前沿是进一步转变：从解决人类给定的问题，转向参与新问题、新表示、新解释与新知识的创造过程，即"发现智能"。

Method: 提出DFM作为面向开放式发现的通用模型系统，运行在可修正的研究状态（revisable research state）之上，支持七项耦合能力：问题发现、问题形式化、表示构建、假设形成、干预、基于证据的修正、持续发现改进。以Zetema实例化，结合显式研究状态动态、验证与实验门控（experimental gating）、外部 grounding 与跨任务发现技能演化（Discovery Skill evolution）。并以真实治疗发现系统GALILEO落地，形成干实验室推理、机器人与人工湿实验室实验、外部生物证据、迭代假设与设计修正构成的闭环物理发现回路。同时提出统一的能力形成与以过程为中心的评测方法。

Result: 构建了DFM框架并给出Zetema与GALILEO两个实例，提出统一的能力形成与过程中心评测方案，使发现行为可训练、可改进，并可超越最终答案性能进行度量。

Conclusion: 将发现确立为基础的模型系统中可学习、可执行、可评测的能力，并把这一转变视为智能扩展的更广泛进程：从既有知识学习，到从行动结果学习，最终参与到新知识发现所依赖结构的构建、检验与修正之中。

Abstract: Foundation models have progressed from learning and reasoning over existing knowledge, to increasingly learning through action, tool use, and outcome feedback. We argue that the next frontier is a further transition: from solving and acting within problems specified by humans to participating in the process by which new problems, representations, explanations, and knowledge are created. We refer to this capability as Discovery Intelligence. We formulate Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs) as general-purpose model systems for open-ended discovery. A DFM operates over a revisable research state and supports seven coupled capabilities spanning problem discovery, formulation, representation construction, hypothesis formation, intervention, evidence-grounded revision, and continual discovery improvement. We instantiate this framework with Zetema, which couples explicit research-state dynamics, verification and experimental gating, external grounding, and cross-task Discovery Skill evolution. We further ground the framework with GALILEO, a real therapeutic-discovery system in which Dry-Lab reasoning, robotic and hands-on Wet-Lab experimentation, external biological evidence, and iterative hypothesis and design revision form a closed physical discovery loop. We then formulate a unified approach to capability formation and process-centered evaluation, enabling discovery behavior to be trained, improved, and measured beyond final-answer performance. Together, these components establish discovery as a learnable, executable, and evaluable capability of foundation-model systems. We view this shift as a broader progression in intelligence scaling: from learning over existing knowledge, to learning from action outcomes, and ultimately to participating in the construction, testing, and revision of the structures through which new knowledge is discovered. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/DFM-Plans

</details>


### [132] [Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15975)
*Shwai He,Haichao Zhang,Shen Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将Transformer表示演化建模为学习到的加法变换，并分解为平行与垂直分量，从功能几何角度连接了编辑鲁棒性、压缩诊断与训练干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Transformer表示如何随层演化，以及这种演化几何结构对模型编辑、压缩和训练的影响尚不清晰。

Method: 将学习到的更新分解为相对当前方向的平行分量与垂直分量，并在两个空间应用：注意力/MLP更新相对隐藏状态，以及注意力值聚合相对当前token的值。

Result: 发现预训练模型中存在显著超出残差恒等路径的平行分量；排除自身的值空间平行操控比残差空间和垂直操控更鲁棒；垂直误差比平行误差更能区分压缩方法；预训练中全聚合平行抑制降低验证损失并提升下游平均表现，值空间变体最强。

Conclusion: 表示几何与编辑鲁棒性、压缩诊断及训练时干预之间的关联得到验证，相关代码已开源。

Abstract: Transformer representations evolve through learned additive transformations that either preserve their current direction or redirect it. We study this evolution as a functional geometry, decomposing learned updates into parallel and perpendicular components. Across pretrained models, we find substantial parallel components beyond the residual identity path. We then apply the decomposition in two spaces: to attention and MLP updates relative to the hidden state, and to attention value aggregation relative to the current token's value. Targeted edits reveal a strongly space-dependent asymmetry: exclude-self value-space parallel manipulation is markedly more robust than residual-space and perpendicular counterparts, preserving the direct self message while scaling only the non-self aggregate. The same decomposition gives a component-resolved description of compression-induced update error: perpendicular error separates compression methods more clearly than parallel error. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that full-aggregate parallel suppression during from-scratch pretraining lowers validation-loss trajectories and improves downstream averages, with the value-space variant strongest. Together, these results connect representation geometry to editing robustness, compression diagnosis, and training-time intervention. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/Shwai-He/Transformer-Geometry}{project repository}.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [133] [BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13149)
*Aditya Karnam Gururaj Rao,Arjun Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BudgetBench——一种以“每次调用输入 token 预算”为自变量的主动预算评测协议与参考工具链，用于在固定模型/任务/采样/解码条件下比较记忆策略；以试点研究（非最终排名）揭示预算违规、非单调质量曲线等单预算评测掩盖的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地大模型智能体的主动上下文是稀缺资源：记忆容量、prefill 延迟、缓存增长与服务目标共同限制了每次调用可负担的输入 token 数。现有评测通常固定单一上下文预算，无法刻画质量、延迟与预算合规性随预算变化的真实权衡，因此需要可复用、以预算为自变量的测量面。

Method: 核心贡献是可复用测量面：可替换的 MemoryStrategy 契约、显式预算强制、确定性/版本化评分器、prompt 审计元数据与可复现工件（开源地址已给出）。协议固定模型、任务、采样与解码，扫描 2K/4K/8K/16K/32K 五档预算，记录质量、预算利用率、延迟，并将预算违规率作为一等结果。用三项试点验证协议而非最终排名：本地 qwen2.5:1.5b（SWE-bench Verified 与 LongBench v2 各 89 项）、托管 Qwen3 30B-A3B 的 50 项 LongBench 复现（精确分词）、500 项 LongMemEval oracle 研究（官方 GPT-4o 评分器）。

Result: 工具链暴露出预算合规失败、非单调质量曲线，以及被单预算评测隐藏的运行点。“预算化 vs 全上下文”方向未定论：本地切片接近零效应，托管复现的点估计偏向全上下文。作者透明说明早期试点的分词器近似会低估部分实际服务模型 prompt 的 token 数，故其违规行仅为分词器近似诊断而非可主张结果；所有计时均为运行诊断。

Conclusion: 可复用贡献是协议、工具链与失败报告规范，为规模化开展固定预算记忆策略评测提供基础，而非给出最终策略排名。

Abstract: For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench.
  We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.

</details>


### [134] [A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13171)
*Koji Koyamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将“导数保真度”界定为物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的一类失效模式，并通过一维基准实验验证：函数值拟合良好并不保证自动微分所得导数准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINNs依赖自动微分施加微分方程残差，但现有评估多关注函数值吻合度；作者指出这是潜在隐患，需要单独检验导数精度。

Method: 以多层感知机为模型，仅用sin(x)与exp(x)的函数值进行训练；随后用自动微分单独计算并评估二阶导数。进一步通过训练点密度、激活函数、端点密集评估以及L2与最大误差两种诊断指标进行强化测试。

Result: 结果发现函数逼近在视觉上准确时，仍可能伴随显著更大的二阶导数误差，尤其在高曲率边界区域附近更为突出。

Conclusion: 该实验提供了区分“函数值精度”与“物理残差可靠性”的诊断流程，强调需将导数保真度作为PINNs评估与可靠性的关键维度。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

</details>


### [135] [Sensory Precision Inference for Multimodal Arbitration under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15065)
*Tin Mišić,Takato Horii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种多模态感知推理模型，通过自由能最小化联合更新潜在信念与模态特异感知精度，并引入学习到的精度先验，在合成多模态MNIST冲突场景下实现鲁棒的重建、潜变量推理与模态仲裁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境中多感觉通道常受噪声、缺失或跨模态不一致干扰，智能体需在竞争性感知假设间自适应仲裁。主动推理虽提供不确定性引导推理框架，但动态推断的感知精度在多模态冲突下如何参与生成式仲裁仍研究不足。

Method: 构建多模态感知推理模型：潜在信念与各模态感知精度经迭代自由能最小化联合更新；感知精度动态既反映感觉不确定性，又主动塑造冲突中潜在信念的演化；并引入可学习的感知精度先验，产生类别相关的结构化精度模式，影响跨模态推理动态。评估使用合成多模态MNIST数据集，结合视觉、听觉与触觉表征，在受控感觉噪声与跨模态不一致条件下测试。

Result: 动态精度推理在感觉证据受损时提升重建鲁棒性；在感觉证据减少情况下支持连贯的潜在推理；在模态冲突间实现稳定仲裁；学习到的精度先验产生可解释的精度结构，塑造推理动态与跨模态潜在结构。

Conclusion: 感知精度推理可作为不确定性下自适应多模态信念形成的机制性控制过程，精度动态是稳健且可解释的多感觉整合的计算机制。

Abstract: Autonomous agents operating on multisensory data cannot assume that all sensory modalities remain consistently informative. In real environments, sensory streams are frequently corrupted by noise, missing data, or inter-modal incongruence, requiring adaptive arbitration between competing sensory hypotheses. While active inference provides a principled framework for uncertainty-guided inference, the role of dynamically inferred sensory precision in generative multimodal arbitration under sensory conflict remains comparatively underexplored. We propose a multimodal perceptual inference model in which latent beliefs and modality-specific sensory precisions are jointly updated through iterative free-energy minimization. In our proposed model, sensory precision dynamics not only reflect sensory uncertainty but actively shape the evolution of latent beliefs during multimodal conflict. In addition, we introduce a learned prior over sensory precisions that induces structured, class-dependent precision patterns and influences cross-modal inference dynamics. We evaluate the model using a synthetic multimodal MNIST dataset combining visual, auditory, and tactile representations of digit classes under controlled sensory noise and inter-modal incongruence. Results show that dynamic precision inference improves reconstruction robustness under corrupted sensory evidence, supports coherent latent inference from reduced sensory evidence, and enables stable arbitration between conflicting modalities. Furthermore, learned precision priors generate interpretable precision structures that shape inference dynamics and cross-modal latent structure. These findings support sensory precision inference as a mechanistic control process for adaptive multimodal belief formation under uncertainty, highlighting precision dynamics as a computational mechanism for robust and interpretable multisensory integration.

</details>


### [136] [Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13182)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文利用1984–2025年共1,744幅Landsat与Sentinel-2影像，构建14维图像复杂度特征，分析Robert Smithson《螺旋形防波堤》所在地大盐湖的水文状态，将其从"艺术即温度计"重构为"艺术即水文状态先行指标"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 《螺旋形防波堤》随大盐湖水位严重下降而反复淹没与出露，为探讨艺术作品作为环境/气候信号载体提供了天然实验对象。作者意在检验并修正此前基于小样本提出的"图像熵与全球温度正相关"说法，并探索遥感图像复杂度能否追踪甚至领先湖区水文状态变化。

Method: 采用1984–2025年逐年逐月的1,744幅共配准Landsat 4-9与Sentinel-2影像块。构造14维复杂度特征：香农熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、lacunarity、灰度共生矩阵纹理、强度统计量及ImageNet预训练ResNet50特征。将其与来自NASA GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo及全球碳预算的42年月度气候-水文面板数据比对；使用自助法（bootstrap）、Spearman/Pearson相关、主成分分析、滞后相关、STL分解及偏相关分析，控制月份与传感器效应。

Result: 自助分析显示香农熵仅是弱代理，不支持其与全球温度正相关的早期小样本结论。粗尺度排列熵与平均强度能强追踪湖面高程，Spearman相关达0.85–0.88，95%置信区间不含零。ResNet50嵌入的第三主成分在无监督下呈现为"AI气候轴"，与累积CO2相关0.86，与湖面高程相关-0.83。图像复杂度领先湖面阶段约三年，滞后+3时Pearson r=0.58（95%CI 0.40–0.73）。STL分解显示非单调趋势：1984–2015上升，随后在湖泊接近历史最低水位时急剧下降。偏相关分析证实结果对季节与传感器效应稳健。

Conclusion: 图像复杂度可作为湖区水文状态的先行指标，而非仅是被动的"温度计"，从而将"艺术即温度计"隐喻修正为"艺术即水文状态先行指标"。作者公开数据集、特征流水线与分析代码作为公共基准。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spearman correlations of 0.85 to 0.88 and 95 percent confidence intervals excluding zero. The third principal component of the ResNet50 embeddings emerges without supervision as an AI climate axis, correlating 0.86 with cumulative CO2 and -0.83 with lake elevation. Image complexity leads lake stage by about three years, with Pearson r = 0.58 at lag +3 and a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.40 to 0.73. STL decomposition reveals a non-monotonic trend that rises from 1984 to 2015 and declines sharply thereafter as the lake approaches record-low elevations. Partial correlations controlling for month and sensor confirm robustness to seasonal and sensor effects. These results refine the art-as-thermometer metaphor into an art-as-leading-indicator-of-hydrological-state interpretation. The dataset, feature pipeline, and analysis code are released as a public benchmark.

</details>


### [137] [Ensemble-Conditioned Molecular Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15077)
*Ross Irwin,Alessandro Tibo,Jon Paul Janet,Simon Olsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将分子设计重新定义为对构象系综的模式与性质进行优化，并提出"系综条件引导"框架，使3D分子生成模型同时以模式和系综性质为条件，支持多模态、多数量条件的自适应组合与可变尺寸生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子设计通常被视为寻找能采用单一生物活性构象的分子问题，但真实分子占据构象分布，且决定候选分子是否可行的许多性质取决于整个分布而非单个构象。因此需要一种能同时优化构象系综模式与整体性质的设计范式。

Method: 提出系综条件引导框架，同时以模式（形状、药效团轮廓或蛋白口袋）和性质（整个分布上的聚合标量）两个轴为3D分子生成模型设定条件。推理时通过组合各条件产生的向量场自适应地合成模式条件，条件可被靶向或规避、跨模态混合并以任意数量组合。引入自适应对称学习以组合来自不同参考系的条件，并扩展生成框架以支持可变尺寸生成。

Result: 在多模式条件化和系综性质优化的新基准上进行评估，并将框架应用于双靶点结合剂设计和活性态选择性激动剂设计两项实际药物发现任务，结果显示以额外状态为条件相比单状态条件均能改善目标结果。

Conclusion: 将分子设计重构为构象系综的模式与性质优化是可行且有效的，单一训练模型即可通过系综条件引导表达多种设计任务，且融合额外构象状态信息能显著提升实际药物设计任务的表现。

Abstract: Molecular design is typically approached as a problem of finding molecules which can adopt a single bioactive conformation. In reality, molecules occupy a distribution over conformations, and many of the properties which determine whether a candidate is viable depend on that distribution rather than on any single conformer. We reframe molecular design as an optimisation of both the modes and properties of molecules' conformational ensembles, where modes can be represented as shapes, pharmacophore profiles or protein pockets, and properties are aggregate scalars computed over the whole distribution. To realise this we introduce ensemble-conditioned guidance, a framework which conditions 3D molecular generative models on both axes simultaneously. Mode conditions are composed adaptively at inference by combining the vector fields produced under each condition. Conditions may be targeted or avoided, mixed across modalities and combined in arbitrary numbers, allowing a wide range of design tasks to be expressed with a single trained model. We introduce adaptive symmetry learning to allow conditions from different reference frames to be composed, and extend our generative framework to enable flexible-size generation. We evaluate on new benchmarks for multi-mode conditioning and ensemble property optimisation, and apply the framework to two practical drug discovery tasks, dual-target binder design and active-state-selective agonist design, where in both cases conditioning on the additional state improves the desired outcome over single-state conditioning.

</details>


### [138] [LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13185)
*Mohammad Firas Sada,Dmitry Mishin,John Graham,Seungmin Kim,Mahidhar Tatineni,Frank Würthwein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在文本分类任务上，互补朴素贝叶斯（NB）与零样本/少样本大模型（27B至1T MoE）的基准对比显示：LLM仅在零数据场景占优（且易受数据污染影响），一旦有标注数据，NB在准确率上可追平甚至超越大模型，且在CPU吞吐率与能耗上高出数个数量级，是资源受限HPC场景下的最优选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的兴起引发研究计算领域的一个反复出现的疑问：像朴素贝叶斯这样的经典方法是否应当被淘汰？作者希望系统性地澄清在文本分类任务中经典方法与LLM各自的适用边界。

Method: 将互补朴素贝叶斯（Complement NB）与跨越4个模型家族、规模跨度达37倍（27B到1T参数的MoE）的零样本/少样本LLM进行基准测试；覆盖Amazon Polarity、AG News等文本分类任务；测量GPU与CPU吞吐率、每样本能耗；并分析批次大小对推理效率的影响。

Result: LLM仅在零数据场景占优（Amazon Polarity情感任务98.0% vs LB 88.2%），但该优势易受数据污染影响——在低污染情感任务上NB反超零样本LLM（81.7% vs 73.0%）。有标注数据时（如AG News）NB达89.1%准确率，与零样本27B LLM（89.0%）统计上无差异，并优于397B前沿模型（84.8%），CPU吞吐率达数千样本/秒。微调DistilBERT达90.6%但batch size 1时吞吐率远低于NB。GPU吞吐分析显示小模型批量推理比NB CPU推理慢40-486倍，能效每样本约低两个数量级。

Conclusion: 决策分界线取决于任务：主题分类中NB约在N~10^4标注量时达到LLM水平，而零数据情感任务在所有测试N下均倾向LLM。对于拥有标注数据的资源受限HPC从业者，NB仍是文本分类的最优选择；作者还提供Kubernetes Helm operator，利用可配置阈值与可验证Prometheus指标自动完成模型选择。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.

</details>


### [139] [Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13191)
*Rabia Tüylek Tok,Burak Yağlıoğlu,Enes Dağ,Emre Onur Kahya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于学习的卫星交会风险早期预测框架，利用UT传播/PCA筛选CDM特征，训练TCN-Transformer混合模型预测后续CDM更新的碰撞概率，服务LEO电推卫星避碰决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO运行卫星与轨道碎片数量激增，交会事件频发，加重操作负担；电推卫星低推力机动受限，避碰规划时间约束更强。现有CDM虽提供相对状态、协方差、最近距离、TCA与PoC，但轨道不确定性非线性传播及PoC对协方差演化的敏感性，使序列CDM解释困难，难以提前一致评估风险。

Method: 1) 以无迹变换（UT）传播与反向传播框架评估碰撞风险指标对CDM参数的敏感性；2) 对数值CDM参数做主成分分析（PCA），识别与PoC变化最相关的特征；3) 依据敏感性分析与PCA结果筛选原始CDM参数，并构造相对运动、交会几何、协方差不确定性等衍生指标；4) 构建序列化增强交会数据集，训练TCN-Transformer混合模型学习交会风险的时间演化，预测同一事件后续CDM更新中的期望PoC。

Result: 敏感性分析与PCA为原始CDM参数选择和衍生指标构造提供了依据；在TÜBİTAK UZAY接收并分析的CDM数据上应用该框架，验证了其面向LEO卫星交会实现更早、更一致操作风险评估的潜力。摘要未给出定量精度指标。

Conclusion: 该学习型框架可实现同一交会事件后续CDM的PoC早期预测，有助于减轻操作负担并支持电推卫星的避碰规划，具备在LEO交会风险评估中业务应用的潜力。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. This study proposes a learning-based framework for early prediction of satellite conjunction risk by estimating the PoC expected in the subsequent CDM update of the same close approach event. In the proposed methodology, an Unscented Transform-based propagation and backpropagation framework is first used to evaluate the sensitivity of the collision risk metric to CDM parameters. In addition, Principal Component Analysis is applied to the numerical CDM parameters to identify the features most relevant to PoC variation. The results obtained from the sensitivity analysis and PCA are then used to justify the selected raw CDM parameters and to construct derived metrics representing relative motion, encounter geometry, and covariance-related uncertainty. Using the resulting sequential enriched conjunction dataset, a hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)-Transformer model is trained to learn the temporal evolution of conjunction risk. The framework is applied to CDMs received and analyzed within TÜBİTAK UZAY, demonstrating its potential for earlier and more consistent operational risk evaluation for LEO satellite conjunctions.

</details>


### [140] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13192)
*Feisal Alaswad,Batoul Aljaddouh,Maher Alrahhal,Wafaa Al Nassan,Talal Bonn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究基于UCI心脏病数据集，对比传统机器学习模型与LLM生成规则系统的预测性能，发现传统模型整体更优（随机森林90.2%准确率），而LLM规则在可解释性上更具优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨在医疗心脏病预测场景中，传统机器学习方法与LLM生成的规则系统之间在预测性能与可解释性上的权衡，以期为临床决策支持系统的选择提供依据。

Method: 使用UCI心脏病数据集，评估逻辑回归、KNN、SVM、朴素贝叶斯、决策树与随机森林等分类器，并与GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6生成的规则系统对比，采用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数进行评估。

Result: 传统机器学习模型整体优于LLM规则系统。随机森林表现最佳，准确率90.2%、精确率0.829、召回率1.0、F1分数0.906；朴素贝叶斯次之，准确率88.5%、F1分数0.881。LLM规则模型中，Claude Sonnet 4.6达80.3%准确率（F1：0.833），GPT-4o为70.5%准确率（F1：0.690）。

Conclusion: LLM生成规则虽预测性能较低，但提供可解释的IF-THEN诊断逻辑，增强临床决策的透明性，体现医疗AI中预测性能与可解释性之间的权衡。所有实验代码已开源。

Abstract: This study compares traditional machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Several classifiers, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were evaluated alongside rule-based systems generated using GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Experimental results show that traditional machine learning models consistently outperform LLM-generated rule-based systems in predictive performance. Random Forest achieved the best overall performance with 90.2% accuracy, a precision of 0.829, perfect recall of 1.0, and an F1-score of 0.906. Naive Bayes followed closely with 88.5% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.881. In contrast, the LLM-generated rule models achieved lower performance, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaching 80.3% accuracy (F1-score: 0.833) and GPT-4o obtaining 70.5% accuracy (F1-score: 0.690). Despite the performance gap, the LLM-generated rules provide interpretable IF-THEN diagnostic logic that enhances explainability and transparency in clinical decision-making. These findings highlight the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability in medical artificial intelligence systems. The complete implementation of all experiments, including machine learning models and LLM-derived rule classifiers, is publicly available in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/LLM-Rule-ML-Heart-Disease-Prediction .

</details>


### [141] [Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13194)
*Tesfay Zemuy Gebrekidan,Hadush Hailu Gebrerufael*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用轨迹中恢复的多项式不变量（化为Q上约化Gröbner基）检验"尊重物理的模型预测更好"这一前提，发现精确不变量对预测增益甚微，但对故障诊断极具价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量文献在学习动力学中嵌入物理结构，其核心前提是遵守底层物理的模型预测更准。作者希望直接检验这一前提，并探索精确不变量究竟在何处真正有价值。

Method: 从轨迹中恢复精确多项式不变量，并规范化为有理数域Q上的约化Gröbner基；在Acrobot上测试一致性正则项与整形势能的影响；提出筛选（定位被违反的物理约束）与归因（恢复错误不变量并识别责任物理参数）两种诊断流程，并引入正规形消胀（normal-form deflation）与商空间恢复技术。

Result: 预测方面：一致性正则项降低代数残差但几乎不改变rollout保真度；用质量误差100%的系统恢复的整形势能与正确势能加速效果相当。诊断方面：15个注入故障中筛选全部正确定位且无误报，观测空间基线则无一能定位；归因在全部7个参数故障上恢复出责任参数；配对差分检验能检测所有故障，说明优势在定位而非检测；参考生成器扰动10^-4仍保留14–15/15定位，而已等性判定可区分10^-12扰动。应用于11个RL环境的350对发布版本，未发现模拟器动力学变化的证据，反而揭示了基准实现本身的性质。

Conclusion: 精确规范不变量的主要价值不在提升预测，而在诊断：可定位被违反的物理约束与责任参数。筛选不要求精确性，而代数比较（理想相等判定）需要精确性；该诊断工具还可用于审计基准实现。

Abstract: A large literature builds physical structure into learned dynamics on the premise that models respecting the underlying physics predict better. We test that premise using exact polynomial invariants recovered from trajectories and canonicalised as reduced Gröbner bases over $\mathbb{Q}$. On Acrobot, exactness provides little benefit for prediction: a consistency regulariser reduces algebraic residual while leaving rollout fidelity essentially unchanged, and a shaping potential recovered from a system with a 100% mass error accelerates learning as effectively as the correct potential. Exact canonical invariants instead prove valuable for diagnosis. We develop two procedures: screening, which identifies the violated physical constraint, and attribution, which recovers the faulty invariant and identifies the responsible physical parameter. To enable this, we introduce normal-form deflation and quotient-space recovery. Across fifteen injected faults, screening localises every broken constraint with no false alarms, whereas observation-space baselines do not localise any; attribution recovers the responsible parameter on all seven parameter faults. Paired difference tests detect all faults, showing that the advantage is localisation rather than detection. Perturbing reference generators by $10^{-4}$ preserves 14--15/15 localisations, showing that screening does not require exactness, whereas ideal-equality decisions distinguish perturbations of only $10^{-12}$, showing that exactness is required for algebraic comparison. Applied to 350 release pairs across eleven RL environments, the diagnostic finds no evidence of changed simulator dynamics, instead revealing properties of the benchmark implementations themselves.

</details>


### [142] [Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13195)
*Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在语音问答中的机器遗忘问题，评估梯度上升、任务算术与对齐微调等策略，在降低隐私泄露率最高达80%的同时保持核心语音理解与问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LALMs在大规模训练数据上具备强大的语音理解与问答能力，但也继承了隐私风险，可能无意中记忆敏感信息。相比文本LLM或ASR任务，语音问答中声学感知与事实知识紧密耦合，使机器遗忘更具挑战性，本文即针对这一空白展开研究。

Method: 提出并评估多种遗忘策略，包括梯度上升（gradient ascent）、任务算术（task arithmetic），以及强制安全拒答响应的基于对齐的微调方法；在语音问答数据集上进行大量实验，以在移除隐私知识的同时保留核心能力。

Result: 这些遗忘方法可将隐私泄露率降低最多80%，同时在非私密语音问答和通用语音理解基准上保持近乎中性的性能表现，即核心能力未明显退化。

Conclusion: 在LALMs语音问答场景中实现机器遗忘是可行且有效的，能够在隐私保护与模型核心能力之间取得较好平衡，为后续语音大模型的隐私安全研究提供了策略与实验依据。

Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in speech understanding and question answering (QA), but they also inherit privacy risks from large-scale training data, including the unintended memorization of sensitive information. In this work, we study machine unlearning for speech QA in LALMs, a setting that is more challenging than prior work on text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) or Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) due to the tight coupling between acoustic perception and factual knowledge. We present and evaluate multiple unlearning strategies, including gradient ascent, task arithmetic, and alignment-based fine-tuning methods that enforce safe refusal responses, to remove private knowledge while still preserving performance on core capabilities. Through extensive experiments on speech QA datasets, we show that these unlearning methods can reduce the privacy leakage rate by up to 80% while maintaining near-neutral performance on non-private speech QA and general speech understanding benchmarks.

</details>


### [143] [Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13197)
*Luan Ozelim,Hector Zenil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用可微的认证复杂度估计器 K^CDM_sF 取代分片常数的块分解法,把算法信息动力学(AID)的微积分引入学习动力学,将复杂度估计器用作控制器来加速 grokking;结果表明其独特贡献在于时机控制(何时施加、何时释放),而非归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AID 通过扰动系统并测量算法复杂度的变化来研究系统,但其常用估计器——块分解法(BDM)——是分片常数(piecewise constant)的,使得微积分只能退化为有限差分,无法用于连续的动力学分析。同时,grokking 现象中虽已有复杂度序参量,却未被用于实际干预。作者希望借助可微估计器,让复杂度成为可参与学习动力学的控制信号。

Method: 采用认证且可微的估计器 K^CDM_sF;固定损失函数,施加短暂的"损失踢动"(transient loss kick),使估计器成为控制器,在 Levin 的"描述长度—时间"意义下加速 grokking,并受数据依赖的 Occam 边界约束。做了多项消融:比较复杂度门控与训练损失门控;检验不同信号是否标记相变完成;检验认证先验与逐参数 ∇K 归因的作用;对 Occam 场进行直接场扰动以观察响应。

Result: Occam 边界的有限尺度趋势 f_c ~ ln p / p,与优惠券收集(coupon-collector)解释一致。消融显示:复杂度门控与训练损失门控在挽救失败种子时效果相当,但干预量减少 27%;在所测试信号中,只有映射复杂度(map complexity)标记了相变的完成;认证先验与逐参数 ∇K 归因均可替代(均匀先验传感器给出比特级相同的门控决策,随机支撑在稀疏度阈值以上可与 ∇K 选择的支持匹配);直接场扰动显示对 Occam 场呈成核式(nucleation-like)响应,在探测振幅范围内未分辨出线性区(故不支持涨落—耗散替代),有限场响应在趋近相变时增长数个数量级。这些测量解释了经验调好的阶梯式策略:bang–bang 脉冲,按产额触发与释放,其迭代恰好构建了它所利用的响应。

Conclusion: 该踢动策略可迁移到稀疏奇偶校验(sparse parity)任务和 Transformer 上,而持续性的权重空间损失则失败。算法估计器的独特贡献是时机控制(何时触发、何时释放),而不是归因。

Abstract: Algorithmic Information Dynamics (AID) studies systems by perturbing them and measuring changes in algorithmic complexity, but its usual estimator, the Block Decomposition Method, is piecewise constant, restricting the calculus to finite differences. We use $K^{\mathrm{CDM}}_{\mathrm{s}F}$, a certified, differentiable estimator, to bring the calculus into learning dynamics: grokking, where a complexity order parameter is known but has not been made to act. A\empts a transient loss kick, the estimator becomes a controller that accelerates grokking in Levin's description-length--versus-time sense, within a data-dependent Occam boundary whose finite-size trend, $f_c\sim\ln p/p$, is consistent with a coupon-collector interpretation. Ablations show that a complexity gate matches a train-loss gate in rescuing failing seeds with $27\%$ less intervention; among the tested signals, only map complexity marks the transition's completion; the certified prior and the per-parameter $\nabla K$ attribution are both fungible (a uniform-prior sensor makes bit-identical gate decisions, and random supports match $\nabla K$-selected ones above a sparsity threshold); and direct field perturbation shows a nucleation-like response to the Occam field (no linear regime is resolved over the probed amplitudes, so these measurements do not justify a fluctuation--dissipation surrogate), with a finite-field response growing by orders of magnitude toward the transition. These measurements account for the empirically tuned staircase: bang--bang pulses, stall-fired and released on yield, whose iteration plausibly builds the response it exploits. The kick transfers to sparse parity and to a transformer; a sustained weight-space loss fails. The algorithmic estimator's distinct contribution is timing (when to fire and when to release), not attribution.

</details>


### [144] [SPICE: Simple Polysemantic Feature Interpretation via Clustering-based Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13198)
*Sehyun Lee,Dahee Kwon,Damin Lee,Jaesik Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SPICE框架，用于通用化分析深度视觉模型中的多义性现象，无需架构特定规则且自动确定概念簇数量，实现对CNN与Transformer的系统比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可解释性中的多义性（单个神经元被多个常不相关的概念激活）阻碍了功能理解。现有方法依赖特定架构和人工启发式（如固定概念簇数量K），通用性与可扩展性受限，尤其难以适用于现代Transformer模型。

Method: SPICE（基于聚类的简单多义特征解释框架）避免架构相关的传播规则，自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数量，无需预设K，从而支持大规模模型的可扩展分析，并可跨CNN与Transformer进行系统比较。

Result: SPICE首次实现了CNN与Transformer之间多义性的系统比较，并能对大型模型进行可扩展分析。

Conclusion: 利用SPICE开展了全面研究，揭示了多义性如何产生、如何随深度与架构变化，以及如何通过不同计算路径形成。

Abstract: One of the pivotal recent challenges in neural network interpretability is polysemanticity, where a single neuron is activated by multiple, often unrelated concepts, hindering clear functional understanding. Although prior work has explored this phenomenon, existing approaches remain architecture-specific and depend on manual heuristics such as a fixed number of concept clusters ($K$), limiting their generality and scalability--especially for modern Transformer-based models. To address these limitations, we introduce SPICE (\textbf{S}imple \textbf{P}olysemantic Feature \textbf{I}nterpretation via \textbf{C}lustering-based \textbf{E}xplanation), a generalizable framework for analyzing polysemanticity in deep vision architectures. SPICE avoids architecture-dependent propagation rules, enabling the first systematic comparison of polysemanticity across both CNNs and Transformers, and automatically determines the number of concept clusters per neuron, eliminating reliance on a preset $K$ and supporting scalable analysis for large models. Using SPICE, we conduct a comprehensive investigation into how polysemanticity emerges, varies across depth and architecture, and forms through distinct computational pathways.

</details>


### [145] [Discovering and Preserving Category Correlation Knowledge via Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13199)
*Dawen Jiang,Zhishu Shen,Zeyu Liu,Tiehua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应互惠知识蒸馏（AR-KD），通过对教师模型进行互惠适应、将其类相关矩阵对齐到学生的关系表示，简化教师输出分布以缩小师生容量差距，在CIFAR-100与ImageNet-1k上超越现有SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏多采用静态单向的"教师到学生"范式，忽视了学生学习的动态性，也难以对困难样本提供针对性指导；同时师生模型间巨大的容量差距阻碍了有效的知识迁移，教师过度自信还会导致类间暗知识坍塌。

Method: 提出自适应互惠知识蒸馏（AR-KD）：对教师进行互惠适应，将教师的类相关矩阵与学生的关系表示进行匹配，从而重塑教师的预测结构使其更契合学生容量；该关系对齐缓解了过度自信教师引发的类间暗知识坍塌，使学生获得更丰富且更兼容的监督信号。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k分类数据集上评估，AR-KD优于当前最先进的知识蒸馏基线；在同构与异构设置下学生准确率最高提升7.13%，平均比原始KD高1.42%至4.15%，与其他先进方法结合时还能进一步提升。代码已开源。

Conclusion: AR-KD通过互惠适应教师的输出分布，有效改善了跨容量差距的知识迁移效果，是一种通用且可与其他蒸馏方法叠加的改进方案。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to improve the performance of lightweight student models by transferring knowledge from larger and more powerful teacher models. However, a substantial size gap between teacher and student models often impedes effective knowledge transfer. Most existing approaches adopt a static, one-way teacher-to-student distillation paradigm, which overlooks the dynamic nature of student learning and fails to provide targeted guidance on hard samples. In this paper, we propose adaptive reciprocal knowledge distillation (AR-KD), a novel method that improves knowledge transfer by simplifying the teacher's output distribution. Specifically, AR-KD performs reciprocal adaptation on the teacher by matching its class correlation matrix to the student's relational representation, which reshapes the teacher's prediction structure to better suit the student's capacity. This relational alignment mitigates the collapse of inter-class dark knowledge caused by overconfident teachers, enabling the student to learn from richer and more compatible supervisory signals. We evaluate AR-KD on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k classification datasets, where it outperforms state-of-the-art knowledge distillation baselines. Specifically, AR-KD improves student performance across homogeneous and heterogeneous setups: up to 7.13% accuracy gain for students, 1.42% to 4.15% higher than vanilla KD on average, and further improvements when integrated with other advanced methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ARKD/.

</details>


### [146] [Criticality in Dissimilar Decomposition and Undersampling of Random Datasets with Anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13201)
*Ghurumuruhan Ganesan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究了当训练数据集包含由现有LLM生成的AI数据（视为与主数据点"链接"的异常）时，随机数据集的分解与欠采样性质，给出强相异（SD）分解最小规模的界并揭示相变现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来LLM的训练数据将包含大量由当前LLM生成的AI文本/图像数据，因此需要理解这种AI生成数据如何影响批分解以及由此产生的新LLM的性能。

Method: 将AI生成数据视为与主数据点相"链接"的异常，研究整体随机数据集的分解与欠采样性质；使用冗余图和迭代技术来获得强相异（SD）分解最小规模的界。

Result: 获得了SD分解最小规模的界，并证明了相变现象：当异常数量较少时最小规模本质上由主数据点决定，而当超过某一阈值后则被异常"接管"；同时建立了随机欠采样数据集强相似性的规模临界性结果。

Conclusion: 通过涉及类别数据集的例子（其整体空间规模远大于数据集规模）对上述结果进行了说明，揭示了AI生成数据对数据集分解性质影响的相变与临界性规律。

Abstract: Training datasets for upcoming LLMs would include a significant amount of AI text/image data generated from current LLMs. In such a scenario, it is important to understand how this affects batch decompositions and thereby, the performance of the resultant new LLM. In this paper, we consider AI generated data as anomalies ``linked" to main data points and study decomposition and undersampling properties of the overall random dataset. We use redundancy graphs and iteration techniques to obtain bounds for the minimum size of a strongly dissimilar (SD) decomposition and demonstrate a phase transition phenomena, wherein the minimum size is essentially determined by the \emph{main} data points when the number of anomalies is small and is ``taken" over by the anomalies above a certain threshold. We also establish a size criticality result for the strong similarity of a randomly undersampled dataset and illustrate our results with examples involving categorical datasets, whose overall space size is much larger than the size of the dataset.

</details>


### [147] [Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13202)
*Yifan WU,Pinjun Dong,Jiran Tao,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过受控实验系统检验了表格基础模型（TFM）是否仍需要人工特征工程。结果表明，特征工程带来的增益主要集中在早期模型代际，对最强模型可忽略；而注入来自相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征工程长期是表格机器学习的基石，而表格基础模型（TFM）通过大规模预训练与上下文学习（in-context learning）直接应用于任务，这引出核心问题：随着模型能力增强，人工特征构造是否仍然重要。作者希望厘清 TFM 能力提升与显式输入表示工程之间的关系。

Method: 对两个主要 TFM 家族的多个版本进行受控研究，在 TabArena 基准数据集上测试多种既有特征工程技术；并设置补充实验，考察从相关数据集引入上下文信息的效果。

Result: 特征工程增益随模型代际增强而递减，在最强模型上基本可忽略；但在无显式特征工程的情况下，加入来自相关数据集的上下文信息仍能改善性能。

Conclusion: 更强 TFM 的性能增益来源发生了转移：对现有输入进行重新表示（re-representation）的效果下降，而提供额外任务相关上下文仍然有益，提示 TFM 更强时对显式特征工程的依赖降低。

Abstract: Feature engineering has long been a cornerstone of tabular machine learning. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained on a wide range of tabular datasets and applied via in-context learning. Their rise raises a natural question: does manual feature construction still matter as these models become more capable? To answer this, we perform a controlled study across several versions of two major TFM families, testing a wide range of existing feature engineering techniques on benchmark datasets from TabArena. We find a consistent pattern: feature engineering gains are concentrated in earlier model generations and become negligible for the strongest models. These results suggest that stronger TFMs depend less on explicitly engineered input representations. In a complementary experiment, however, adding in-context information from related datasets still improves performance. Our findings indicate a shift in the source of performance gains for stronger TFMs: re-representing existing inputs becomes less effective, while providing additional task-relevant context remains beneficial.

</details>


### [148] [Scalable partial information decomposition for symptom networks via supervised embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13203)
*Cillian Hourican,Eric Dignum,Rick Quax,Debraj Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于嵌入的偏信息分解（ePID），将高维症状压缩为低基数离散嵌入后做可计算的两源PID，分离冗余、协同、唯一性与残差信息。在PHQ-9上冗余/残差唯一主导、协同仅6–9%，而在IRI上45%的源对以协同为主。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 症状网络通常用标量边权表示两两关系，无法刻画两个症状对第三症状是否存在信息重叠，或信息是否仅在联合出现时才产生。偏信息分解（PID）可解决这一问题，但其计算复杂度随源数量增长而不可行，难以扩展到多症状量表。

Method: 提出ePID流程：把所有非焦点症状压缩为低基数离散嵌入，再对每个有序"源-目标"对计算可处理的两源PID，输出源唯一、残差唯一、冗余与协同四个分量。在两类数据上评测13种候选嵌入：(1) 以PHQ-9校准的合成贝叶斯网络；(2) 83个真实数据集；并在5种PID度量下验证。表现最优的是有监督的凝聚式条件信息瓶颈（ACIB）嵌入。

Result: ACIB嵌入在全部PID度量下最准确地还原参考分解，只要压缩四维及以上症状即可获得非负原子（协同还原r=0.92）。两量表结果截然不同：PHQ-9网络（UK Biobank N=154,291；新乡学生样本 N=24,292）中周围症状背景通过冗余与残差唯一通道承载了大部分两两依赖，协同贡献6–9%，且两队列均无被协同主导的有向边；而在28项人际反应指针（IRI）中，45%的源对由协同主导。

Conclusion: ePID通过区分重叠信息与交互依赖信息，为标准症状网络方法提供了可扩展、模型无关的补充，能辨别观测相关中的冗余与协同贡献，并在不改参数的情况下对两量表给出各自符合其构建逻辑的相反剖面。

Abstract: Pairwise relationships among mental-health symptoms are routinely summarised asscalar edge weights, which cannot express whether two symptoms carry overlapping information about a third or information that appears only in combination. Partial information decomposition (PID) addresses this gap but is computationally intractable beyond a few sources.
  We introduce embedding-based PID (ePID), a scalable pipeline that compresses all nonfocal symptoms into a low-cardinality discrete embedding and computes a tractable two-source PID, yielding source-unique, remainder-unique, redundant, and synergistic components for each ordered source-target pair. We benchmarked 13 candidate embeddings on synthetic Bayesian networks calibrated to PHQ-9 and on 83 real-world datasets across five PID measures.
  A supervised Agglomerative Conditional Information Bottleneck (ACIB) embedding recovered the reference decomposition most accurately of the 13 embeddings tested, and did so for every PID measure yielding non-negative atoms once four or more symptoms were compressed (synergy recovery r = 0.92). The two instruments then diverged sharply. In PHQ-9 networks (UK Biobank,N = 154,291; Xinxiang student sample, N = 24,292) the surrounding symptom context carried most pairwise dependence through redundant and remainder-unique channels; synergy contributed 6 to 9%, and no directed edge was synergy-dominated in either cohort. In the 28-item Interpersonal Reactivity Index, 45% of source pairs were. The identical pipeline, applied without parameter changes, therefore returned opposite profiles for the two instruments, each consistent with how that instrument was constructed.
  By separating overlapping from interaction-dependent information, ePID provides a scalable, model-agnostic complement to standard symptom-network methodology to distinguish redundant and synergistic contributions to observed correlations.

</details>


### [149] [GradRepair-ODE: Certified Gradient Repair for Neural ODE Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13204)
*Ziqian Bi,Xin Liang Chia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GradRepair-ODE可靠性框架，在优化器步中对神经常微分方程的梯度进行检验、修复与拒收，为ODE梯度附加数值证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经ODE在训练循环内嵌入数值求解器，求解器既决定前向轨迹，也影响传给优化器的梯度。这种耦合在宽松步长、刚性动力学、混沌敏感或事件不连续时，可能返回方向可疑的有限梯度，给科学机器学习和连续时间生成建模（如扩散概率流ODE、流匹配）带来可靠性问题。

Method: GradRepair-ODE：计算多个梯度候选；用方向有限差分校验与求解器诊断进行对比；诊断可能的数值失效模式；通过路径切换或更严格重算修复所选梯度；对无法认证下降方向的步予以拒收。

Result: 在六个合成ODE系统上：低风险系统保持不变；将Robertson与Lorenz梯度修复至与严格参考的余弦相似度1.000；不安全接受步从37降至0；对事件不连续情形予以拒收而非施加未认证更新。

Conclusion: 论文主张对训练契约做一简单改变：ODE梯度应带着数值证据抵达优化器。

Abstract: Neural ordinary differential equations use numerical solvers inside the training loop. The solver determines the forward trajectory and also affects the gradient passed to the optimizer. That coupling creates a reliability problem for scientific machine learning and continuous-time generative modeling, including diffusion probability-flow ordinary differential equations and flow-matching models. Under loose step sizes, stiff dynamics, chaotic sensitivity, or event discontinuities, a differentiable ODE pipeline can return a finite gradient whose direction is numerically suspect. We introduce GradRepair-ODE, a reliability framework for checking, repairing, and rejecting ODE gradients at the optimizer step. The method computes several gradient candidates, compares them with directional finite-difference checks and solver diagnostics, diagnoses likely numerical failure modes, repairs selected gradients through path switching or stricter recomputation, and rejects steps whose descent direction cannot be certified. In six synthetic ODE systems, GradRepair-ODE leaves low-risk systems unchanged, repairs Robertson and Lorenz gradients to cosine similarity 1.000 against a strict reference, reduces unsafe accepted steps from 37 to 0, and rejects an event-discontinuous case instead of applying an uncertified update. The paper argues for a simple change in the training contract: an ODE gradient should reach the optimizer with numerical evidence attached.

</details>


### [150] [Task-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning for MoE-based Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13395)
*Tingqi Wang,Hongyu Ke,Haoxin Wang,Rafal Angryk,Zhipeng Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedTAR，一种面向MoE大模型的任务感知联邦微调方法，通过路由输出建立本地更新与任务偏好的关联，缓解异构客户端数据下的专家特化退化与更新冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE大模型因稀疏专家激活在资源受限的分布式环境中具有吸引力，但在客户端数据异构（任务偏好不同）条件下进行联邦微调时，直接聚合本地更新会削弱专家特化并给共享专家引入冲突的更新方向。

Method: FedTAR利用路由输出建立本地更新与任务偏好的关联：对路由特征与本地更新分别施加SVD，提取低维任务坐标与更新方向；基于任务坐标，对任务偏好相似的客户端进行簇内聚合，并在不同任务组之间进行簇间聚合；再通过学习到的任务到更新映射重构聚合更新，使其与任务特定的优化方向保持一致。

Result: 在四种基准任务、不同non-IID设置下进行评估，FedTAR持续优于强联邦微调基线，取得state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: FedTAR通过任务感知的聚合与更新重构，在异构客户端场景中保留专家特化并缓解破坏性干扰，验证了其在MoE大模型联邦微调中的有效性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a widely adopted architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs), as it improves model capacity while limiting computational overhead through sparse expert activation. This property makes MoE-based LLMs particularly attractive for resource-constrained distributed environments. However, federated fine-tuning of MoE-based LLMs remains challenging under heterogeneous client data. Since clients often correspond to different task preferences, directly aggregating their local updates may weaken expert specialization and introduce conflicting update directions on shared experts. To address these challenges, we propose FedTAR, a task-aware federated fine-tuning method for MoE-based LLMs. FedTAR establishes the association between local updates and task preference via routing outputs. Specifically, we apply Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to both routing features and local updates to extract low-dimensional task coordinates and update directions. Based on the task coordinates, FedTAR performs intra-cluster aggregation among clients with similar task preferences and inter-cluster aggregation across different task groups. The aggregated update is then reconstructed through the learned task-to-update mapping, ensuring that the final update remains aligned with task-specific optimization directions. In this way, FedTAR preserves expert specialization and mitigates destructive interference among heterogeneous clients. We evaluate FedTAR on four benchmark tasks under different non-IID settings. Experimental results demonstrate that FedTAR consistently outperforms strong federated fine-tuning baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [151] [Specification Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13415)
*Atticus Cull,Justin McCarthy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将语言模型作为紧凑的"规范预言机"，比较外部文本笔记与权重修改两种存储方式，发现权重预言机更能利用结构化信息，但存储成本显著更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规范设计中存在基本权衡：省略细节会导致关键问题无法回答，而逐条记录全部细节又会使规范庞大冗长。作者希望探究语言模型能否作为紧凑、动态的规范预言机，通过学习目标事实并直接回答问题来缓解这一矛盾，并比较不同事实存储方式的优劣。

Method: 构建四类共596条事实的世界，采用两种Qwen2.5模型规模（含7B），对比两种存储学习事实的方式：外部文本笔记与对模型权重的修改（适配器）。通过在结构化与非结构化世界上评估准确率，并衡量存储容量成本，比较两类预言机的表现。

Result: 权重预言机从结构中获益明显更多：以7B模型为例，其跨存储容量积分准确率在结构化世界比非结构化世界高18.5个百分点，而笔记预言机仅高1.1个百分点。但该优势伴随显著存储代价，最小适配器约需175 KiB，而笔记预算上限仅为16 KiB。

Conclusion: 适配权重能更成功地利用潜在结构，而外部笔记所需的特定对象存储量要小得多。两种方式各有权衡：权重法在结构化信息利用上占优但存储昂贵，笔记法在存储效率上更佳。

Abstract: Specifications face a basic tradeoff: leave details out, and important questions go unanswered; record every detail separately, and the specification becomes large and prolix. We investigate whether a language model can serve as a compact, living specification oracle by learning facts about a target and answering questions about it directly. We compare two ways of storing the learned facts: external text notes and changes to the model's weights. Across four families of 596-fact worlds and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, weight-only oracles benefited substantially more from structure: with the 7B model, their accuracy integrated across storage capacities was 18.5 percentage points higher on structured than unstructured worlds, compared with 1.1 points for note-sheet oracles. This advantage came at a substantial storage cost, with the smallest adapter requiring approximately 175 KiB compared with a maximum note budget of 16 KiB. Adapted weights therefore exploited latent structure more successfully, while external notes required substantially less object-specific storage.

</details>


### [152] [ReCAST: Reward Credit Assignment across Timesteps for Online Diffusion Reinforcement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13425)
*Yihang Chen,Yuanhao Ban,Kuei-Chun Kao,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCAST，一种在扩散模型多奖励微调中按奖励、按时间步进行信用分配的方法，通过分离用户偏好与时间分配来同时解决"每种奖励贡献多少"和"何时反馈有用"两个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用多奖励训练扩散模型时，需要区分两件事：用户偏好决定每种奖励对总目标的贡献比例，而奖励信息量决定其反馈在去噪过程中何时有用。有些奖励在全局结构出现时即可有效评价样本，另一些则只有样本接近干净时才具有信息量。现有方法未能同时处理这两个问题。

Method: 提出 ReCAST（Reward Credit ASsignment across Timesteps），据称是首个面向扩散奖励微调的、按奖励且依赖时间步的信用分配方法。它通过一个"奖励×时间步"权重矩阵 W 将用户偏好与时间分配解耦：W 的行和等于用户指定的奖励预算 λ，列和相等（即每个去噪步分配相同总权重）。在这些边际约束下，ReCAST 依据每种奖励在各时间步的 Rényi 可判别性增益来分配权重，这些增益可累加为奖励诱导的正策略与当前策略之间的总可判别性，为时间信用分配提供依据。

Result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上以两种不同的四奖励设置、各五个奖励预算 λ 进行评估。ReCAST 在一种设置中提升了训练奖励、在另一种中与之持平，在两种设置下均提升了所有留出评判器，并被独立的 LLM-as-a-Judge 所偏好。

Conclusion: 结果表明，ReCAST 带来的提升能够泛化到训练奖励之外，并支持其核心原则：在每种奖励反馈最具信息量的去噪时间步上赋予其更大权重。

Abstract: Training diffusion models with multiple rewards requires distinguishing user preference from reward informativeness. User preference determines how much each reward should contribute to the overall objective; reward informativeness determines when its feedback is useful during denoising. Some rewards can meaningfully evaluate a sample as soon as global structure emerges, but others become informative only when the sample is nearly clean. To address both questions jointly, we propose ReCAST (Reward Credit ASsignment across T}imesteps), the first method, to our knowledge, for per-reward, timestep-dependent credit assignment in diffusion reward fine-tuning. ReCAST separates user preferences from temporal allocation through a reward-by-timestep weight matrix $W$, whose row sums match the user-specified reward budgets $λ$, while its column sums are equal, assigning the same total weight to each denoising step. Under these marginal constraints, ReCAST allocates weight according to each reward's informativeness, quantified by its Rényi discriminability gain at each step. These gains telescope to the total discriminability between the reward-induced positive policy and the current policy, providing a basis for temporal credit assignment. We evaluate ReCAST by training SD3.5-Medium under two distinct four-reward settings, each across five reward budgets $λ$. ReCAST improves the training rewards in one setting and matches them in the other, improves every held-out judge in both, and is preferred by an independent LLM-as-a-Judge. Together, these results show that ReCAST yields improvements that generalize beyond the training rewards and support its core principle: assigning each reward greater weight at the denoising timesteps where its feedback is most informative.

</details>


### [153] [Certifiably Interpretable Training of ReLU-MLPs for Boolean Tasks with Guaranteed Truth-Table Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13439)
*Hrad Ghoukasian,Anastasis Kratsios*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MACCHIATO 训练算法，联合构造结构化 ReLU-MLP 与带证书的布尔电路，兼顾可解释性与统计保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随算力、模型与训练算法发展，AI 系统日益强大但其可解释性正在被侵蚀；需通过专门训练算法保障可解释性。

Method: MACCHIATO 从部分真值表观测出发，迭代将布尔函数残差投影到低维 {AND,OR,XOR} 电路类，并精确编译为 ReLU-MLP；融合 ReLU-MLP 电路编译、ESPRESSO 逻辑最小化与基于影响的变量选择，电路对子网络计算内容及组合方式提供证书。

Result: 在影响恢复条件下，若每级残差依赖至多 log2(B) 位，样本划分变体在 T 个观测上返回六层、宽度 O(mB) 的 ReLU-MLP，真值表误差 O(√(m(B+log(m/δ))/T))；合成 random-junta 任务上在数据稀疏或投影对齐场景优于同深度/宽度 Adam-MLP；PyEDA 实现中迭代过程在平面 ESPRESSO 超三小时预算的场景下仍可完成。

Conclusion: MACCHIATO 将可解释性证书与统计泛化保证结合，在部分场景优于标准训练 MLP，并显著提升高维逻辑编译的可扩展性。

Abstract: As compute scales, models evolve, and training algorithms advance, our ability to explain the increasingly powerful AI systems they enable is eroding. To help safeguard interpretability, we introduce a specialized training algorithm (MACCHIATO) that jointly constructs (i) an explicitly structured $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP from partial truth-table observations and (ii) an explicit Boolean circuit over signed literals with $\{\operatorname{AND},\operatorname{OR},\operatorname{XOR}\}$ gates certifying what its subnetworks compute and how they compose. Intuitively, we iteratively project the residuals of a Boolean function onto low-dimensional $\{\operatorname{AND},\operatorname{OR},\operatorname{XOR}\}$-circuit classes and exactly compile the resulting circuit into a $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP; we combine $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP circuit compilation, ESPRESSO logic minimization, and influence-based variable selection.
  Roughly speaking, our interpretability certificate is complemented by a statistical guarantee: under the theorem's influence-recovery conditions, if each of the $m$ stage-wise residuals depends on at most $\log_2(B)$ bits, a sample-splitting variant of our algorithm trained on $T$ observations returns a six-layer $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP (counting the input layer) of width $\mathcal{O}(mB)$ with truth-table error $\mathcal{O}\bigl(\sqrt{m(B+\log(m/δ))/T}\bigr)$.
  On synthetic random-junta tasks, our networks outperform depth- and hidden-width-matched Adam-trained MLPs in several data-sparse or projection-aligned regimes, while the trained ReLU-MLPs are stronger in others. Moreover, in our explicit PyEDA truth-table implementation, the iterative procedure completes in regimes where flat ambient-dimensional ESPRESSO exceeds the three-hour computational budget.

</details>


### [154] [Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with $O(d)$ Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13440)
*Yang Cai,Anupam Gupta,Vineet Gupta,Guru Guruganesh,Yanchen Jiang,Christopher Liaw,Aranyak Mehta,Renato Paes Leme,Grigoris Velegkas,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个高效且"proper"的在线逆线性优化确定性算法，每轮O(d²)时间、总遗憾O(d)，兼具有腐坏鲁棒性与秩自适应变体，并应用于凸最小化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线逆线性优化此前最优的O(d)遗憾界由Dewasurendra给出，但其规则是"improper"的，需在每个尺度上枚举覆盖（cover），每轮代价高达T^{Θ(d)}，实际不可行；同时该界还带ln T因子。作者希望同时解决效率与proper性两个问题。

Method: 基于Sakaue等人的变尺度（variable-metric）框架，引入自归一化秩一更新（self-normalized rank-one update）；将原\text{log}\det势函数替换为迹幂\text{tr}(H^{-1/2})，该量天然有界，从而消除ln T项。

Result: 得到确定性算法，遗憾O(d)且对时间horizon一致（uniform），每轮O(d²)时间；这是首个高效的此类界，也是首个proper规则。该界对不进行优化的专家（expert）同样成立；并给出腐坏鲁棒（corruption-robust）和秩自适应（rank-adaptive）变体，以及凸最小化的应用。

Conclusion: 通过势函数替换与秩一更新，作者在保持O(d)遗憾的同时将每轮开销从T^{Θ(d)}降至O(d²)，实现了首个高效、proper的在线逆线性优化算法，并拓展到鲁棒、秩自适应及凸优化场景。

Abstract: We give a deterministic algorithm for online inverse linear optimization with regret $O(d)$, uniform in the horizon and $O(d^{2})$ time per round. A bound of this order was obtained recently by Dewasurendra, settling a question of Gollapudi et al.\ and of Oki and Sakaue, but by an improper rule that enumerates covers at every scale and costs $T^{Θ(d)}$ a round; ours is the first efficient such bound and the first proper one. We build on the variable-metric framework of Sakaue et al., adding a self-normalized rank-one update, and we replace the $\log\det$ potential by the trace power $\tr(H^{-1/2})$, which is bounded outright and removes the $\ln T$. The bound also holds against an expert that does not optimize, and we give corruption-robust and rank-adaptive variants, and an application to convex minimization.

</details>


### [155] [Learning to Solve Hard Problems in RL for LLMs by Never Giving Up](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13443)
*Michael Noukhovitch,Hamish Ivison,Nathan Lambert,Aaron Courville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出RL训练LLM存在"马太效应"——简单题提升大、难题提升小，并提出自适应采样方法NGU以动态重分配算力，在数学与代码任务上提升每算力性能，尤其改善难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL对LLM的性能提升在数据集上分布不均：LLM本已擅长的简单题提升显著，难题提升有限。作者将此归因于现代RL方法在简单题上浪费过多算力，故需动态重分配算力以缓解这一累积优势现象。

Method: 提出Never Give Up（NGU），一种简单的自适应采样方法：对某问题持续生成样本直至得到一个正确解。借助异步RL，该方法自然减少用于过滤简单题的样本量，并将更多算力分配给难题。同时研究了影响NGU的设计选择（如off-policy鲁棒性），并总结出一套最佳实践。

Result: 在数学基准DeepScaler上，NGU提升了每算力性能，尤其在难题上改善明显；在近期编码任务Manufactoria上，标准GRPO配合逐测试奖励无法完全解决含易难测试梯度的问题，而NGU可迭代改进，逐步解决越来越难的测试，最终学会完整解决代码问题。

Conclusion: 现代RL浪费算力于简单题，加剧了对难题提升不足的"马太效应"；NGU通过自适应采样与异步RL重新分配算力，可有效提升每算力性能，并在数学与编程任务上尤其在难题上取得更好效果。

Abstract: We demonstrate that training LLMs with RL does not improve performance equally across a dataset. RL shows large improvements on easy problems that an LLM is already good at solving, but small improvements on hard problems. We call this the Matthew Effect in RL for LLMs, after the phenomenon of cumulative advantage from economics and network science summarized as "the rich get richer". The naive explanation is that hard problems require more compute to find a solution. We argue that modern RL methods are exacerbating the issue by wasting too much compute on easy problems and instead should dynamically reallocate how they use compute. We introduce Never Give Up (NGU), a simple adaptive sampling method that keeps generating samples for a problem until one is correct. By leveraging asynchronous RL, this naturally uses fewer samples to filter out easy problems and allocates more compute to solving harder problems. We investigate the design choices that affect NGU, such as off-policy robustness, and develop a set of best practices. On the math benchmark Deepscaler, NGU improves performance per compute, especially on harder problems. On a recent coding task, Manufactoria, standard GRPO with a per-test reward fails to fully solve problems that have a range of easy and difficult tests. NGU iteratively improves, solving harder and harder tests, until it learns to fully solve coding problems.

</details>


### [156] [A Machine Learning API for Earth Observation Data Cubes Based on openEO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13453)
*Brian Pondi,Jonas Hurst,Rolf Simoes,Jonas Starke,Marius Appel,Edzer Pebesma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出openEO过程级机器学习规范，分模型初始化、模型操作与管理三阶段，支持经典与深度学习算法，借多后端原型与用例验证跨后端互操作性，并指出完全可移植性需后端一致性配置文件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测数据日益以时空数据立方体组织，而机器学习方法依赖表格特征矩阵或结构化张量输入，二者不匹配导致平台特定的转换难以复现或跨云基础设施迁移；openEO虽提供统一接口，却缺乏标准化的机器学习集成方案。

Method: 提出面向openEO的过程级机器学习规范，划分为模型初始化、模型操作（训练、调参、推理、验证）与模型管理三个阶段；支持随机森林、SVM等经典算法及TempCNN、时间注意力编码器和基础模型推理等深度学习架构；在R与Python中实现三个原型，并以作物类型制图用例向独立的R与Python后端提交相同过程图，比较预测与评价指标。

Result: 三个原型实现证明了跨异构技术栈的可行性；作物类型制图用例实现了跨后端互操作性；另两个用例分别在专用后端上完成时间序列深度学习与基础模型推理。但原型揭示，仅靠过程级规范无法强制实现完全跨后端可移植性，序列化格式与执行语义仍需更深协调，后端库版本及规范边界外的预处理约定也影响可复现性。

Conclusion: 该规范提升了云平台上地球观测数据立方体机器学习工作流的可复现性、可移植性与可访问性；未来最重要的近期方向是通过显式的后端一致性配置文件同时解决序列化与执行语义协调以及边界外因素问题。

Abstract: Earth Observation (EO) data are increasingly organized as spatio-temporal data cubes, while machine learning (ML) methods operate on tabular feature matrices or structured tensor inputs. This mismatch forces platform-specific transformations that are difficult to reproduce or transfer across cloud infrastructures. The openEO specification provides a unified interface for EO data access and processing across heterogeneous backends, but lacks a standardized approach for ML integration.
  We propose a process-level ML specification for openEO structured into three stages: model initialization, model actions (training, tuning, inference, validation), and model management. It supports classical algorithms such as Random Forest and SVM, as well as deep learning architectures for time-series and spatial patch-based modeling, including TempCNN, Temporal Attention Encoders, and foundation model inference. Three prototype implementations in R and Python demonstrate feasibility across diverse technology stacks. A crop type mapping use case demonstrates cross-backend interoperability by submitting an identical process graph to independent R and Python backends and comparing predictions and evaluation metrics.
  Two further use cases demonstrate deep learning on time series and foundation model inference, each executed on a dedicated backend. The prototypes reveal, however, that full cross-backend portability requires deeper harmonization of serialization formats and execution semantics than the process level alone can enforce; backend library versions and preprocessing conventions outside the specification's boundary also affect reproducibility. Addressing both through explicit backend conformance profiles represents the most important near-term direction. The specification advances the reproducibility, portability, and accessibility of ML workflows on EO data cubes across cloud platforms.

</details>


### [157] [On the Potential of Multi-Task Learning in Predictive Process Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13477)
*Lukas Kirchdorfer,Keyvan Amiri Elyasi,Heiner Stuckenschmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对预测性流程监控（PPM）中的多任务学习（MTL）进行了系统性实证研究，验证其相对单任务学习（STL）的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPM深度学习方法多为单任务学习（STL），需为每个任务单独训练模型，导致维护成本高且忽视任务间潜在协同效应。MTL虽为有前景的替代方案，但在PPM中是否有效、在何种设置下有效等问题尚不明确。

Method: 首次针对PPM开展MTL的全面实证研究，评估多种任务组合、神经网络架构及优化方法，探究MTL的有效性、受益任务、协同组合及任务平衡策略。

Result: MTL在下一活动预测上取得显著提升，并能内在地缓解类别不平衡问题；任务平衡在低容量模型下尤为关键。

Conclusion: MTL是PPM的一种强有力范式，为超越传统STL提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts how ongoing organizational processes unfold, enabling information systems to move beyond execution support toward proactive analysis and monitoring. Although deep learning has improved prediction accuracy in PPM, most approaches follow a single-task learning (STL) setup, training a separate model per task. This increases maintenance effort and overlooks potential synergies. Multi-task learning (MTL), which jointly learns multiple prediction targets in one model, offers a promising alternative, yet its effectiveness in PPM remains underexplored. It remains unclear whether and under which settings MTL improves upon STL, which prediction tasks benefit most from joint learning, which task combinations are particularly synergistic, and if and how tasks should be balanced. To fill this gap, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of MTL for PPM, evaluating a variety of task combinations, neural architectures, and optimization methods. Overall, our results position MTL as a strong paradigm for PPM: we see substantial improvements in next-activity prediction and inherent mitigation of class imbalance using MTL, while task balancing is especially critical under low-capacity models.

</details>


### [158] [One Spectrum, Two Resources: Data-Memory Scaling in Autoregressive Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13500)
*Chiwun Yang,Xiaoyu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究自回归检索源中"数据"与"学习记忆"两种资源的权衡关系，证明二者由同一预测能量谱控制，并给出极小极大律刻画其耦合规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者试图回答一个核心问题：要从更多数据中获益，需要多少已学得的记忆？即数据规模（预测分辨率）与记忆容量（量化比特）如何相互制约。

Method: 在正熵自回归检索源框架下，定义每个坐标的查询概率乘以其未知logit的平方半径构成的预测能量谱μ；据此推导极小极大律 R*_value(n,B)≍_R Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B)，其中Φ_μ(t)=∫min{x,t}μ(dx)。数据设定分辨率1/n，记忆通过最优比特分配确定水平τ_B。并通过一个带掩码的query-key注意力头实现该路由与取值，显式给出路由、格式与算术误差。

Result: 证明了极小极大律并完整恢复正能量谱；揭示能量-维度配对的关键性（两个具有相同块能量与块维度边缘分布的因果源，其数据与记忆指数不同）；给出指数自适应分配、有限精度实现以及双侧算术假设下的计算-精度律。

Conclusion: 实验恢复了数据-记忆坍缩与耦合指数，解释了路由与分配机制，并在六种规模的预训练模型上检验了仅权重量化。理论表明数据与记忆由单一能量谱统一支配，二者不可分离地耦合。

Abstract: How much learned memory is needed to benefit from more data? We show that the two resources are governed by one predictive-energy spectrum in a positive-entropy autoregressive retrieval source. Each coordinate contributes its query probability times the squared radius of its unknown logit. Writing $μ$ for the resulting energy spectrum, we prove the minimax law $\mathfrak R^*_{\rm value}(n,B)\asymp_R Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B), Φ_μ(t)=\int\min\{x,t\}\,μ(\mathrm dx),$ for $n$ prediction blocks and a learned state with at most $2^B$ values. Data set the resolution $1/n$; memory sets the level $τ_B$ reached by optimal bit allocation. The complete curve also recovers the positive spectrum. Energy-dimension pairing is essential: two causal sources with identical block-energy and block-dimension marginals have different data and memory exponents. A masked query-key attention head learns the route and values, realizing the law with explicit routing, format, and arithmetic errors. Further results give exponent-adaptive allocation, finite-precision realization, and compute-precision laws under two-sided arithmetic assumptions. Experiments recover the data-memory collapse and coupling exponents, explain the routing and allocation mechanisms, and examine weight-only quantization across six pretrained-model scales.

</details>


### [159] [Pretraining for Sample-Efficient Neural Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13507)
*Ben Tang,Zachary Spalding,Gregory B. Cogan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MAPA（带解剖区域嵌入与相对位置编码的掩码自编码器），实现跨受试者、跨任务的iEEG神经表征自监督预训练，在Neuroprobe基准三个设定上均达SOTA，并将跨受试者解码所需标注试次从3500降至约164。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能神经解码器通常需为每个新受试者采集大量带标注数据，标注成本高。自监督预训练可利用跨受试者积累的无标注记录学习通用神经表征以降低标注需求，但在iEEG上因受试者间电极触点位置与神经解剖结构差异而难以奏效。

Method: 提出MAPA：结构上为常规掩码自编码器，引入两种空间编码——解剖区域嵌入（anatomical region embedding）与相对位置编码（relative positional encoding），二者共同使模型学到可迁移至未见过受试者及多种任务的神经表征。

Result: 在Neuroprobe基准的三种评测设定（同session、跨session、跨受试者）上，无需微调即全面刷新SOTA；跨受试者设定下，基于MAPA特征的线性探针仅需约164个标注试次即可达到无预训练时需3500个试次才达到的准确率。

Conclusion: 自监督预训练能够跨异构iEEG记录规模化扩展，并显著减少新受试者实现高精度解码所需的标注数据量。

Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) decode neural activity to restore lost function. Typically, training a high-performance neural decoder requires a large labeled dataset to be collected from every new subject. One way to reduce the labeled data cost is self-supervised pretraining, which learns general neural representations from unlabeled recordings that accumulate across subjects. However, for intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) recordings, self-supervised learning has been challenging due to differences in contact placement and neuroanatomy between subjects. We propose MAPA, an otherwise vanilla masked autoencoder with two spatial encodings, an anatomical region embedding and a relative positional encoding, which together enable it to learn neural representations that transfer to unseen subjects and across various tasks. MAPA sets a new state of the art across all three regimes of the Neuroprobe benchmark without fine-tuning: within-session, cross-session, and cross-subject. In the cross-subject regime, a linear probe on MAPA's features needs only ${\sim}164$ labeled trials to reach the accuracy that takes 3,500 without pretraining. Our results show that self-supervised pretraining can scale across heterogeneous iEEG recordings and reduce the labeled data needed for accurate decoding in new subjects.

</details>


### [160] [A Three-Axis Stress Test of LLM vs Classical ML for Network Intrusion Detection under Distribution Shift and Adversarial Evasion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13511)
*Muhammad Ebad Atif,Muhammad Haider Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出NIDS领域的LLM与经典机器学习对比普遍仅采用同数据集评测，这一范式不完整。作者在NetFlow v2上从同数据集性能、跨数据集迁移和对抗规避三轴评测XGBoost与RoBERTa-LoRA，发现二者互有胜负，不存在通用最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用于网络入侵检测（NIDS），并与经典机器学习方法进行基准对比，但现有评测几乎总是采用同数据集（same-dataset）设定，忽略了分布偏移下的迁移能力与对抗鲁棒性，导致结论片面、模型推荐依据不足。

Method: 在两组独立采集的NetFlow v2网络上评测XGBoost与RoBERTa-LoRA，覆盖三个独立轴：同数据集性能、跨数据集迁移、对抗规避；并辅以分阶段的特征泄漏消融实验，考察其对跨数据集迁移的影响方向。

Result: 同数据集上两模型统计上持平；跨数据集分布偏移下XGBoost决定性胜出，F1高约15分、平衡准确率高约25分，而RoBERTa-LoRA在目标网络上假阳性率高达0.78，几乎接近随机水平；对抗规避下RoBERTa-LoRA决定性胜出，在代表性中等扰动强度下F1领先约17分，且两模型假阳性率均保持在0.01以下。特征泄漏消融显示跨数据集迁移呈非单调变化，表明泄漏信号分布于整个特征表示而非局限于少数列；两网络间的跨数据集迁移具有强方向性。

Conclusion: 推荐哪个模型完全取决于所测试的轴，而非同数据集准确率。NIDS评测应在多个相互独立的鲁棒性轴上展开，且每个轴需使用多于一个指标，以避免单一评测协议带来的误导性结论。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly benchmarked against classical machine learning for network intrusion detection (NIDS), almost always using same-dataset evaluation, and that protocol turns out to be incomplete. Evaluating XGBoost and RoBERTa-LoRA on two independently collected NetFlow v2 networks across three axes (same-dataset performance, cross-dataset transfer, and adversarial evasion) reveals no universal winner. The two models are statistically tied same-dataset. XGBoost wins decisively under cross-dataset distribution shift, by 15 points of F1 and 25 points of balanced accuracy; on the target network RoBERTa-LoRA's false positive rate reaches 0.78, leaving it barely above chance despite a superficially moderate F1. RoBERTa-LoRA wins decisively under adversarial evasion, by roughly 17 points of F1 at a representative mid-range perturbation strength, while both models hold false positive rates below 0.01 throughout. The model an evaluator would recommend therefore depends entirely on which axis is tested, not on same-dataset accuracy alone. A staged feature-leakage ablation improves cross-dataset transfer non-monotonically, indicating the leakage signal is distributed across the feature representation rather than confined to a few columns, and cross-dataset transfer between our two networks is strongly directional. These results argue for evaluating NIDS models along multiple independent robustness axes, and with more than one metric per axis.

</details>


### [161] [Adaptive Phase-Switching for Communication-Efficient Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13512)
*Jerry Adams Franklin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文测量双向B-only联邦LoRA协议的每轮上下行字节数，将五种方法置于统一的通信-质量前沿上，提出自适应相位切换聚合器ReverseAdaptive，在TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat上以40.5%的往返通信节省换取0.0063的留出损失代价，并显著优于FFA-LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦LoRA微调虽降低了每客户端可训练参数量，但客户端-服务器通信仍是主要开销。现有联邦LoRA协议的通信核算忽略了协议切换聚合模式时的非对称过渡轮次，且所报告节省量未考虑分组查询注意力（GQA）的形状，导致评估不准确。

Method: 测量双向B-only联邦LoRA协议的每轮上传与下载字节，并将五种方法（含三种既有工作）统一放在通信-质量前沿上比较；提出自适应相位切换聚合器ReverseAdaptive，通过监测全局训练损失的相对改进量与一个无量纲阈值来确定前沿拐点，而非预先固定相位边界。

Result: 在TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat与Alpaca上，ReverseAdaptive相较FLoRA实现40.5%的实测往返节省，留出指令跟随损失代价为0.0063；在留出损失上比FFA-LoRA（初始化时冻结两个LoRA因子中的第一个）优0.0182，超过该指标各方法最大种子标准差的二十倍以上。同一阈值可跨模型规模迁移而无需重新调参，过渡的质量代价在两个测试数据集上保持稳定。

Conclusion: 先学习LoRA因子再冻结可产生更优适配器；ReverseAdaptive以极小质量代价换取显著通信节省，且其阈值具有跨规模可迁移性和跨数据集稳定性。

Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models with low-rank adaptation reduces per-client trainable parameters, but client-to-server communication remains the dominant cost. Existing accounting for federated LoRA protocols omits the asymmetric transition round when a protocol changes aggregation mode, and reports savings that ignore grouped-query attention shapes. This paper measures per-round upload and download bytes for a bidirectional B-only federated LoRA protocol and places five methods, three from prior work, on a single communication-quality frontier. The frontier has a knee, which an adaptive phase-switching aggregator, ReverseAdaptive, locates by monitoring the relative improvement in global training loss against a dimensionless threshold rather than by fixing a phase boundary in advance. On TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat with Alpaca, ReverseAdaptive attains 40.5 percent measured round-trip savings over FLoRA at a held-out instruction-following loss cost of 0.0063. It outperforms FFA-LoRA, which freezes the first of the two LoRA factors at initialization, by 0.0182 in held-out loss, more than twenty times the largest per-method seed standard deviation on that metric, so learning that factor before freezing it produces better adapters. The same threshold transfers across model scales without retuning, and the quality cost of the transition is stable across the two datasets tested.

</details>


### [162] [Operational Range Bounding in Spectroscopy: A Safety Cage Framework for Machine Learning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13514)
*Nikki Grens,Luís F. Simões,Kai Hou Yip,Theresa Lueftinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化"安全笼"架构，作为并行监控层评估黑盒模型预测的有效性，在Ariel数据挑战赛数据集上验证表明，20%覆盖率削减可带来45%–65%的误差下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在空间任务等安全关键场景中，黑盒机器学习模型难以在无地面真值条件下验证可靠性。模型对未建模的仪器异常、恒星活动与域偏移敏感，会引入未被量化的风险，因此需要在不修改模型本身的前提下监控其预测有效性。

Method: 提出模块化安全笼架构，作为与估计器并行的监控层，不改动底层模型。监控三类运行时指标：不确定性量化、域外检测与影响函数，将模型运行域约束在已验证区域内。使用2019与2021两版Ariel数据挑战赛数据集，在同域与跨域条件下进行受控评估，并基于形式化的覆盖率-风险框架系统分析指标组合。

Result: 模型失效是多方面的，单一指标无法覆盖所有失效模式，说明需要指标融合。采用安全驱动的拒识策略后，数据覆盖率仅降低20%，不同域和评估指标上的误差下降45%至65%。通过覆盖率-风险框架识别出可最大化风险排序准确性并优化覆盖率与科学性能权衡的指标组合。

Conclusion: 安全笼为检测不可靠预测提供了透明机制，是在地面真值稀缺的科学应用（如天体物理）中安全部署数据驱动模型的关键一步。

Abstract: Ensuring the reliability of black-box machine learning models in safety-critical space missions remains a significant challenge, particularly when ground-truth is unavailable for validation. Although machine learning models offer a powerful means to augment standard pipelines by extracting transmission spectra from complex exoplanetary light curves, their susceptibility to unmodelled instrument anomalies, stellar activity, and domain shifts introduces unquantified risks. This study evaluates a modular safety cage architecture that operates as a parallel monitoring layer to assess the validity of a prediction without modifying the underlying estimator. By monitoring different runtime indicators, including uncertainty quantification, out-of-domain detection, and influence functions, the framework constrains the model's operational domain to a verified region. A controlled evaluation is conducted under both in-domain and cross-domain conditions, using datasets from the 2019 and 2021 editions of the Ariel Data Challenges. The results reveal that model failure is multifaceted and that no single indicator captures all failure modes, demonstrating the need for indicator fusion. The application of safety-driven rejection strategies shows that a modest 20% reduction in data coverage results in error reductions between 45% and 65% across different domains and evaluation metrics. Using a formalised coverage-risk framework, a systematic analysis of indicator combinations is performed to identify configurations that maximise risk-ranking accuracy and optimise the trade-off between data coverage and scientific performance. Safety cages provide a transparent mechanism for detecting unreliable predictions and represent a critical step towards the safe deployment of data-driven models in scientific applications, such as astrophysics, where ground truth is seldom available.

</details>


### [163] [GeoTTER: Leveraging Local Geometry of Optimal Transport for Zero-Shot Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13518)
*Wei-Yang Alex Lee,Rudrasis Chakraborty,Vishnu Lokhande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GeoTTER 框架，将局部几何结构与聚类引导代价融入最优传输，用于零样本分类，在多个基准上稳定超越零样本基线与 OTTER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统零样本分类中的最优传输方法依赖由预训练模型嵌入得到的固定代价矩阵，存在代价失配（miscalibration）与适应性不足问题，并表现为高频的标签锯齿与低频的角度漂移两类偏差。

Method: 两项关键技术：(1) 借助图谱拉普拉斯平滑，将局部几何结构引入最优传输以抑制高频标签锯齿，强制邻域一致性；(2) 融合聚类引导的代价分量与全局校正的传输代价，进行多目标优化，以纠正角度漂移并同时满足全局分布约束与潜在数据结构。

Result: 在多样化的基准测试上取得稳健提升，相对零样本方法中位提升 +6.82%，相对 OTTER 中位提升 +2.13%。

Conclusion: GeoTTER 通过几何感知与聚类引导的最优传输代价设计，有效缓解固定代价矩阵带来的失配与适应性问题，显著提升零样本分类性能。

Abstract: We present GeoTTER, a novel framework that redefines optimal transport in the realm of zero-shot classification. Conventional methods often suffer from miscalibration and a lack of adaptability, as they rely on fixed cost matrices derived solely from pre-trained model embeddings. In contrast, GeoTTER addresses these limitations by incorporating two key techniques. First, to alleviate high-frequency label jaggedness (sample-level manifold jitter that assigns neighboring embeddings to different classes), GeoTTER integrates local geometric structure into the optimal transport formulation via graph-Laplacian smoothing, a technique grounded in spectral graph theory that enforces neighborhood consistency. Second, to correct coherent angular drift (a low-frequency orientation bias in which large groups of samples share the same angular offset from their true label prototypes), we fuse clustering-guided cost components with a globally adjusted transport cost, achieving a multi-objective optimization that respects both global distribution constraints and latent data structure. With a median improvement of +6.82% compared to zero-shot and +2.13% compared to OTTER, GeoTTER shows robust improvements across a diverse set of benchmarks.

</details>


### [164] [Bandits with Probing: Optimal Regret and the Limits of Winner Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15248)
*Yongjie Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"探测优势"问题：每轮从 n 个臂中探测至多 k 个，仅观测其奖励的最大值，并与最优固定臂竞争；作者刻画了两类极小极大遗憾律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在只能观测被探测臂奖励最大值的受限反馈下，探测多个臂带来的"覆盖优势"是否值得、何时值得学习，缺乏理论刻画；需要给出极小极大遗憾的精确阶。

Method: 考虑两种反馈设定：(1) 独立随机奖励下的 winner feedback（最大值加获胜臂标签），以及给定块最大值间单一带符号对比的任意固定序列；(2) winner feedback 下的任意联合 i.i.d. 奖励与固定序列。通过构造上界算法与允许任意自适应动作规模的下界分析，建立极小极大遗憾阶。

Result: 第一种设定下极小极大遗憾为 Φ_{n,k}(T)=min{(n-k)/n·T, (n-k)/k}，2≤k<n；第二种设定下为 R_{n,k}(T)=(n-k)/n·min{T,(n+T)/k,√(nT/k)}。两律均含通用常数与 anytime 上界；第一律退化为纯覆盖代价，第二律在时间尺度 n 处出现与覆盖相当的学习代价，超过 nk 后数值最大值优于标签信息。

Conclusion: 探测优势的收益由覆盖与学习两类代价决定：同轮对比吸收稳定性代价、独立性支持精确重采样以资助样本推进；学习代价在长时域下不可忽略，且反馈信息在不同时间尺度发生转变。

Abstract: A learner probes at most $k$ of $n$ arms each round, receives the maximum of their rewards in $[0,1]$, and competes with the best fixed arm. When does the probing advantage pay for learning? We determine two minimax laws. Under independent stochastic rewards with winner feedback (the maximum and a winning label), or on arbitrary fixed sequences given a single signed contrast between block maxima, the minimax regret has order $Φ_{n,k}(T)=\min\{\frac{n-k}{n}T,\frac{n-k}{k}\}$, $2\le k<n$. Under winner feedback, both arbitrary joint i.i.d. rewards and fixed sequences have minimax regret of order $R_{n,k}(T)=\frac{n-k}{n}\min\{T,\frac{n+T}{k},\sqrt{\frac{nT}{k}}\}$.
