Both laws have universal constants and anytime upper bounds. The first reduces regret to a pure coverage cost: same-round contrasts absorb the stability cost, and independence permits exact resampling whose gains fund sample advancement. The second adds a learning cost that becomes comparable to coverage at horizon $n$; beyond $nk$, numerical maxima improve over labels alone. The lower bound allows every adaptive action size.

</details>


### [165] [Rolling Day-Wise Mortality Prediction in Critically Ill Patients With AKI on CRRT Utilizing Machine Pressure Waveforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13524)
*Shehan Irteza Pranto,Joanna Yang,Joshua Lambert,Stuart L. Goldstein,Lili Chan,Girish N. Nadkarni,Tiago K. Colicchio,Javier A. Neyra,Jin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将CRRT机器的分钟级回路压力波形用于患者级死亡预测：通过数据清洗流程（机器记录对齐、去除预冲/停机分钟、去噪、掩码未观测区间）构建干净流数据，进而提出基于Transformer的堆叠集成模型（窗口降采样序列Transformer + 经典模型晚期融合）。在CRRTnet多中心队列（976例、4,585治疗日）上，融合EHR与机器流的一天死亡预测AUROC达0.766，高于仅机器（0.625）与仅EHR（0.717）；SHAP显示回路不稳定特征显著提升了机器数据在Top15特征中的占比（3→7个，20.0%→46.7%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 危重AKI行CRRT患者死亡率高，但现有风险评估仅依赖EHR临床参数，忽略了CRRT机器生成的分钟级回路压力波形——该连续信号反映体外循环与患者的相互作用，却被弃用（受共享设备记录、非生理分钟、传感器伪影污染）。临床医生因此只能在化验时点重新评估风险，无法实时感知恶化。

Method: 1) 数据清洗：将机器记录对齐到已记录的therapy intervals防跨患者泄漏；剔除预冲与停机分钟；在合成尖峰注入基准上调参去噪；对未观测区间用掩码而非插补。2) 任务定义：滚动日粒度预测。3) 模型：Transformer堆叠集成，将窗口降采样的序列Transformer与经典模型晚期融合，特征包含回路不稳定特征（滤器压力、TMP、ARD）与EHR变量。

Result: 在防泄漏基准的CRRTnet多中心队列（976患者、4,585治疗日）上：仅机器模型AUROC 0.625最低；仅EHR模型0.717；EHR+机器融合达一天死亡率AUROC 0.766。SHAP归因显示回路不稳定描述符使机器特征在Top15组合特征中的数量由3升至7（占比20.0%→46.7%），主要贡献为滤器压力、跨膜压（TMP）与通路-回流差（ARD）。

Conclusion: 本文首次实现纳入CRRT机器数据的患者级死亡预测，将原本被丢弃的床旁连续数据流转化为连续风险信号，验证了机器波形与EHR融合的增量预后价值及回路不稳定特征的临床可解释性。

Abstract: Critically ill patients with acute kidney injury (AKI) on continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) face high mortality, yet current risk assessment relies primarily on clinical parameters from electronic health records (EHR) and ignores minute-level circuit pressure waveforms generated by CRRT machines that track the extracorporeal circuit's interaction with the patient. Clinicians therefore cannot see deterioration as it develops. Risk is reassessed only when labs are drawn, while this continuous record is discarded because it is contaminated by shared-device records, non-physiological minutes, and sensor artifacts. To make the stream usable, we aligned machine records to charted therapy intervals to prevent cross-patient leakage, removed priming and downtime minutes, tuned denoising on a synthetic spike-injection benchmark, and masked unobserved intervals rather than imputing them. On this cleaned stream, we define a rolling day-wise task and a transformer-based stacked ensemble that late-fuses a window-reduced sequence transformer with classical models using circuit-instability features and clinical EHR variables. In a leak-safe benchmark on the multi-center CRRTnet cohort (976 patients, 4,585 treatment days), the machine-only model had the lowest standalone prognostic value (AUROC 0.625), followed by the EHR-only model (0.717). Integrating EHR and machine streams reached a one-day mortality AUROC of 0.766. SHAP attribution showed that circuit-instability descriptors raised the machine share of the top 15 combined-model features from 3 to 7 (20.0% to 46.7%), highlighting filter pressure, transmembrane pressure (TMP), and access-to-return difference (ARD). To our knowledge, this is the first patient-level mortality prediction incorporating CRRT machine data, turning a discarded bedside stream into a continuous risk signal.

</details>


### [166] [Learning CNF Formulas from Uniform Random Solutions: Near-Tight Sample Complexity for Valiant's Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15268)
*Weiming Feng,Yixiao Yu,Yiyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Valiant算法在局部引理条件下从均匀随机解学习CNF公式的问题，给出了固定t下算法样本复杂度的上界与下界匹配结果，并证明t=1时算法在样本复杂度上近似最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Valiant (Commun. ACM'84) 提出的算法用于从i.i.d.均匀随机解中学习n变量、子句大小k、变量度d的CNF公式。其在局部引理条件下的样本复杂度是否最优尚不清楚，本文旨在给出精确的样本复杂度刻画，区分t>1与t=1（涵盖0<t<1）两种情形。

Method: 在固定t≥1、k≥(1+1/t)log d的条件下，分析Valiant算法在总变差误差ε下的样本复杂度；针对t>1构造与算法上界匹配的下界；针对t=1（覆盖0<t<1）通过信息论下界分析其最优性。

Result: t>1时，Valiant算法达到总变差误差ε的样本复杂度为Õ(n^{⌈t⌉}/ε)，且存在匹配下界；t=1时，算法具有对数因子意义下最优的样本复杂度，信息论下界为Õ(n/ε)。

Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了Valiant算法在局部引理条件下的样本复杂度：t>1时上界与下界匹配，t=1时算法近似信息论最优。

Abstract: We revisit Valiant's algorithm (Commun. ACM'84) for learning $n$-variable CNF formulas with clause size $k$ and variable degree $d$ from i.i.d. uniform random solutions in the local lemma regime. For fixed $t\geq1$, under $k\gtrsim(1+1/t)\log d$, Valiant's algorithm achieves total variation error $\varepsilon$ with $\widetilde{O}(n^{\lceil t \rceil}/\varepsilon)$ sample complexity. For $t>1$, we prove a matching lower bound for Valiant's algorithm. At $t=1$ (covering $0<t<1$), we show Valiant's algorithm has optimal sample complexity up to logarithmic factors by an information-theoretic lower bound $\widetildeΩ(n/\varepsilon)$.

</details>


### [167] [Generative Interpretability via Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13529)
*Xiaocong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张将AI可解释性研究从"事后解释"转向"生成式可解释性"——一种架构属性，使模型推理过程原生地暴露语义上有意义、人类可理解且可进行因果干预的检查点，并以神经符号模型作为具体实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型从聊天机器人迈向智能体系统，模型输出演变为在现实世界中具有不可逆后果的行动。在此背景下，事后可解释性范式在结构上不足以支撑安全可信的模型部署：它只能在行为发生之后进行解释，无法在推理计算确定输出之前对其审计或干预。因此需要一种能在推理过程中进行干预的新范式。

Method: 这是一篇立场/观点类论文，方法为论证与范式对比：通过将"生成式可解释性"与其他可解释性研究范式进行对比，论证其优越性，并提出神经符号模型（Neuro-Symbolic Models）作为生成式可解释性的一个具体实例化方案。

Result: 论文论证了生成式可解释性相较于其他可解释性范式（尤其事后可解释性）的优势，并指出神经符号模型可作为其可落地的具体实现形式。摘要未给出实证或量化结果。

Conclusion: 面向具有现实后果的智能体系统，可解释性研究应转向"生成式可解释性"这一架构属性，使推理过程原生地提供可理解、可因果干预的检查点，从而支持安全与可信的部署；神经符号模型被提议为实现该范式的具体路径。

Abstract: As the use of Large Language Models moves from chatbots into agentic systems, where outputs become actions with irreversible consequences on reality, the existing paradigm on AI Interpretability research, post-hoc interpretability, is structurally inadequate for safe and trustworthy model deployment: it explains behavior after the fact but cannot audit or intervene in an inference computation before it commits to an output. We therefore argue for a shift toward \emph{generative interpretability}, an architectural property under which a model's inference pass natively exposes semantically meaningful checkpoints that are human-understandable and amenable to causal intervention. We show the merits of generative interpretability as comparison to other interpretability research paradigms, and propose Neuro-Symbolic Models as a concrete instantiation.

</details>


### [168] [Attention Is All You Need (to Avoid Spurious Oscillations)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13531)
*Jinyoung Jeong,Joseph B. Choi,Xinlun Cheng,H. S. Udaykumar,Sanghun Choi,Stephen S. Baek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种守恒的、固定网格有限体积格式，其中由CFL条件约束的注意力通量根据当前时间步所需的输运距离选择上游信息。在一维无粘Burgers输运上，学习到的通量在小步长下与传统方法一致，而在四倍大步长下仍能保持尖锐激波且每次更新仅需一个阶段。结果支持将注意力作为守恒大步长激波输运的可学习信息模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题：注意力机制能否在一次更新中把激波跨越多个网格单元移动而不破坏它。作者希望突破传统显式格式受CFL条件限制、大步长下激波易被抹平或产生振荡的瓶颈，并厘清通量选择与时间积分各自的贡献。

Method: 构建守恒的固定网格有限体积格式，采用受CFL条件约束的注意力通量，按当前时间步所需输运量自适应选择上游信息。以一维无粘Burgers输运作为核心机制测试，并设置对照：标准五阶WENO格式配合三阶SSP-RK3，以及受控的Forward Euler比较，以分离通量选择与时间积分的影响。进一步用二维标量Burgers输运和一维浅水系统检验该"守恒-尺度-选择"原则的可迁移性，并通过推理时干预和重训练消融实验分析机制。

Result: 学习到的通量在小步长（传统）区间保持可靠；时间步放大四倍时，仍能保持尖锐激波，且每次更新仅用一个阶段。注意力随局部输运范围向上游移动，并在激波附近变得更具选择性。推理时干预与重训练消融表明，输运尺度信息和状态相关选择对性能有直接贡献。二维标量Burgers及一维浅水系统的实验结果支持该原则可超出原始标量设定。

Conclusion: 结果支持将注意力视为一种用于守恒、大步长激波输运的可学习信息模板。当前局限在于候选可达范围有限，以及鲁棒性依赖于具体问题。

Abstract: Can attention move a shock across several cells in one update without breaking it? We develop a conservative, fixed grid finite-volume scheme in which a CFL-conditioned attention flux selects upstream information according to the transport required by the current time step. One-dimensional inviscid Burgers transport is used as the central mechanism test: the same learned flux remains reliable in the conventional small-step regime and, with a time step four times larger, preserves sharp shocks while using one stage per update. A standard fifth-order WENO scheme with third-order strong-stability-preserving Runge-Kutta time integration (WENO-5+SSP-RK3) is included alongside controlled Forward Euler comparisons to separate flux selection from time integration. The learned attention shifts upstream with the local transport reach and becomes more selective near shocks; inference-time interventions and retrained ablations show that transport-scale information and state-dependent selection contribute directly to performance. Directional two-dimensional scalar Burgers transport and the one-dimensional shallow-water system then test whether the conservation-scale-selection principle transfers beyond the original scalar setting. The results support attention as a learnable information stencil for conservative large-step shock transport, while identifying finite candidate reach and problem-dependent robustness as the present limits.

</details>


### [169] [Toward Optimal Switching Regret for Multi-Armed Bandits with Oblivious Adversary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13547)
*Mengxiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在对抗性多臂老虎机中研究切换遗憾（switching regret），证明存在单一算法在未知切换次数 $S$ 时对遗忘型对手达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ 的期望遗憾，解决了 Auer 等人 [2019b] 提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在对抗性多臂老虎机中，当比较序列的切换次数 $S$ 已知时，最优期望遗憾 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ 可由 [Auer et al., 2002] 获得。但当 $S$ 未知时，Marinov 与 Zimmert [2021] 证明在自适应对手下该保证不可能实现。如何在对遗忘型对手下、在 $S$ 未知时仍达到该最优遗憾，是一个未解决的开放问题。

Method: 提出一个单一算法：以较小学习率初始化的 fixed-share 学习器为主，配合二元区间（dyadic-interval）子程序，子程序使用随机化学习率与隐式探索来搜索局部改进；采用非均匀先验偏向主学习器，从而降低维护大量子程序的开销。当子程序相对主学习器积累足够改进时，主学习器学习率翻倍，以适配未知的比较器切换次数 $S$。

Result: 该单一算法对任意 $S$、在遗忘型对手下均达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ 的期望遗憾，解决了 Auer 等人 [2019b] 的开放问题。

Conclusion: 通过结合小学习率初始化的 fixed-share 学习器与基于随机化学习率和隐式探索的二元区间子程序，并利用非均匀先验控制开销，在 $S$ 未知且对手为遗忘型时实现了最优切换遗憾，填补了自适应对手下不可能性结果与已知 $S$ 情形之间的空白。

Abstract: We study switching regret in adversarial multi-armed bandits, where the learner competes with an arm sequence that changes at most $S$ times. When $S$ is known, an optimal expected regret of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ is obtainable [Auer et al., 2002]. However, when $S$ is unknown, Marinov and Zimmert [2021] show that this guarantee is impossible under an adaptive adversary. In this paper, we show that a single algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ expected regret for every $S$ against an oblivious adversary, resolving an open problem of Auer et al. [2019b]. Our algorithm combines a fixed-share learner initialized with a small learning rate and dyadic-interval subroutines that search for local improvements using randomized learning rates and implicit exploration. Importantly, a non-uniform prior favors following the main learner, keeping the cost of maintaining many subroutines small. When the subroutines accumulate sufficient improvement over the main learner, its learning rate doubles, allowing adaptation to the unknown number of comparator switches $S$.

</details>


### [170] [When Greedy Sampling Explores: KL-Regularized Contextual Bandits without Eluder-Dimension Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13564)
*Zichen Wang,Haoyang Hong,Huazheng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究KL正则化上下文bandit在奖励反馈与偏好反馈下的贪心采样算法，证明其可达到不显式依赖eluder维度的对数遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有理论通常认为贪心/采样类算法需要显式依赖eluder维度的复杂度代价，本文希望探究在KL正则化下贪心采样能否获得更优、与eluder维度无关的遗憾保证。

Method: 针对奖励反馈，设计直接从估计奖励诱导的Gibbs策略中采样的简单贪心算法；并将结果扩展到偏好反馈下的通用偏好模型与Bradley–Terry模型，同时改进已有的维度相关保证。分析中对比贪心采样与UCB式探索的权衡。

Result: 证明贪心采样可获得对数遗憾界且不显式依赖eluder维度；在偏好反馈下扩展了该保证并加强了维度相关结果；揭示了贪心采样与UCB式探索之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 当KL正则化足够强时，贪心采样具有更强保证；随着正则化减弱，额外的探索更为可取。

Abstract: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits under both reward and preference feedback. We show that greedy sampling can achieve logarithmic regret without explicit dependence on the eluder dimension. For reward feedback, we establish an eluder-dimension-independent regret bound for a simple greedy algorithm that directly samples from the Gibbs policy induced by the estimated reward. We further extend this result to preference feedback under both the general preference and Bradley--Terry models, while also sharpening existing dimension-dependent guarantees. Our analysis reveals a trade-off between greedy sampling and upper confidence bound-style exploration: greedy sampling enjoys stronger guarantees when KL regularization is sufficiently strong, whereas additional exploration becomes preferable as the regularization weakens.

</details>


### [171] [AttnFuse: A Composable DSL for Compiling Attentions to Fused GPU Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13612)
*Varun Kumar Dasoju,Tian Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AttnFuse：面向注意力的DSL编译器，将RoPE等乘前变换作为一等操作，编译为单个融合GPU内核，在RTX 3090上比flex_attention快2.10倍，在H100上接近PyTorch手写后端5%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的注意力机制占据主要计算与访存开销，研究者不断提出新变体，但每个变体需专家手写GPU代码才能达到可用速度。PyTorch的flex_attention支持用Python描述自定义注意力模式并编译为融合内核，但其设计局限于矩阵乘法之后的修改，无法涵盖所有主流LLM使用的RoPE（乘前变换）。

Method: 提出AttnFuse，一种小型注意力DSL，将RoPE等乘前变换作为一等操作。研究者组合十种高层构建块描述变体，编译器为整个计算生成单个融合GPU内核。

Result: 在RTX 3090上，AttnFuse在RoPE+因果模式上比flex_attention取得2.10倍加速；在H100上，完整Llama-3-8B训练步的性能与PyTorch手工调优后端差距在5%以内。研究揭示“旋转微积分”（Rotation Calculus）：是否融合RoPE或单独应用取决于GPU的计算带宽比，推导出的交叉点与实测相符。

Conclusion: AttnFuse表明，小型、注意力专用的编译器能够弥合灵活研究代码与生产级内核之间的差距。

Abstract: Modern AI systems are built on the Transformer architecture, whose core operation, attention, accounts for the majority of computation and memory cost. Researchers continually propose new attention variants to improve quality, efficiency, or context length, but each variant currently requires expert-written GPU code to run at usable speeds. PyTorch's recent flex\_attention lets researchers describe custom attention patterns in Python and compile them to fused kernels, but its design is limited to modifications applied after the central matrix multiplication, excluding Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), the positional encoding used by every major LLM.
  We introduce AttnFuse, a small DSL for attention that makes pre-multiplication transformations like RoPE first-class operations. Researchers compose ten high-level building blocks to describe a variant, and AttnFuse's compiler emits a single fused GPU kernel for the entire computation. On an RTX 3090, AttnFuse achieves a 2.10$\times$ speedup over flex\_attention on the RoPE+causal pattern. On an H100, it runs a full Llama-3-8B training step within 5\% of PyTorch's hand-tuned backend. Our investigation reveals the Rotation Calculus: whether to fuse RoPE or apply it separately depends on the GPU's compute-to-bandwidth ratio, with a derived crossover that matches measurement. AttnFuse demonstrates that a small, attention-specific compiler can close the gap between flexible research code and production kernels.

</details>


### [172] [An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13624)
*Roberto Campbell,Momin Abbass,Muneeza Azmat,Michal Ulewicz,Raya Horesh,Kristjan Greenewald,Rogério Abreu de Paula,Nathalie Baracaldo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种模块化纠错框架，用 Activated LoRA 适配器与上下文感知路由机制，在生成过程中实时修正 LLM 的不对齐输出，提升安全性同时保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐方法成本高且与模型紧耦合，缺乏灵活性和可扩展性；LLM 作为零样本学习器仍易产生偏见、毒性等有害输出。

Method: 为预训练 LLM 增加 Activated LoRA（aLoRA）适配器与上下文感知路由。专家适配器可在序列中间激活而不失效 KV cache，实现低延迟的定向生成中修正；每个专家针对特定危害（如偏见、毒性）训练；学习到的路由器依据模型中间输出动态选择专家。

Result: 在标准安全基准上改善了对齐效果，同时保留了任务性能。

Conclusion: 该框架为更安全、更可控的 LLM 部署提供了一条轻量高效的路径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot learners but remain prone to misalignment with human preferences, often producing biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs. Existing alignment methods, while effective, are costly and tightly coupled to the model, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose a modular correction framework that augments pretrained LLMs with Activated LoRA (aLoRA) adapters and a context-aware routing mechanism to eliminate harms from misaligned model responses. Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.

</details>


### [173] [FlowTSFM: Turning Encoder Depth into Quantile Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13640)
*Bahaeddine Abdessalem,Shifeng Xie,Zehao Xiao,Youssef Attia El Hili,Ambroise Odonnat,Jianfeng Zhang,Lujia Pan,Keli Zhang,Malik Tiomoko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowTSFM将编码器深度视为循环式输运过程，用共享参数的单一Transformer块迭代执行，并以分位数流目标监督中间状态，在仅38.8M参数下取得与更强基线相近的精度，同时提出CosMean诊断指标衡量循环更新的预测对齐度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于编码器的时间序列基础模型通常堆叠多个独立参数化的Transformer层，仅对最终预测进行监督，中间表示不具备显式预测作用，导致参数冗余且中间层预测结构未被利用。

Method: 提出FlowTSFM：把网络深度理解为从先验分布到最终预测的循环输运过程，反复应用同一个共享参数的Transformer块；训练目标为分位数流目标，即pinball分位数预测损失与路径级位置匹配损失相结合，从而对中间状态沿预定轨迹进行监督。同时提出尺度无关的诊断指标CosMean，用于衡量循环更新是否持续朝向最终预测方向对齐。

Result: FlowTSFM仅38.8M参数，在GIFT-Eval与TIME基准上性能具有竞争力，MASE与更强基线相差在1.8–4.6%以内，而参数约为12层Chronos-2（119.5M）的1/3。在匹配的中间状态探针协议下，CosMean得分为0.919，Chronos-2仅为0.350。

Conclusion: 循环式参数共享结合路径级监督，能够在更优的精度-效率权衡下产生结构显著更强的预测轨迹；CosMean等诊断指标为分析中间表示的预测性提供了尺度无关的手段。

Abstract: Encoder-based time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically rely on deep stacks of independently parameterized Transformer layers, where only the final forecast is supervised and intermediate representations have no explicit predictive role. We introduce FlowTSFM, an encoder architecture that interprets depth as a recurrent transport process: a single Transformer block is iteratively applied with shared parameters, while a quantile-flow objective supervises intermediate states along a prescribed trajectory from a prior distribution toward the final forecast. The objective combines pinball forecasting loss with path-level position matching. With only 38.8M parameters, FlowTSFM achieves competitive performance on GIFT-Eval and TIME, remaining within 1.8-4.6% MASE of stronger baselines while using approximately $3\times$ fewer parameters than a 12-layer Chronos-2 model (119.5M). Beyond accuracy, we introduce CosMean, a scale-free diagnostic measuring whether recurrent updates consistently align toward the final prediction. Under a matched intermediate-state probing protocol, FlowTSFM achieves a CosMean score of 0.919 compared with 0.350 for Chronos-2, suggesting that recurrent parameter sharing combined with path supervision is associated with substantially more structured predictive trajectories at a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [174] [When Compliance Data Masquerades as Evaluation: Measurement Validity for Deployed AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13642)
*Hung-Yu Lin,Xingran Huang,Qiming Guo,Jinwen Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，将用于运营监测或合规报告的数据当作比较性评估数据来解读，是已部署AI系统评估中的常见错误。作者以自动驾驶为例，提出"测量效度"问题，并构建"评估契约"框架，明确比较性结论所需的对齐假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署AI系统的运营监测与合规数据常被直接用于比较不同系统或版本的安全性能，但这类数据并未按比较评估目的设计。作者希望揭示这一普遍性误区，并说明自动驾驶领域是典型而非特例，需要从AI评估方法论层面加以纠正。

Method: 作者采用概念分析与案例研究相结合的方式：以美国自动驾驶"脱离接管（disengagement）"报告和碰撞报告制度为案例，剖析报告范围、暴露量、部署域、事件捕获方式及比较对象构建等方面的差异如何限制安全结论；进而提出"评估契约"（evaluation contract）框架，要求在任何运营数据被解释为比较性证据之前，显式声明意图能力、测量结果、暴露机会、部署域、数据生成过程与评估比较对象之间的对齐关系。

Result: 分析表明，美国脱离接管与碰撞报告体系虽能提供有价值的运营证据，但由于报告范围、暴露量、部署域、事件捕获和比较对象构建的不一致，仅凭这些测量无法支持可靠的比较性安全论断。作者将该现象界定为AI评估中的测量效度问题，而非交通领域特有的数据局限。

Conclusion: 对已部署AI系统的比较性论断，必须实现预期能力、测量结果、暴露机会、部署域、数据生成过程与评估比较对象六者之间的对齐。监测用数据并不自动构成有效的评估基准；通过"评估契约"显式化这些假设，可避免将运营数据误用为性能比较证据，该结论可推广至自动驾驶之外的其他AI部署场景。

Abstract: We argue that a recurring failure in the evaluation of deployed AI systems occurs when data collected for operational monitoring or regulatory compliance are interpreted as if they were designed for comparative evaluation. Automated driving provides a concrete example of this problem. U.S. disengagement and crash-reporting regimes produce valuable operational evidence, but differences in reporting scope, exposure, deployment domain, event capture, and comparator construction limit the safety claims that can be supported from these measurements alone. We frame this issue as a measurement-validity problem in AI evaluation rather than as a transportation-specific data limitation. We argue that comparative claims about deployed AI systems require alignment between the intended capability, measured outcome, exposure opportunity, deployment domain, data-generation process, and evaluation comparator. Using automated-driving safety evaluation as a case study, we propose an evaluation contract that makes these assumptions explicit before operational data are interpreted as evidence of comparative performance. The broader implication is that data useful for monitoring deployed AI systems are not automatically valid benchmarks for evaluating them.

</details>


### [175] [Curvature-Independent Regret Bounds for Distributed Online Optimization on Hadamard Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13646)
*Zhanyuan Cai,Emre Sahinoglu,Shahin Shahrampour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Hadamard流形上的去中心化在线黎曼优化，针对horospherical凸（h-convex）函数类，提出D-ROGD算法，结合局部黎曼h-次梯度更新与隐式Fréchet均值共识，实现了与曲率无关的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有基于测地凸性（g-convexity）的工作通常需要在优化分析中引入曲率信息（如截面曲率的下界），曲率还可能进入步长或切空间黎曼共识方案的收缩因子，限制了算法的适用性与分析简洁性。本文希望放宽这种曲率依赖。

Method: 研究分布式黎曼在线梯度下降（D-ROGD）算法，将局部的黎曼h-次梯度更新与隐式Fréchet均值共识相结合，面向更窄的h-convex函数类进行分析。

Result: 对h-convex与强h-convex局部目标，分别建立了O(√T)与O(log T)的静态遗憾，与欧氏情形关于T的速率相匹配，且网络依赖仅由谱隙（spectral gap）决定。据作者所知，这是Hadamard流形上去中心化在线优化首个与曲率无关的遗憾保证。在双曲嵌入上的实验验证了预测速率，未观察到由曲率导致的性能退化。

Conclusion: 通过限制到h-convex函数类，可在Hadamard流形的去中心化在线优化中获得曲率无关的遗憾界，网络拓扑影响仅通过谱隙体现，理论与实验均支持该结论。

Abstract: This work addresses decentralized online Riemannian optimization on Hadamard manifolds. Prior work under geodesic convexity (g-convexity) may require curvature information in the optimization analysis, typically through a finite lower bound on the sectional curvature. Curvature may also enter the step size or contraction factor of tangent-space Riemannian consensus schemes. In this work, we relax the curvature dependence for a narrower class of horospherical convex (h-convex) functions. We study Distributed Riemannian Online Gradient Descent (D-ROGD), which combines local Riemannian h-subgradient updates with an implicit Fréchet-mean consensus. For h-convex and strongly h-convex local objectives, we establish $O(\sqrt{T})$ and $O(\log T)$ static regret, respectively, matching the corresponding Euclidean rates with respect to $T$, with network dependence governed solely by the spectral gap. To our knowledge, these are the first curvature-independent regret guarantees for decentralized online optimization on Hadamard manifolds. Experiments on hyperbolic embeddings corroborate the predicted rates, with no observable degradation due to curvature.

</details>


### [176] [Online Bayesian Node Classification on Inductive Graphs under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13655)
*Jinwen Xu,Gonzalo Mateos Buckstein,Qin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对动态图上节点分类需兼具归纳泛化与校准不确定性的问题，提出在线变分贝叶斯末层模型（online GVBLL）：以变分目标联合训练编码器与末层近似后验，测试时冻结编码器并用在线拉普拉斯更新末层后验，在五个分布偏移基准上同时取得最优精度与负对数似然。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 演化图上的节点分类器需满足两点：在分布偏移下对新到达节点具备归纳泛化能力，并为安全敏感应用提供校准的不确定性。标准GNN只训练一次，两者均不满足。贝叶斯末层（BLL）虽可用于不确定性量化，但分类所需的类别softmax似然破坏高斯共轭性，导致训练后验与测试时流式更新均无闭式解。

Method: 在确定性GNN编码器之上放置随机的末层参数构建BLL。针对softmax似然破坏共轭性的问题，提出变分贝叶斯末层（VBLL）目标：通过最大化证据下界（ELBO），并以蒙特卡洛期望对数似然估计，联合训练编码器与末层近似后验。测试阶段冻结编码器，对末层后验施加在线拉普拉斯更新，该更新等价于带指数遗忘与对训练后验的KL锚定的幂先验贝叶斯模型。

Result: 在五个分布偏移下的节点分类基准上，online GVBLL是唯一在每个数据集上都同时取得最优精度与负对数似然的方法。相比最强的非GVBLL基线，Cora精度提升最多17个百分点，ogbn-arxiv提升最多14个百分点；在Cora与ogbn-arxiv上较最强非GVBLL基线的精度提升分别达17与14个百分点，同时在校准方面与MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles、Temperature Scaling及高斯过程分类器保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 将变分贝叶斯末层与在线拉普拉斯更新相结合，可在演化图上同时实现归纳泛化与校准不确定性；online GVBLL在精度与不确定性质量上一致优于现有基线，验证了末层贝叶斯化加在线更新的有效性。

Abstract: On evolving graphs, node classifiers must satisfy two key requirements: inductive generalization to newly arriving nodes under distribution shift and calibrated uncertainty for safety-sensitive applications. Standard graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically trained once and address neither requirement. We adapt the Bayesian last-layer (BLL) model by placing random last-layer parameters on top of a deterministic GNN encoder for uncertainty quantification. The categorical softmax likelihood required for classification breaks Gaussian conjugacy, so neither the training posterior nor the test-time streaming update has a closed-form solution. To address both challenges, we introduce a variational Bayesian last-layer (VBLL) objective that jointly trains the encoder and an approximate last-layer posterior by maximizing an evidence lower bound with a Monte Carlo expected log-likelihood. At test time, we freeze the encoder and apply an online Laplace update to the last-layer posterior. This update corresponds to a power-prior Bayesian model with exponential forgetting and a Kullback-Leibler anchor to the training posterior. Across five node-classification benchmarks under distribution shift, online GVBLL is the only method to achieve the best accuracy and negative log-likelihood on every dataset. It improves accuracy by up to 17 percentage points on Cora and 14 percentage points on ogbn-arxiv over the strongest non-GVBLL baseline, while remaining competitive in calibration with MC Dropout, Deep Ensembles, Temperature Scaling, and Gaussian-process classifiers.

</details>


### [177] [Leakage-Safe and Scheduler-Aware Machine Learning for Grid Job Runtime Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13701)
*Ashfaq Ali Shafin,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在GWA-T-4 AuverGrid负载轨迹上重新审视CPU突发时间预测，将其重构为无泄漏的执行前作业运行时预测，并在时间与冷启动设定下评估模型；经时间验证调参后CatBoost取得最佳部署导向结果（R²=0.239），调度仿真显示预测驱动的SJF相比FCFS降低平均等待时间50.92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的作业运行时预测可改善网格与分布式计算环境中的调度感知资源管理，但现有预测模型往往在非现实的评估设定下被评估。随机交叉验证会因数据泄漏而高估性能，且缺乏对部署约束（仅可用提交时刻信息、时间漂移、冷启动）的考察，因此需要一种无泄漏、面向真实部署的评估框架。

Method: 1) 将任务重构为作业级运行时的无泄漏执行前预测：目标为作业级运行时，仅使用提交时刻属性，排除执行后变量。2) 在时间切分与冷启动设定下评估，而非仅用随机交叉验证。3) 对比标准回归器、按时间顺序的历史基线、类别编码策略，以及具备原生类别处理能力的CatBoost。4) 补充时间维度的超参数调优、运行时可预测性分析、特征消融、按作业长度的误差分析，以及一个最小化调度仿真。

Result: 经时间验证调参后，CatBoost取得最强的部署导向结果：在留出的时间测试集上R²=0.239、MAE=27,019、RMSE=46,587、LogMAE=2.646。在全部69,523个留出时间测试作业上的单服务器仿真表明，预测驱动的SJF相比FCFS将平均等待时间降低50.92%。

Conclusion: 结果表明：随机划分评估会高估性能；类别原生提升方法（CatBoost）能改善时间泛化能力；长作业的低估仍是调度器相关的重要挑战。

Abstract: Accurate job runtime prediction can improve scheduling-aware resource management in grid and distributed computing environments, but prediction models must be evaluated under realistic deployment constraints. This paper revisits CPU burst time prediction on the GWA-T-4 AuverGrid workload trace and reformulates it as leakage-safe pre-execution job runtime prediction. We define the target as job-level runtime, use only submission-time attributes, exclude post-execution variables, and evaluate models under temporal and cold-start settings rather than relying only on random cross-validation. We compare standard regressors, chronological historical baselines, categorical encoding strategies, and CatBoost with native categorical handling. We further add temporal hyperparameter tuning, runtime predictability analysis, feature ablation, error analysis by job length, and a minimal scheduling simulation. After temporal-validation tuning, CatBoost achieves the strongest deployment-oriented result with R^2=0.239, MAE=27,019, RMSE=46,587, and LogMAE=2.646 on the held-out temporal test set. A single-server simulation over all 69,523 held-out temporal test jobs shows that prediction-informed SJF reduces average waiting time by 50.92% relative to FCFS. The results show that random-split evaluation overestimates performance, categorical-native boosting improves temporal generalization, and long-job underestimation remains a scheduler-relevant challenge.

</details>


### [178] [Certifying Model Upgrades with Slice-Wise Non-Regression and Incumbent Fallback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13714)
*Shengwei Zhang,Tao Wu,Fei Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究在相对保留基线（incumbent）满足非劣性（non-regression）容差前提下的检查点选择问题，区分"未检测到伤害"与"认证非劣性"，提出可复现的发布流程并给出有限样本保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更新后的模型可能提升总体指标却损害下游用户关心的特定切片（slice）。核心动机是区分"未能检测到伤害"（fail to detect harm）与"认证非劣性"（certifying non-inferiority）：在评估有噪声时，前者可能以高概率发布有害更新。

Method: 提出可复现的发布流程，将候选搜索与独立的配对评估分离，认证失败时返回原incumbent。基于intersection-union与Learn-then-Test原则，给出三种场景的有限样本保证：单个冻结候选、有限候选库、预先指定的检验顺序。论证联合发布决策无需slice数量的Bonferroni惩罚。

Result: 在bounded-score模拟中，32-slice设置下"未检测到伤害"门控在99.7%的试验中发布有害候选，而精确非劣性门控在5%目标下仅2.6%。构造的两块（two-block）族在匹配候选数下比标量路径获得更大的认证效用。公开digits实验中（含后续提升平均准确率的延续实验），因认证power不足，每次均返回incumbent。

Conclusion: 结果确立了可审计的协议及其局限性；但未证实在基础模型或多语言翻译升级上的收益。

Abstract: An updated model can improve an aggregate metric while degrading a slice that matters to a downstream user. We study checkpoint selection subject to non-regression tolerances relative to a retained incumbent. The central distinction is between failing to detect harm and certifying non-inferiority: the former can release harmful updates with high probability when evaluation is noisy. We give a reproducible release procedure that separates candidate search from independent, paired evaluation and returns the exact incumbent when certification fails. Applying established intersection-union and Learn-then-Test principles, we state finite-sample guarantees for one frozen candidate, a finite candidate library, and a prespecified testing order. A joint release decision does not require a slice-count Bonferroni penalty, although certification power can still decrease with the number of slices. In bounded-score simulations, a no-detected-harm gate releases a harmful candidate in 99.7% of trials in one 32-slice setting, compared with 2.6% for an exact non-inferiority gate at a 5% target. A constructed two-block family yields larger certified utility than a scalar path under matched candidate counts. Public digits experiments, including a subsequent continuation that improves average aggregate accuracy, return the incumbent in every run because certification is underpowered. These results establish an auditable protocol and its limitations; they do not establish benefits on foundation-model or multilingual translation upgrades.

</details>


### [179] [A Variational Optimal Transport Operator on Incompressible Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13729)
*Jinjin He,Shenyifan Lu,Sinan Wang,Zhiqi Li,Duowen Chen,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 VIOT，一种用于摊销式不可压缩密度输运的生成式神经算子，可前馈预测无散度速度场并生成完整输运轨迹，比逐对优化基线快约 10^4 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统不可压缩输运依赖伴随流体求解器或可微模拟，需对每一对源-目标密度从头优化，耗时约一小时，无法实时复用。作者希望将不可压缩输运转化为可跨密度对和网格分辨率复用的神经算子。

Method: VIOT 由三部分组成：(1) 流函数/矢量势表示，从构造上保证无散度；(2) 正则化不可压缩输运目标，平衡端点精度与流场平滑度；(3) Fourier Neural Operator 骨干，将求解摊销到新密度对和不同网格分辨率上。

Result: 在 2D 和 3D 密度输运基准上验证：2D 与 3D rollout 每对仅需数秒，而 2D 对比中逐实例基线需约一小时，在线加速约 10^4 倍。系统还支持用户手绘源-目标对的实时交互式生成，并可泛化到训练分布之外。

Conclusion: VIOT 将不可压缩输运变为可复用的神经算子，支持实时交互与分布外泛化，为多种输运过程提供高效生成式求解方案。

Abstract: We present the Variational Incompressible Optimal Transport (VIOT) operator, a generative neural operator for amortized incompressible density transport. Given a new source-target density pair, VIOT predicts a divergence-free velocity field and generates the full transport trajectory by feed-forward inference, replacing the hour-scale per-pair optimization used by adjoint fluid solvers and differentiable simulation baselines. The system consists of three components: a stream-function or vector-potential representation that enforces incompressibility by construction, a regularized incompressible transport objective that balances endpoint accuracy and flow smoothness, and a Fourier Neural Operator backbone that amortizes the solve across new pairs and grid resolutions. Together, these components make incompressible transport a reusable neural operator that facilitates various transport processes. Further, the generative capability extends beyond the training distribution, with VIOT producing incompressible transports for user-drawn source-target pairs in a real-time interactive system. We demonstrate VIOT on 2D and 3D density-transport benchmarks. Both 2D and 3D rollouts complete in seconds per pair, while per-instance baselines in our 2D comparisons optimize each new pair from scratch and require on the order of an hour, a roughly $10^4\times$ online speedup.

</details>


### [180] [JumpStart Your Policy Learning with Lessons from 160,000 Training Runs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13730)
*Nabil Omi,Eric Bae,Chung Yik Edward Yeung,Siddhartha Sen,Ali Farhadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对离线强化学习与模仿学习进行大规模实证研究，训练了16万余个策略、覆盖114个数据集，发现无算法能全面占优，超参调优与基准构成会显著改变结论，并提出默认配置推导策略、数据集条件化推荐器及资源套件JumpStart。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线策略学习的可靠进展依赖严谨的报告方式、良好调优的基线以及跨多样条件的评测。已有工作表明结果对报告选择、超参调优和数据集属性敏感，但缺乏足够规模的系统性联合考察来理解这些变异来源如何影响结论。

Method: 开展大规模实证研究：在114个数据集上训练超过160,000个离线强化学习与模仿学习策略；系统分析超参调优、基准构成、超参敏感性与跨环境迁移；基于发现构建数据集条件化的算法推荐器；并发布包含全部模型、分数、超参、基线、代码与可扩展网站的资源套件JumpStart。

Result: 在此规模下没有算法能够全面占优：最强方法间的总体性能往往接近，但领先者随环境差异显著变化。恰当的超参调优会频繁改变算法排名感知，基准构成可导致相互冲突的结论。研究还识别出推导强默认配置的简单策略，并构建出可给出任务特定算法推荐的数据集条件化推荐器。

Conclusion: 离线策略学习结论对调优与评测设计高度敏感，需谨慎报告与跨多样条件评测。所发布的JumpStart资源套件（含全部策略、逐模型分数与超参、强基线、代码及可扩展网站）旨在提升该领域研究的可靠性，并支撑超出本研究范围的后续工作。

Abstract: Reliable progress in offline policy learning depends on careful reporting, well-tuned baselines, and evaluation across diverse conditions. Prior work has shown that results can be sensitive to reporting choices, hyperparameter tuning, and dataset properties, but these sources of variability have not been systematically investigated together at the scale needed to understand how they shape conclusions. To address this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of offline reinforcement and imitation learning, training over 160,000 policies across 114 datasets. At this scale, no algorithm dominates: aggregate performance among the strongest methods is often close, but the leaders differ substantially across environments. We find that proper hyperparameter tuning frequently reshuffles perceived algorithm rankings and that benchmark composition can produce conflicting conclusions. We also study hyperparameter sensitivity and transfer across environments, identifying a simple strategy for deriving strong default configurations. We use our findings to develop a dataset-conditioned recommender that provides task-specific algorithm recommendations for practitioners. Finally, we release JumpStart: a resource suite containing every trained policy, per-model scores and hyperparameters, strong baselines across all environments, training and evaluation code, and an extensible website for retrieving, analyzing, and contributing results. Together, these resources aim to make offline policy-learning research more reliable and enable future work beyond the scope of this study.

</details>


### [181] [HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13739)
*Hongliang Wei,Xiaobing Tu,Yinggui Wang,Zhengxi Liu,Rongkun Xue,Jinkui Ren,Xiantao Zhang,Debin Zhao,Xiaopeng Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessBandit，一种在线调度器，在每个优化器步选择一个 harness 进行训练，通过融合可学习性与可迁移性信号，提升语言模型智能体对 harness 变化的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体通过多样的 harness（系统提示、工具模式、控制循环、轨迹格式各异）部署，同一模型在不同接口下表现不均，因此对 harness 变化的鲁棒性成为重要目标。多 harness 联合训练虽可行，但引入调度问题：每步应偏向当前能提供有用学习信号、同时其更新又能惠及其他 harness 的 harness。

Method: 提出 HarnessBandit 在线调度器，每步选择一个 harness。在 GRPO 更新后观测两个信号：可学习性（批上平均绝对优势）与可迁移性（当前 harness 的低维梯度草图与其余 harness 指数移动平均之间的余弦相似度）。两信号经池化滑动窗口 min-max 归一化后融合，并以访问依赖奖励和显式探索下限进行采样。

Result: 在 ClawGym 上跨六个 harness 训练 Qwen3.5-2B，并在 PinchBench（留出任务、分布内 OpenClaw）与 ClawEval（留出任务与 harness）上评估。HarnessBandit 在两个基准上均优于混合批次多 harness 训练；训练诊断表明可学习性与可迁移性提供相互独立且动态演化的信号。

Conclusion: 融合可学习性与可迁移性的在线 harness 调度能有效提升多 harness 智能体训练的泛化能力，且两类信号具有互补性。

Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.

</details>


### [182] [Training Specialist Models without Reasoning Trajectories for Domain Expert Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13770)
*Yilei Tu,Zihao Li,Shaoxiong Ji,Jörg Tiedemann,Fei Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将学生蒸馏作为"无关探针"来观测专家模型在无推理监督下隐式选择的潜在轨迹分布，发现专家的特化-泛化轮廓与其蒸馏学生高度相关，且可通过控制专家分布漂移来系统调节这一权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家蒸馏依赖教师生成的推理轨迹传递领域知识，但当专家仅用问答对训练、缺乏显式推理监督时，其生成轨迹的机制不明；作者希望揭示是什么在支配这些轨迹的生成及其对下游学生的影响。

Method: 将学生蒸馏重新定位为一种"无关探针"——学生不继承教师的参数化或优化约束，仅继承采样出的轨迹；通过27组专家-学生对进行实证分析，并显式控制专家的分布漂移（distributional drift）来观察教师与学生的特化-泛化轮廓变化。

Result: 27组配对中专家与学生的特化-泛化轮廓呈异常强的相关性；显式控制专家分布漂移可系统性地同时移动教师及其蒸馏学生在领域精度与通用能力保留之间的权衡；在化学、物理和多语言场景下，即使跨不同模型家族，蒸馏学生也系统反映专家诱导的轮廓。

Conclusion: 在缺乏黄金推理（gold reasoning）时，专家训练的调参选择直接控制传递给下游模型的潜在监督；这为专家训练提供了新视角，即专家优化本质上是在潜在轨迹空间中进行隐式选择。

Abstract: Specialist distillation effectively transfers domain expertise to student models via teacher-generated reasoning trajectories. However, when these specialists are trained solely on question--answer pairs without explicit reasoning supervision, what governs the trajectories they generate? In this work, we show that specialist optimization implicitly selects from this latent trajectory space. To isolate and observe this latent distribution, we leverage student distillation not as a downstream goal, but as an agnostic probe---since students inherit no parameterization or optimization constraints from the specialist, inheriting only the sampled trajectories themselves. Through this probe, our empirical analysis unveils a tight governing relationship: across 27 specialist--student pairings, their specialization--generalization profiles correlate exceptionally strongly. Crucially, explicitly controlling the specialist's distributional drift systematically shifts both the teacher and its distilled student along a controllable trade-off between domain precision and general-capability retention. Across chemistry, physics, and multilingual settings, distilled students systematically reflect these specialist-induced profiles, even across divergent model families. Our findings establish a new view of specialist training: when gold reasoning is absent, tuning choices directly control the latent supervision passed to downstream models.

</details>


### [183] [Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13773)
*Ruichen Zheng,Yihe Wang,Fabrice Y Harel-Canada,Sara Khosravi,Zeynep Senahan Yildiz,Amit Sahai,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了LLM-as-a-Judge评价器的部署有效性失效模式：在开发集上与人类评分相关性较高（ρ=0.646）的评委，在分布偏移的盲测配对比较中与人类偏好严重脱节——人类读者间一致性近乎随机（α=0.070）且无普遍推理优势，而评委在89.0%维度比较中系统偏好推理输出，并与句长、词汇多样性等表层特征相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge被越来越广泛地用于开放式生成评分，但其在开发集上与人类评分的相关性未必能保证在输出质量接近、人类偏好高度主观的新分布上仍然有效。作者希望以心理学深度（psychological depth）这一主观构念为切入口，检验评委的"开发集表现"是否有资格作为"部署有效性"的证据。

Method: 1) 沿用原始标量《心理深度量表》（PDS）数据集，选出与人类评分相关性达ρ=0.646的LLM评委集成；2) 构造60对盲测、提示匹配的故事对：GPT-5 vs GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1 vs DeepSeek-V3；3) 由7名人类读者与LLM评委对同一批配对进行评价；4) 采用Krippendorff's α测量读者间信度，并考察读者内一致性与加权模式；5) 检验评委偏好是否与句长、词汇多样性等表层文本特征相关，并在5种评估器配置下重复验证。

Result: 人类偏好不存在普遍的"推理优势"：GPT-5相对GPT-4o仅获温和偏好（60.0–62.9%），而DeepSeek-R1反而落后于DeepSeek-V3（42.9%）；读者间一致性接近随机（Krippendorff's α=0.070），但读者内一致性与反复出现的加权模式表明这是结构性异质而非随机作答。评委则相反：在89.0%的维度级比较中偏好推理输出，在聚合PDS上60对中有59对偏好推理输出，且该偏好在全部5种评估器配置下保持一致；评委分数与句长、词汇多样性等表层特征相关。

Conclusion: 开发集上的性能不足以作为分布偏移下部署有效性的证据；点估计式评委（point-estimate judges）会掩盖主观人类评价中的异质性，需要以更细致的方式刻画评价者间的分歧与结构性差异。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators are increasingly used to score open-ended generation, yet a judge's correlation with human ratings on its development set may not guarantee valid measurement when outputs are closely matched and human preferences are subjective. We study this failure mode through psychological depth in short stories. Seven human readers and an LLM-judge ensemble selected on the original scalar Psychological Depth Scale dataset ($ρ= 0.646$) evaluated 60 blinded, prompt-matched story pairs from GPT-5 vs.\ GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 vs.\ DeepSeek-V3. Human preferences showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was modestly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0--62.9\%), whereas DeepSeek-R1 trailed V3 (42.9\%), and inter-reader agreement was near chance (Krippendorff's $α= 0.070$), with within-reader consistency and recurring weighting patterns suggesting structured heterogeneity rather than random responding. The judge, by contrast, favored reasoning outputs in 89.0\% of dimension-level comparisons and 59 of 60 pairs on aggregate PDS, uniformly across all five evaluator configurations, and its scores were associated with surface features such as sentence length and lexical diversity. These results suggest that development-set performance is insufficient evidence for deployment validity on a shifted distribution, and that point-estimate judges can obscure the heterogeneity in subjective human evaluation.

</details>


### [184] [PPDL: A Real-world Industrial User Retention Ratio Forecasting Framework Integrating Physical Priors with Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13789)
*Zibo Zhao,Zhengxiong Guan,Chaoli Zhang,Linyuan Geng,Xuanbing Zhu,Zhonglong Zheng,Fan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出PPDL框架，将物理先验（Weibull分布）与深度学习结合，用于多通道付费获客场景下的用户留存率预测，在工业级数据集上显著优于现有线上方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多头付费获客中，通道级别的早期、准确留存预测对预算分配优化至关重要。留存曲线呈现“先高流失后长期稳定”的时间模式，并伴有季节性波动和高序列自相关，适合用时间序列框架建模。但在大规模短视频平台上，预测留存率面临三大挑战：通道间显著异质性、衰减后饱和的全局趋势、以及短回看窗口。

Method: PPDL框架包含三部分：（1）趋势-残差分解组件，趋势项用Weibull分布建模，其参数由多层感知机（MLP）学习；（2）针对残差项，在深度学习骨干上设计辅助嵌入模块以保持通道身份感知；（3）设计多尺度趋势惩罚损失函数以增强模型对趋势的敏感性。

Result: 在工业级数据集上开展全面实验，覆盖三个应用、每个应用平均30+通道。结果显示PPDL在不同骨干网络上均取得提升，并显著优于现有线上解决方案。

Conclusion: 将物理先验（Weibull趋势分解）与深度学习及通道感知嵌入、趋势惩罚损失相结合，可有效应对通道异质性、饱和趋势和短窗口挑战，提升通道级留存预测效果，具备工业落地价值。

Abstract: In multi-channel paid user acquisition, early and accurate prediction of user retention at the channel level is crucial for optimizing budget allocation. User retention curves display a pronounced temporal pattern: an initial period of high churn transitions into long-term stability. This pattern is further characterized by regular fluctuations attributable to seasonality and exhibits high serial autocorrelation. These intrinsic properties make such curves highly suitable for analysis within a time-series forecasting framework. However, forecasting user retention ratio for large-scale short-video platform faces three major challenges: significant heterogeneity across channels, pronounced global trend of decay followed by saturation, and short look-back windows. To address these challenges, we propose PPDL, a novel forecasting framework that integrates physical priors with deep learning. We first introduce a trend-residual decomposition component. The trend is modeled using the Weibull distribution, whose parameters are learned via a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). Secondly, for the residual component, we design an auxiliary embedding module on top of a deep learning backbone to maintain the channel identity awareness. Finally, to enhance the model's sensitivity to trends, we design a Multiscale Trend-penalized loss function. The proposed approach PPDL is validated through comprehensive experiments on industrial-scale datasets, covering three applications with an average of 30+ channels each. Experimental results show that PPDL achieves improvements across different backbones and significantly outperforms existing online solutions.

</details>


### [185] [Benchmarking Optimizers to Solve Inverse Problems with Differentiable Physics Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13819)
*Xiang Chen,Huanhuan Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建12个可微物理模拟器，设计涵盖参数辨识、逆设计与最优控制的逆问题，系统基准测试一阶、近似二阶及全局优化器的性能，为可微编程优化器选择与设计提供洞见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微物理模拟器结合了物理模拟器的严格物理正确性与自动微分、梯度优化的高效性，有望推动科学发现与工程设计。但当前该范式在优化性能上存在问题，亟需系统基准以指导优化器选择与设计。

Method: 构建覆盖离散力学、连续力学、原子模拟、渲染和半经验物理模型等物理领域的12个可微物理模拟器；基于这些模拟器设计可归类为参数辨识、逆设计和最优控制的逆问题；在这些问题上对常规一阶方法、近似二阶方法以及全局优化器进行大量对比实验并分析结果。

Result: 通过大量实验对比不同优化器（一阶方法、近似二阶方法、全局优化器）在上述逆问题上的性能，并对结果进行分析，得出了关于如何为可微编程选择和设计优化器的洞见。

Conclusion: 期望该基准能启发更有效优化器的开发，并进一步推动可微编程在科学与工程各领域的应用。

Abstract: Solving inverse problems with differentiable physics simulators holds the potential to revolutionize scientific discovery and engineering design, as it enjoys both the strict physical correctness from rigorous numerical physics simulators, and the high efficiency and effectiveness from automatic differentiation and gradient-based optimization. However, currently, this paradigm faces performance issues in optimization. In this work, we target benchmarking the performance of different optimizers to solve various inverse problems. We construct 12 differentiable physics simulators spanning physics domains including discrete mechanics, continuous mechanics, atomistic simulations, rendering, and semi-empirical physics models. Based on these simulators, we design corresponding inverse problems that can be categorized into parameter identification, inverse design, and optimal control. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments to compare the performance of different optimizers, including regular first-order methods, approximate second-order methods, as well as global optimizers, on these inverse problems, and analyze the results to provide insights on how to choose and design optimizers for differentiable programming. We hope such benchmarks can inspire the development of more effective optimizers, and further promote the applications of differentiable programming in various scientific and engineering domains.

</details>


### [186] [Graph Neural Networks for Influence Maximization in Social Networks: An Unsupervised Minimum Dominating Set Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13836)
*Erfan Ahmadi,Mina Shirazi,Behnam Bahrak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督图神经网络框架求解最小支配集问题，无需真值解训练，在合成图上训练后可快速推理并得到近优解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小支配集（MDS）是NP难组合优化问题，在病毒营销、影响力最大化、公共卫生干预和信息传播等社交网络分析中应用关键。寻找覆盖整个网络的最小影响力个体集合在规模上计算困难，现有元启发式与监督学习方法效率或泛化性受限。

Method: 提出无监督GNN框架求解MDS，训练阶段不依赖真值解，使用12,000个具有多样结构属性的合成图进行训练，学习一种可迁移的启发式策略。

Result: 推理速度较元启发式基线最高快55倍，较监督学习方法最高快14倍，在真实社交网络基准上找到最优或近最优支配集，并能有效泛化到未见图分布。

Conclusion: 该无监督GNN学习启发式在效率与解质量上均具优势，泛化能力强，适用于大规模社交网络分析。

Abstract: The Minimum Dominating Set (MDS) problem is a classic NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with critical applications in social network analysis, including viral marketing, influence maximization, public health interventions, and information dissemination. Identifying a minimal set of influential individuals whose reach covers an entire social network is central to these applications, yet remains computationally challenging at scale. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning over graphs, and recent work explores their application to hard combinatorial problems. This paper presents a novel unsupervised GNN framework for the MDS problem that eliminates the need for ground-truth solutions during training. Trained on 12,000 synthetic graphs with diverse structural properties, our method achieves up to 55x faster inference than metaheuristic baselines and up to 14x faster inference than supervised learning approaches, while finding optimal or near-optimal dominating sets on real-world social network benchmarks. Our learned heuristic generalizes effectively to unseen graph distributions, demonstrating strong practical applicability for large-scale social network analysis.

</details>


### [187] [Accuracy Is Not Service: A Decision-Aware Benchmark for Intermittent-Demand Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13840)
*Joo Ern Chin,Shih-Fen Cheng,Aldy Gunawan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 订单级服务与行级预测精度存在目标错位：在间歇性需求下，预测精度排名与订单服务水平排名负相关（-0.555）。服务更受累积偏差方向影响，通过免训练修正 Chronos-2 的实例归一化偏差，填充代理指标从 77.5% 提升至 92.0%，完整订单满足率从 54% 提升至 63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合同物流备件运营商按订单级服务计酬（所有行项目全部满足才算有效订单），但预测方法却以行级精度遴选，二者目标不一致。在需求间歇且块状、历史短、提前期长达数月的场景下，这种错位尤为关键，因此需要决策感知的评估协议来揭示精度与真实服务之间的差距。

Method: 构建覆盖经典、间歇性需求、机器学习、深度学习及预训练基础模型的 38 种预测方法的基准，采用统一的决策感知协议，在来自实际合同的工业面板及两个公开数据集上评估；并分析 Chronos-2 实例归一化引入的偏差，提出免训练修正；同时发布 RUF（Regenerate-Until-Fidelity）用于生成可复现的保真合成面板。

Result: 在涵盖 20,330 个真实多物品订单的工业面板上，预测精度排名与订单服务排名呈负相关（-0.555）。服务表现与累积预测偏差的方向（包括零需求期的过预测）关联更紧密，而非点精度。修正 Chronos-2 实例归一化偏差后，90% 策略目标下每物料填充代理指标从 77.5% 升至 92.0%（+14.5 个百分点），完整订单满足率从 54% 升至 63%。

Conclusion: 对间歇性需求而言，误差最低的预测未必带来最高服务水平；偏差方向可解释这一缺口，且无需重新训练即可缩小该缺口。研究强调应采用决策感知的预测遴选标准，并以保真合成数据支撑结论复现。

Abstract: A contract-logistics spare-parts operator is paid on order-level service: an order counts only if every requested line is fulfilled, yet forecasters are selected based on line-level forecast accuracy. This disconnect matters when demand is intermittent and lumpy, histories are short, and lead times span months. We benchmarked 38 forecasting methods spanning classical, intermittent-demand, machine-learning, deep-learning, and pretrained foundation models. A common decision-aware protocol evaluates them on an industrial panel drawn from a live contract and two public datasets. Forecast-accuracy rank and order-service rank are negatively correlated on the industrial panel, at -0.555, across methods evaluated on 20,330 real multi-item orders. Service is more closely associated with the direction of cumulative forecast bias, including over-prediction during zero-demand periods, than with point accuracy. Examining bias in Chronos-2's instance normalization yields a training-free correction that lifts the per-material fill proxy from 77.5% to 92.0% (14.5 percentage points) at the 90% policy target and raises the complete-order fill rate from 54% to 63%. For reproducibility, we release RUF (Regenerate-Until-Fidelity), a method for generating fidelity-certified synthetic panels on which the findings reproduce. For intermittent demand, the lowest-error forecast need not deliver the highest service. Bias direction helps explain this gap, which can be reduced without retraining.

</details>


### [188] [Pre-training with Graph Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13844)
*Jiaming Wang,Thomas Laurent,Xavier Bresson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究生物化学领域图Transformer的预训练策略，发现以计算属性为标签的监督式预训练在下游任务上增益最大，并强调需约束模型容量以缓解过拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图Transformer在该领域的预训练策略尚缺乏系统比较，需要明确何种预训练方式与模型容量设置最有利于下游任务表现。

Method: 通过全面的实验，对不同预训练策略（重点为以计算属性作为标签的监督式预训练）进行对比评估。

Result: 以计算属性为标签的监督式预训练取得最高的下游任务性能增益；约束模型容量可有效缓解图Transformer的过拟合。

Conclusion: 监督式预训练（计算属性标签）是该领域图Transformer的优选预训练策略，且模型容量约束对防止过拟合至关重要。

Abstract: This article investigates pre-training strategies for graph transformers in the biochemistry domain. By conducting comprehensive experiments, the study reveals that supervised pre-training using computed properties as labels provides the highest performance gain on downstream tasks. The results also highlight the importance of constraining model capacity to mitigate overfitting in graph transformers.

</details>


### [189] [Affinity-Aware Sharding for Delayed Tensor Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13846)
*Eloi de Reynal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 延迟张量并行（DTP）通过推迟收集其它设备的部分输出破坏了神经元与KV头的置换对称性，使分片本身成为建模决策；本文提出以亲和度为导向的置换-分片优化方法，加速DTP模型的蒸馏/重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DTP移除了张量并行推理中阻塞式的all-reduce：每台设备立即将自身部分输出加入残差流并广播，但推迟接收（gather）其它设备的部分输出。因此TP改为DTP实质上是架构变更，稠密Transformer模型必须重训练或蒸馏。作者希望在不改变DTP架构的前提下，通过优化分片方式来降低这一适配成本。

Method: 论文指出DTP打破了FFN内部神经元之间以及注意力模块内部KV头之间的置换对称性，从而使得如何分片成为一个建模决策。方法上，作者先定义亲和度：用一阶近似估计"丢失某个头的贡献对每个神经元输出的损害"，以此度量KV头与同设备上FFN神经元的共置亲和度；随后用坐标上升优化器最大化共置亲和度，交替执行神经元的精确平衡分配与对KV头划分的穷举搜索，从而在分片前对稠密模型进行置换。

Result: 整个流程在单张GPU上对Qwen3-0.6B和Danube3-500M耗时不到两分钟。在δ=1时，亲和度优化布局达到任意蒸馏目标所需步数仅为朴素连续布局的约1/2到2/3（在测试的整个10k步范围内成立）；每个优化种子都优于每个连续种子，并且除十六个随机布局中的一个之外，优于所有随机布局。此外，初始化时的共置亲和度分数可预测训练后相对基础模型的KL散度，在从反优化到优化的十七种布局上，Pearson相关系数为−0.81与−0.89。

Conclusion: DTP下的分片决策具有建模意义：通过基于亲和度的置换优化分片布局，能显著加快DTP模型的蒸馏或重训练收敛，且初始化亲和度可作为训练后KL的可预测指标，方法计算开销极低。

Abstract: Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP) removes the blocking all-reduce of tensor-parallel Transformer inference. Every device adds its own partial output to its residual stream (and broadcasts it) immediately, but only gathers (receives) the other devices' partials $δ$ modules later. A TP to DTP change therefore amounts to a real architecture change, and dense Transformer models need to be retrained or distilled after adaptation. We show that DTP breaks the permutation symmetry of neurons inside FFNs and of KV heads inside attention modules, and that this symmetry breakage makes the sharding itself a modelling decision. We show that maximising the affinity between the KV heads and the FFN neurons co-located on a device, by permuting the dense model before sharding, speeds up the distillation or retraining process. The affinity is measured with a first-order approximation of the damage that losing a head's contribution does to each neuron's output, and the co-located affinity is maximised with a coordinate-ascent optimiser that alternates an exact balanced assignment of neurons with an exhaustive search over the KV head partitions. The whole procedure takes under two minutes on one GPU for Qwen3-0.6B and Danube3-500M. On these models, at $δ=1$, the affinity-optimised layouts reach any distillation target in about half to two thirds of the steps needed by the naive contiguous layouts, over the whole 10k-step range we tested, and every optimised seed beats every contiguous seed and all but one of the sixteen random layouts. We also show that the co-located affinity score at initialisation predicts the KL to the base model after training, across seventeen layouts ranging from anti-optimised to optimised (Pearson $-0.81$ and $-0.89$).

</details>


### [190] [ReH-FUSE: Reliability-Aware Hierarchical Fusion of Experts for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13857)
*Guan-Hua Wen,Hou-Chiang Tseng,Kuan-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReH-FUSE可靠性感知框架，通过对话级文本、音频与跨模态专家及决策级路由，解决多模态对话情感识别中证据源可靠性随实例变化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态对话情感识别中，不同证据源的可靠性依赖具体实例：有时词汇内容是决定性的，有时语音表达提供互补线索，有时准确识别依赖跨模态交互；固定融合方式无法显式刻画这种变化。

Method: ReH-FUSE采用可靠性感知框架，构建对话感知的文本、音频和跨模态专家。其决策级路由先建模文本与音频之间的相对偏好，再将所得单模态混合结果与跨模态专家进行平衡，从而把单模态竞争与跨模态选择分离。

Result: 在IEMOCAP上三次独立运行达到74.34%加权F1和73.11%宏F1；在MELD上达到68.03%加权F1。受控消融实验表明，学习式路由优于均匀专家平均，并从跨模态交互中获益。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的决策级路由可有效适配实例相关的证据可靠性，跨模态交互对性能提升具有正向作用。

Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) requires adapting to the instance-dependent reliability of different evidence sources. Lexical content may be decisive, vocal expression may provide complementary cues, or accurate recognition may require cross-modal interaction; fixed fusion does not explicitly account for this variation. We propose ReH-FUSE, a reliability-aware framework with dialogue-aware text, audio, and cross-modal experts. Its decision-level router first models the relative preference between text and audio and then balances the resulting unimodal mixture against the cross-modal expert. This factorization separates unimodal competition from cross-modal selection. Across three independent runs on IEMOCAP, ReH-FUSE achieves 74.34% weighted F1 and 73.11% macro F1; on MELD, it achieves 68.03% weighted F1. Controlled ablations show that learned routing outperforms uniform expert averaging and benefits from cross-modal interaction.

</details>


### [191] [An Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Mathematical-Machine-Learning Model for Smart Irrigation Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13864)
*Andrea Scariolo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将可解释的水量平衡模型与随机森林残差校正耦合，并通过保形预测量化不确定性，把预测区间下界转化为灌溉触发规则，实现风险感知的灌溉决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灌溉调度通常是被动响应式的，既不预测土壤水分走向，也不给出预测置信度。数据驱动模型准确但黑箱且只给点值，水量平衡模型透明但结构误差大，二者单独都无法在不确定性下支持可靠的灌溉决策。

Method: 以四参数水量平衡模型为核心，仅在训练数据上校准，再用随机森林仅学习物理残差进行校正；采用保形预测给出90%名义区间，并用风险感知规则将区间下界转为灌溉触发阈值。在雨养地中海农田站点三年逐小时原位数据上、按严格时间顺序划分进行评测，与持续性预测基线对比，预见期从1小时到1周。

Result: 24小时预见期混合模型RMSE为0.00925 m^3 m^-3，技巧得分+9.4%，约为九个基线中最优者的两倍，而九个基线中仅随机森林优于持续性预测。技巧不随预见期单调增长：3小时达峰值+27.4%，1周降至+1.2%。保形分位数回归比定宽保形预测校准更好且区间锐度提高11%。风险感知规则将管理阈值穿越的提前检出率从0.905提升至1.000，代价是精确率由0.975降至0.950、名义用水增加3.7%；超过72小时后点预测规则不如无预测规则，而区间规则仍保持有效。

Conclusion: 不确定性量化决定了由预报驱动灌溉建议仍可信赖的预见期长度；在本研究中，物理层的透明度未造成可测量的精度损失。

Abstract: Agriculture accounts for roughly 70% of global freshwater withdrawals, yet irrigation is still commonly scheduled reactively, with no forecast of where soil moisture is heading and no statement of confidence in that forecast. Data-driven models are accurate but opaque and point-valued; water-balance models are transparent but carry large structural error. Neither alone supports a defensible irrigation decision under uncertainty. This study coupled the two and carried uncertainty through to the decision: a four-parameter water-balance core, calibrated on training data only, was corrected by a Random Forest that learned nothing but the physical residual, conformal prediction attached 90%-nominal intervals, and a risk-aware rule converted the interval lower bound into an irrigation trigger. It was evaluated on three years of hourly in-situ measurements from a rainfed Mediterranean cropland station under a strict chronological split, scored against persistence, from one hour to one week. At the 24 h horizon the hybrid reached RMSE 0.00925 m^3 m^-3 and +9.4% skill, roughly double the best of nine baselines, of which only the Random Forest beat persistence. Skill did not grow with lead time: it peaked at +27.4% at three hours and fell to +1.2% at one week. Conformalised quantile regression was better calibrated and 11% sharper than constant-width conformal prediction. The risk-aware rule raised management-threshold crossings detected in advance from 0.905 to 1.000, at a precision cost of 0.975 to 0.950 and 3.7% more notional water, and beyond 72 h the point forecast fell below the no-forecast rule while the interval-based rule did not. Uncertainty quantification therefore governs the lead time over which forecast-driven irrigation advice remains trustworthy, and here transparency in the physical layer cost no measurable accuracy.

</details>


### [192] [The Filter Metric is Safety-Critical: Phantom Advantages in Group-Relative RL under Shaped Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13866)
*Juntao Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在使用复合塑形奖励的 GRPO 类算法中，若动态采样的过滤指标使用塑形训练分数而非任务结果，会使全失败组因组内仍存在非零方差而通过过滤，经标准差归一化后产生"幻影优势"，导致训练崩溃；改用任务结果信号过滤可稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 及其变体可通过动态采样丢弃无对比的 rollout 组，但实际实现中过滤指标是可配置的。本文识别并量化了复合塑形奖励下"指标—谓词"的语义错配：过滤若依据塑形训练分数而非任务结果，则语义上与"无对比组"的定义不一致，从而引入隐蔽的失效模式。

Method: 控制变量实验：在 GSM8K 上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B + LoRA，对比无过滤、塑形分数过滤、二值结果过滤三种设置（每臂四次运行，含三次默认种子重跑与一次 seed-123）。并在 verl 原生 recipe/dapo 训练器上固定模型、数据、奖励与训练器，仅改变过滤指标，直接观测原生的删除/重填（deletion/refill）遥测；同时测试正系数 lambda ∈ {0.1, 0.3, 0.5}，并在 MATH（1.5B/7B）与 GSPO 下做探索性单次运行复现，另验证关闭标准差归一化的效果。

Result: GSM8K 对比中，无过滤与塑形分数过滤的 EM 分别为 0.080 ± 0.112 与 0.040 ± 0.008，而二值结果过滤稳定保持 0.754 ± 0.005。在 verl 原生 DAPO 训练器上仅更换指标：分数臂在 40 个观测步中均无需重填批次，最终 EM 0.160；准确率臂在 29/40 步发生重填，最终 EM 0.763。测试的 lambda 取值下不安全臂均崩溃；探索性单次运行在 MATH（1.5B/7B）与 GSPO 下复现失败；关闭标准差归一化可避免崩溃。

Conclusion: 复合奖励下的动态采样过滤应使用语义独立于塑形项的任务结果信号作为谓词；本文隔离出"指标—谓词语义错配"这一因素，并通过原生删除/重填遥测直接佐证，为滤波指标设计提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Group-relative policy optimization (GRPO and descendants) can discard no-contrast rollout groups through dynamic sampling, while practical implementations expose a configurable filter metric. We identify and quantify a metric-predicate mismatch under composite shaped rewards. When filtering follows the shaped training score rather than the task outcome, all-fail groups retain nonzero within-group spread and pass the predicate; standard-deviation normalization then promotes shaping differences among failures to full-size phantom advantages. In a controlled GSM8K comparison (Qwen2.5-1.5B, LoRA), no filtering and shaped-score filtering end at EM 0.080 +/- 0.112 and 0.040 +/- 0.008, whereas binary-outcome filtering holds 0.754 +/- 0.005 across four runs per arm (three default-seed reruns and one seed-123 run; mean +/- sample SD). On verl's native recipe/dapo trainer, holding model, data, reward and trainer fixed and changing only the metric, the score arm requires no batch refill in any of 40 observed steps and ends at EM 0.160; the accuracy arm refills in 29/40 steps and ends at 0.763. Both use the same custom shaped-reward hook and unmodified trainer/filter code. Prior work established shaping-induced amplification and all-fail filtering; our contribution isolates the metric-predicate semantic mismatch and directly instruments native deletion/refill telemetry. Across tested positive coefficients lambda in {0.1, 0.3, 0.5}, unsafe arms collapse; exploratory one-run cells reproduce the failure at 1.5B/7B on MATH and under GSPO, while disabling standard-deviation normalization avoids the observed collapse. Filtering under a composite reward should use a task-outcome signal whose semantics are independent of shaping.

</details>


### [193] [A Multi-Resolution Multi-Domain Pre-Training Framework for Universal Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13878)
*Zhouyang Liu,Jindong Han,Hao Wang,Xinyue Liu,Hui Gao,Dongsheng Li,Hao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FlexST预训练框架，通过模块化与自适应设计解决交通数据异质性建模难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空交通数据是智能交通系统的核心，但数据高度异质。现有预训练模型采用同质化建模范式处理异质交通数据，导致范式与数据根本性失配，限制泛化能力，并造成计算开销大、参数效率低的问题。

Method: 1) 多分辨率时空扩散模块：捕捉短期波动与长程趋势，协调时间与空间分辨率差异大的输入；2) 领域自适应混合专家（MoE）：动态路由数据至专用子网络，实现选择性知识迁移并避免跨领域负干扰；3) 统一周期编码策略：注入分辨率与领域感知的归纳偏置，协调跨数据集的周期不一致性。

Result: 在23个真实交通数据集上，FlexST在零样本与少样本设置下显著优于最先进基线，展现出更优的泛化性、适应性与效率。

Conclusion: 该工作为构建能够应对城市交通系统复杂性与可变性的通用预训练模型提供了新方向。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal traffic data are central to intelligent transportation systems, yet their heterogeneity poses significant challenges for large-scale modeling. Existing pre-trained models often rely on a homogeneous modeling paradigm to handle highly heterogeneous traffic data. This fundamental mismatch not only limits model generalization but also leads to computationally expensive and parameter-inefficient designs. To this end, we propose FlexST, a novel pre-training framework that introduces modularity and adaptivity for traffic modeling. Specifically, we first propose a multi-resolution spatio-temporal diffusion module that captures both short-term fluctuations and long-range trends, effectively reconciling inputs with divergent temporal and spatial resolutions. After that, we construct a domain-adaptive mixture-of-experts that dynamically routes data to specialized sub-networks, enabling selective knowledge transfer while preventing negative interference across diverse domains. Moreover, we devise a unified periodic encoding strategy that injects resolution- and domain-aware inductive biases to harmonize periodic inconsistencies across datasets. Extensive experiments on 23 real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that FlexST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in zero- and few-shot settings, showcasing superior generalization, adaptability and efficiency. This work offers a new direction for building general-purpose pre-trained models capable of handling the complexity and variability of urban traffic systems.

</details>


### [194] [Lie to me: Detecting Managerial Evasiveness in Earnings Calls via Conversational Audio Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13893)
*Huizhong Chen,Huan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双分支晚融合框架，用LLM评判问答文本并结合对话音频时序表示，检测管理层回避性，预测SEC迟交文件等不利事件，AUROC达0.89。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 财报电话会议是管理层在接受分析师审视下披露信息的主要渠道。以往研究将语音和词汇特征与未来不利结果关联，但往往在整通电话上汇总特征，且未充分利用问答环节的交互结构，因此需要更好地捕捉交互动态以提升预警能力。

Method: 双分支晚融合框架：(i) LLM-as-a-judge，通过结构化二元评分量表将问答文本映射为可解释的电话层面向量X_text；(ii) 冻结的对话编码器，其时间隐藏状态由DeepVoice式顺序读取器处理，生成音频表示h。将(X_text, h)晚融合得到电话层面风险分数p。

Result: 在n=1,039通电话（212起迟交）上，采用按公司分组的5折交叉验证，融合模型AUROC约0.89，而纯文本评判为0.55，仅时长特征为0.71。

Conclusion: 对话音频动态所编码的管理层回避性信息超出词汇内容和电话时长，可提供更强的SEC不利结果早期预警信号。

Abstract: Earnings conference calls are a primary channel through which managers disclose information under analyst scrutiny. Prior work has linked vocal and lexical cues to future adverse outcomes, but often pools features over an entire call and underuses the interactive structure of Q&A. We propose a two-branch late-fusion framework for detecting managerial evasiveness as a predictor of extrinsic SEC events (primarily late filings): (i) an LLM-as-a-judge that maps Q&A text to an interpretable call-level vector X_text via a structured binary rubric, and (ii) a frozen conversational encoder whose temporal hidden states are read by a DeepVoice-style sequential reader to produce an audio representation h. Late fusion of (X_text, h) yields a call-level risk score p. On n=1,039 calls (212 late filings) with firm-grouped 5-fold CV, fusion reaches AUROC approx. 0.89, versus 0.55 for the text judge and 0.71 for duration alone. These results show that conversational audio dynamics encode managerial evasiveness beyond lexical content and call length, yielding a stronger early-warning signal of adverse SEC outcomes.

</details>


### [195] [Machine Learning under Imperfect Data: Challenges and Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13914)
*Masoumeh Zareapoor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇短综述，将机器学习中数据不完整、不平衡、弱标注、分布不匹配等常见缺陷统一归因于少数共享机制（信息损失、经验风险偏差、监督模糊、表征不稳定），并据此组织代表性方法并指出未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中训练与测试数据常不满足充分完整、平衡、有标注且分布相容的假设：测量可能缺失或损坏、稀有类代表性差、监督薄弱、部署环境与训练环境不一致。这些缺陷通常被当作彼此独立的技术问题处理，但本文认为它们通过少数共享机制共同影响学习，因此有必要统一组织梳理。

Method: 采用短综述（short survey）的形式，以共享机制为组织线索，围绕四种机制（信息损失、有偏经验风险、监督模糊、表征不稳定）归类代表性方法，并分主题综述：重建与生成、重平衡与表征校准、有限监督学习、跨域与跨模态适应、分布变化下的可靠性。

Result: 梳理并综合了上述各方向的代表性方法，并指出了若干关键局限：合理重建的边界、面向特定基准的校正的局限、以及缺乏可信反馈时的适应问题。

Conclusion: 提出未来方向：证据感知学习（evidence-aware learning）、保留不确定性的预测（uncertainty-preserving prediction），以及将视觉合理性（visual plausibility）与决策效用（decision utility）分离的评估方式。

Abstract: Machine-learning models are commonly developed under an assumption that training and test data are sufficiently complete, balanced, labelled, and drawn from compatible distributions. In practice, one or more of these conditions is often violated. Measurements may be missing or corrupted, rare classes may be poorly represented, supervision may be weak, and the deployment environment may differ from the training environment. These imperfections are usually treated as separate technical problems, although they alter learning through a small number of shared mechanisms: loss of information, biased empirical risk, ambiguous supervision, and unstable representations. This short survey organises representative methods around these mechanisms. It reviews reconstruction and generation, rebalancing and representation calibration, learning with limited supervision, adaptation across domains and modalities, and reliability under distribution change. The discussion highlights the limits of plausible reconstruction, benchmark-specific correction, and adaptation without trustworthy feedback. It concludes with directions for evidence-aware learning, uncertainty-preserving prediction, and evaluation that separates visual plausibility from decision utility.

</details>


### [196] [Learning Through Energy Refinement and Manifold Projection: A Cooperative EBM-AE Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13917)
*Ryad Zemouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出协同式能量模型-自编码器（EBM-AE）框架，通过联合训练EBM与去噪自编码器并引入EBM→AE→EBM迭代采样，在MNIST生成与图像修复任务上优于传统自编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EBM虽理论框架灵活，但训练受限于Langevin采样的计算成本以及难以高效探索所学数据流形，因此需要一种能同时缓解采样效率与流形探索问题的方法。

Method: 联合训练EBM与去噪自编码器；提出迭代式EBM→AE→EBM采样流程，Langevin动力学与自编码器投影交替精化样本。自编码器充当流形投影算子以正则化采样轨迹，EBM则执行朝低能量区域的能量精化。

Result: 在MNIST数据集上的大量实验表明，联合EBM-AE训练相比传统自编码器显著提升生成质量；在结构化与随机掩码的图像修复任务中，流形投影贡献了主要的重建能力，而能量精化在重建问题更难时收益愈发明显。

Conclusion: 结合流形投影与能量最小化，为生成、重建及分布外检测提供了有效且可解释的框架，并揭示了能量建模与表示学习的互补作用。

Abstract: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) provide a flexible framework for generative modeling by learning an energy landscape that assigns low energy values to realistic samples and higher energies to unlikely observations. Despite their theoretical appeal, training EBMs remains challenging due to the computational cost of Langevin sampling and the difficulty of efficiently exploring the learned data manifold. In this work, we propose a cooperative Energy-Based Model and Autoencoder (EBM-AE) framework that combines energy-based refinement with manifold projection. The proposed approach jointly trains an EBM with a denoising autoencoder and introduces an iterative EBM$\rightarrow$AE$\rightarrow$EBM sampling procedure in which Langevin dynamics and autoencoder projection alternately refine generated samples. Within this framework, the autoencoder acts as a manifold projection operator that regularizes sampling trajectories, while the EBM performs energy-based refinement toward low-energy regions of the learned distribution. Extensive experiments conducted on the MNIST dataset demonstrate that joint EBM-AE training substantially improves generation quality compared with a conventional autoencoder.
  Beyond unconditional generation, we evaluate the proposed framework on image inpainting tasks involving structured and random masks. The results show that manifold projection provides the majority of the reconstruction capability, whereas the final energy-based refinement becomes increasingly beneficial as the reconstruction problem becomes more challenging.
  Taken together, the results indicate that combining manifold projection and energy minimization provides an effective and interpretable framework for generation, reconstruction, and out-of-distribution detection, while offering new insights into the complementary roles of energy-based modeling and representation learning.

</details>


### [197] [Machine Learning in Fish Farming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13919)
*Fearghal O'Donncha,Nikos Papandroulakis,Jennie Korus,Abigail Langbridge,Alexander Timms,Konstantinos Topouzelis,Abdul Baseer Khan,Shree Rama Kamal Kumar Vegu,Mahtab Sarvmaili,Ryan Mowat,Rhanna Turberville,Tyler Sclodnick,Christopher Whidden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本章探讨机器学习（ML）如何变革水产养殖，重点关注提升决策过程与运营效率。内容涵盖ML技术概览、应用、新兴趋势、未来方向与案例研究，涉及随机森林、CNN、RNN、GNN及大语言模型等，并强调ML与物联网协同用于实时监测与决策支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水产养殖面临诸多运营与环境挑战，传统决策方式难以满足实时性与精准性需求，亟需借助人工智能与机器学习技术提升决策质量与生产效率。

Method: 采用综述性章节结构：先介绍水产养殖挑战与AI作用，再概述ML技术，随后展开应用、新兴趋势、未来方向及案例研究。具体方法包括随机森林、卷积神经网络（CNN）、循环神经网络（RNN），以及图神经网络（GNN）与大语言模型（LLM）等新兴技术，并结合物联网（IoT）实现实时监测与决策支持。

Result: ML技术已应用于生物量估计、物种识别、行为分析及环境预测等关键场景；ML与IoT的协同可实现实时监测与决策支持，展现出显著的应用成效。

Conclusion: ML驱动的创新有望彻底变革鱼类养殖，推动水产养殖业向更高效、可持续且高产的方向发展。

Abstract: This chapter explores how machine learning (ML) is transforming aquaculture, with a particular focus on enhancing decision-making processes and improving operational efficiency. The chapter is structured to first introduce the challenges in aquaculture and the role of AI and then provide an overview of ML techniques in the context of aquaculture, followed by applications, emerging trends, future directions, and case studies. The focus is on real-world applications of ML techniques, including Random Forest, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), as well as emerging technologies such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and large language models (LLMs). Key applications include biomass estimation, species recognition, behavioural analysis, and environmental forecasting. The chapter also highlights the synergy between ML and the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and decision support. Ultimately, ML-driven innovations have the potential to revolutionise fish farming, leading to more efficient, sustainable, and productive practices in the aquaculture industry.

</details>


### [198] [Finite-Time Node Separation in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks with Persistent Gaussian Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13920)
*Mostafa Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对带持续高斯噪声的循环GNN进行有限时间分析，证明任意两节点表示的期望平方距离有统一下界2σ²d，并给出非中心卡方刻画的近碰撞界与几乎必然不碰撞等结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明持续高斯扰动可保证循环GNN的正平稳Dirichlet能量，从而避免渐近过平滑，但该全局能量界无法保证有限深度下各节点表示仍保持可区分。本文旨在补充有限时间层面的节点级分离性分析。

Method: 针对同一持续噪声架构，令d为表示维度、σ为噪声标准差。首先证明任意两节点表示期望平方距离的精确二阶矩分解，得到每步下界2σ²d（无需收缩或平稳性假设）；进一步给出条件成对距离的非中心卡方刻画，其非中心参数为确定性消息传递分离度除以2σ²；据此推导动态感知的固定时间与有限时域近碰撞界，并将原有中心高斯界作为零分离最坏情形恢复；同时证明几乎必然成对不碰撞、有限时域一致保证及随机动力学的置换等变性与图输出的置换不变性。

Result: 得到期望平方距离的普适下界2σ²d；建立非中心卡方刻画与动态感知的固定时间/有限时域近碰撞界；恢复原中心界为最坏零分离情形；证明几乎必然成对不碰撞、有限时域一致保证及置换等变性/不变性。

Conclusion: 本研究从有限时间角度补充了此前的渐近能量分析，为节点级表示分离提供了严格保证。

Abstract: Persistent Gaussian perturbations have been shown to prevent asymptotic oversmoothing in recurrent Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) by ensuring a positive stationary Dirichlet energy. However, this global energy bound does not guarantee that individual node representations remain distinct at finite depths. In this paper, we provide a complementary finite-time analysis of the same persistent-noise architecture. Let \(d\) denote the representation dimension and \(σ\) the noise standard deviation. We first prove an exact second-moment decomposition for the expected squared distance between any two node representations, yielding the universal lower bound \(2σ^2 d\) at every positive time step without contraction or stationarity assumptions. More precisely, conditional pairwise distances have a noncentral chi-square characterization: the noncentrality parameter is the deterministic message-passing separation normalized by \(2σ^2\). This yields dynamics-aware fixed-time and finite-horizon near-collision bounds that retain information discarded by the central worst-case analysis. The earlier central Gaussian bound is recovered as the worst-case zero-separation case. We additionally prove almost-sure pairwise noncollision, derive a uniform finite-horizon guarantee, and establish permutation equivariance in distribution for the stochastic dynamics and permutation-invariant graph outputs. Our results complement the asymptotic energy analysis of prior work and provide rigorous finite-time guarantees on node-level representation separation.

</details>


### [199] [Minibatch persistency, eight years later: what batch reuse costs in steps and joules, and what it saves in data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13922)
*Matteo Fischetti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过预注册的对照实验（49M参数Transformer，FineWeb-Edu，B∈{32,128,512}，每格8个种子，逐臂调优学习率）检验小批量复用（minibatch persistency）的真实收益。结论：其收益既非速度也非能耗，而是数据节省，且仅在大批量下成立；在B=512处，注册对照无法将复用效应与学习率调度位置区分开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小批量复用自2019年被纳入data echoing以来，一直存在两点争议：一是认为复用只是在模仿更大的学习率，二是缺乏与该方法同等调优力度的基线。本文旨在补上这一缺失的对照测试。

Method: 预注册研究：在FineWeb-Edu上训练49M参数Transformer，批量大小B∈{32,128,512}，每格8个随机种子，对每个批量大小和每个实验臂分别调优学习率。对照组为无复用控制（仅改变采样方式，其余不变）。以达到固定损失的成本为指标，从四个维度衡量：优化器步数、新鲜token数、秒数、插座端焦耳数。随后在新种子和更新一代GPU上复现，并将三个实验臂置于同一步数调度上比较。

Result: 在B=32时，复用比基线读取更多而非更少的新鲜token；在步数、秒数和焦耳上最多是"免费"（无收益）；在B=512处表现最佳，但注册对照在n=8种子下无法将复用效应与学习率调度位置的影响区分开。

Conclusion: 小批量复用值得在"新鲜数据而非算力是瓶颈成本"的场景使用，如语料耗尽、按样本计费的流水线、无法回溯的数据流；若数据可以重新读取，间隔式epoch（spaced epochs）效果相当或更好。

Abstract: Minibatch persistency reuses data instead of reading it: rather than drawing a fresh minibatch at every optimizer step, it takes K consecutive steps on the same one. Absorbed into data echoing in 2019, it has carried one objection -- that reuse merely imitates a larger learning rate -- and no baseline tuned as carefully as the method itself. This paper runs the missing test. A pre-registered study trains a 49M-parameter Transformer on FineWeb-Edu at minibatch size B in {32, 128, 512}, 8 seeds per cell, tuning the learning rate separately for every batch size and every arm, against a reuse-free control that changes the sampling and nothing else. Each headline claim is a cost to reach a fixed loss, read on four axes: optimizer steps, fresh tokens, seconds, and joules at the socket. We then replicate on new seeds and a newer GPU generation, and put the three arms on one schedule in steps. The outcome of our study is that what minibatch reuse buys is neither speed nor energy but data, and only at large minibatch size: at B = 32 it reads more fresh tokens than the baseline, not fewer. On steps, seconds and joules it is at best free; and at B = 512, where it looks best, a registered control cannot separate the effect of reuse from the position on the learning-rate schedule at n = 8 seeds. The technique is therefore worth using where fresh data rather than compute is the binding cost: a corpus that runs out, a pipeline that pays per sample, a stream that cannot be rewound. Where the data can simply be read again, spaced epochs do as well or better.

</details>


### [200] [Exploring napping paradigm for Recurrent Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13927)
*Andreas Massey,Stefano Nichele,Aliaksandr Hubin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"小睡(napping)"机制——比例权重缩放与连续随机膜噪声结合，在无监督循环SNN上验证其能复现权重归一化的稳定性并降低模型复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物体通过两种离线机制平衡内部世界模型的准确性与简洁性：睡眠通过渐进突触下调降低复杂度，随机噪声衰减精度从而放松感觉输入对突触重组的约束。而工程化SNN忽略这一平衡，仅采用瞬时、无噪的权重归一化，因此作者希望引入仿生的小睡范式来填补这一空白。

Method: 在Gabor预处理的MNIST上，用基于迹的STDP训练无监督循环SNN；在三种正则化机制下扫描小睡的时长与膜噪声水平，并将最佳配置与权重归一化进行对比。

Result: 三种机制下，调参良好的小睡均能达到与归一化相当的准确率：准确率在短时长、低噪声时达到峰值，随后随时长或噪声增大单调下降。但聚类表现分化，最强的几何分离出现在更长时间、更高噪声时——自由能两项出现张力，准确率偏好数据拟合，结构偏好渐进噪声下调诱导的更简表示。

Conclusion: 小睡在准确率上可媲美权重归一化且能降低模型复杂度，但需付出归一化所不具备的仿真代价，因此当优先考虑表征结构而非单纯分类效率时，小睡更具吸引力。

Abstract: Biological organisms minimize free energy by balancing two competing demands on their internal world model: it must be accurate enough to predict sensory input, yet simple enough to generalize beyond it.
