Two mechanisms regulate this balance offline: sleep reduces complexity through gradual synaptic downscaling, while stochastic noise attenuates precision, relaxing the constraint sensory input imposes on synaptic reorganization. Engineered Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) leave this balance unaddressed, favoring instantaneous, noiseless weight normalization instead. This paper investigates the hypothesis that a biologically inspired micro-sleep paradigm, napping -- combining proportional weight scaling with continuous stochastic membrane activity -- can replicate the stability of normalization while shedding model complexity. We evaluate this in an unsupervised recurrent SNN trained via trace-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) on Gabor-preprocessed MNIST. We tune napping across three regularization regimes by sweeping its duration and membrane noise level, then compare the best configuration against weight normalization. Across all three regimes, well-tuned napping matches the accuracy of normalization: accuracy peaks at brief durations and low noise, then declines monotonically as either grows. Clustering diverges, with the strongest geometric separation arising at longer durations and higher noise -- the two terms of free energy pulling apart, accuracy rewarding data fit and structure rewarding the simpler representation that gradual, noisy downscaling induces. This gain carries a simulation cost normalization avoids, so napping is most compelling where representational structure, rather than raw classification efficiency, is the priority.

</details>


### [201] [Optimal Transport for Efficient, Unsupervised Anomaly Detection on Industrial Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13940)
*Abigail Langbridge,Fearghal O'Donncha,James T Rayfield,Bradley Eck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于最优传输（OT）的时间序列异常检测框架，利用滑动参考窗口学习正常与观测工况的映射，无需标注数据，适应实时数据，具备抗噪性并给出反事实解释，在三个工业数据集上优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业4.0背景下，时序传感器数据异常检测需求强烈，但现有方法存在数据标注依赖、泛化性差、可扩展性不足等问题，且工业环境中常见的短期波动、噪声与数据缺失进一步增加检测难度。

Method: 提出基于最优传输（OT）的异常检测框架。方法仅需极少用户输入，通过滑动参考窗口自适应数据动态性，学习正常运行条件与观测运行条件之间的映射，不依赖标注训练数据，并可实时适配数据；同时提供反事实解释以增强工业部署中的可审计性。

Result: 在来自航运、工业HVAC系统以及公开基准数据的三个工业数据集上进行评估，方法在识别异常和降低误报方面表现优异，超过传统方法，同时保持计算效率与配置便捷性。

Conclusion: 该OT框架有效克服了数据标注、泛化性与可扩展性限制，对短期波动、噪声和数据缺失具有鲁棒性，并能提供可审计的反事实解释，适用于工业时间序列异常检测。

Abstract: Effective anomaly detection frameworks are a central pillar of the Industry 4.0 paradigm. In this paper, we introduce an Optimal Transport (OT)-based framework for anomaly detection, designed to detect deviations from normal behaviour in time-series sensor data. The OT-based method requires minimal user input and adapts to real-time data without the need for labelled training data. Our method effectively addresses existing limitations related to data labelling, generalisability, and scalability, demonstrating resilience against short-term fluctuations, noise, and data gaps - common challenges in industrial environments. Additionally, our method provides counterfactual explanations improving the auditability of the approach when deployed in industrial settings. The proposed method learns the mapping between normal and observed operating conditions through a sliding reference window that adapts to the dynamicity of the data. We evaluate our approach on three industrial datasets, from shipping, industrial HVAC systems, and publicly available benchmark data. The method was highly effective in identifying anomalies and reducing false positives, outperforming traditional methods, while maintaining computational efficiency and ease of configuration.

</details>


### [202] [Hardware-Aware Learned Representation Compression for Distributed In-Sensor Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13947)
*Chengwei Zhou,Abu Masum,Xuming Chen,Mehran Moghadam,Sreetama Sarkar,Arnab Sanyal,Md Abdullah-Al Kaiser,M. Hassan Najafi,Sercan Aygun,Gourav Datta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OASIS 提出一种分布式传感内视觉框架，通过轻量编码器生成紧凑任务相关表征以降低通信开销，并结合量化/Huffman 编码或 Sobol 超维计算实现高压缩率的边缘视觉处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与 CMOS 图像传感器集成的逻辑芯片受算力与内存严格限制，传统深度神经网络划分方案难以适用；同时高分辨率图像数据传输成本高，需要在传感器近端进行早期处理以降低通信开销。

Method: 采用轻量编码器在片外传输前生成紧凑、任务相关的表征，编码器以任务、熵和重建目标进行端到端训练，解码器仅用于训练。支持两条部署路径：其一为 4-bit 量化加 Huffman 编码，并保留分类与密集预测所需空间结构；其二为基于 Sobol 的超维计算（HDC），将编码器潜变量转换为固定维度二进制超向量用于联想记忆分类。在 AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA 上实现数字近传感器流水线，并通过板级功耗实测、Vivado 实现后分析、电路仿真的 CIS 模型及 7-nm ASIC 投影进行表征。

Result: 在基于 SwinViT 的 VWW 模型中，将 3×3×8 潜变量映射为 64 维超向量，相比 128 维配置额外实现 1.77× 通信压缩，精度损失不足一个百分点，相较原始 8-bit 图像传输整体压缩达 18,816×。在视觉唤醒词分类、手部追踪和眼动追踪任务上，OASIS 将系统总能耗降低约 2×–4.5×，同时保持有竞争力的精度。

Conclusion: OASIS 展示了一条实用的硬件-算法协同设计路径，可在资源受限的近传感器逻辑上实现通信高效的传感内视觉，兼顾压缩率、精度与能耗。

Abstract: In-sensor computing reduces the cost of transmitting high-resolution image data by performing early-stage processing near the sensor. However, the logic chip integrated with a CMOS image sensor (CIS) is tightly constrained in compute and memory, limiting conventional deep neural network partitioning. We present OASIS, a distributed in-sensor vision framework that uses a lightweight encoder to generate compact, task-relevant representations before off-chip transmission. The encoder is trained end-to-end using task, entropy, and reconstruction objectives, while the decoder is used only during training. OASIS supports two complementary deployment paths. The first applies 4-bit quantization and Huffman coding while preserving the spatial structure required by classification and dense-prediction tasks. The second uses Sobol-based hyperdimensional computing (HDC) to transform the encoder latent into a fixed-dimensional binary hypervector for associative-memory classification. For the SwinViT-based VWW model, mapping a $3\times3\times8$ latent to a 64-dimensional hypervector provides an additional $1.77\times$ communication reduction with less than one percentage point of accuracy loss relative to the 128-dimensional configuration, yielding an overall $18{,}816\times$ reduction compared with raw 8-bit image transmission. We implement the digital near-sensor pipeline on an AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA and characterize it using direct board-level power measurements and Vivado post-implementation analysis, together with circuit-simulated CIS models and a 7-nm ASIC projection. Across visual wake-word classification, hand tracking, and eye tracking, OASIS reduces total system energy by approximately $2\times$-$4.5\times$ while maintaining competitive accuracy, demonstrating a practical hardware-algorithm co-design path for communication-efficient in-sensor vision.

</details>


### [203] [Linear Ensemble Sampling with Smaller Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13954)
*Taehyun Hwang,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种按需刷新机制的集成采样算法，将足够集成规模从 Θ(d log T) 降至 Θ(d log d + d log log T)，并首次在集成采样中同时恢复任意有界臂集与有限臂集的经典遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成采样是随机化探索的实用方法，但其集成规模能否逼近内在的 Ω(d) 下界尚不清楚。已有保证需要 Θ(d log T) 的集成规模，与 Ω(d) 壁垒之间存在关于时间步 T 的对数间隙。论文旨在缩小该间隙。

Method: 仅当正则化 Gram 矩阵发生显著变化时才刷新集成。该机制将扰动分析局部化到 Gram 矩阵漂移受控的各个 epoch 中，从而把足够的集成规模降低到 Θ(d log d + d log log T)。算法还支持无需重置历史数据的 anytime 实现。

Result: 在任意有界臂集下保持集成采样当前最优的 Õ(d^{3/2}√T) 遗憾；当臂集有限且基数为 K 时，达到更紧的 Õ(d√(T log K))。实验显示算法使用显著更小的集成即可与基线方法竞争。

Conclusion: 这是首个同时恢复随机化线性 bandit 两种经典遗憾缩放（任意有界臂集的 Õ(d^{3/2}√T) 与有限臂集的 Õ(d√(T log K))）的集成采样保证，显著缩小了集成规模的理论间隙并具备实用价值。

Abstract: Ensemble sampling offers a practical approach to randomized exploration by maintaining a collection of models, but how small an ensemble can be while retaining strong regret guarantees remains unresolved. In particular, the existing guarantees use an ensemble size of $Θ(d\log T)$, leaving a logarithmic gap in the horizon $T$ relative to the intrinsic $Ω(d)$ ensemble-size barrier. We aim to narrow this gap by proposing an ensemble sampling algorithm that refreshes the ensemble only when the regularized Gram matrix changes substantially. This mechanism localizes the perturbation analysis to epochs with controlled Gram-matrix drift and reduces the sufficient ensemble size to $Θ(d\log d+d\log\log T)$, while preserving the state-of-the-art $\tilde O(d^{3/2}\sqrt T)$ regret for ensemble sampling with arbitrary bounded arm sets. We further show that, when the arm set is finite of cardinality $K$, the proposed algorithm achieves the sharper regret bound $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T\log K})$. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first ensemble-sampling guarantee that simultaneously recovers both canonical regret scalings known for randomized linear bandit algorithms: the $\tilde O(d^{3/2}\sqrt{T})$ rate for arbitrary bounded arm sets and the $\tilde O (d\sqrt{T\log K})$ rate for finite arm sets. The algorithm also admits an anytime implementation without resetting past data, and experiments show that it remains competitive with baselines while using substantially smaller ensembles.

</details>


### [204] [Tabby: An Open Pretraining Recipe for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13956)
*Shifeng Xie,Bahaeddine Abdessalem,Zehao Xiao,Youssef Attia El Hili,Ambroise Odonnat,Zhiwei Dong,Lei Zan,Themis Palpanas,Jianfeng Zhang,Lujia Pan,Keli Zhang,Malik Tiomoko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tabby是一个长上下文概率时间序列基础模型，采用encoder-only patch Transformer架构，通过扩展真实数据与合成数据预训练，支持8192长度上下文，可用于预测、分类和异常检测，相关训练流程与模型已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型在长上下文建模、训练流程透明性以及多任务统一支持方面仍存在不足，作者希望发布一个完整开放构建配方的基础模型，并提升零样本与分布外泛化能力。

Method: 模型采用encoder-only patch Transformer架构，重点在数据与训练流程：预训练语料结合扩展真实数据GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+和BLAST，以及KernelSynth和CauKerV2合成数据，其中CauKerV2通过随机采样结构因果模型组合时序动态；训练结合渐进收敛调度以产生可复用中间检查点，并对中间层采用深度分位数监督目标；提出prompt-tuning模块，在冻结预训练权重下进一步提升同分布预测性能。

Result: 145M参数骨干支持最多8,192个观测的上下文，统一服务预测、分类和异常检测。在GIFT-Eval及分布外TIME基准上取得有竞争力的零样本预测性能，同一预训练骨干还支持UCR Archive分类和TSB-AD-U零样本异常检测。

Conclusion: Tabby提供了一个长上下文、多任务、开源的时间序列基础模型及完整训练配方，验证了数据构建与训练策略对统一时序建模的有效性，为后续研究与应用提供了可复现基础。

Abstract: In this report, we release Tabby, a long context probabilistic time series foundation model, together with a complete and open recipe of how it was built. Tabby adopts an encoder-only patch Transformer architecture and concentrates the contributions on the data and the training procedure. The pretraining corpus combines an extended real-world collection, GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+ and BLAST, with synthetic data from KernelSynth and CauKerV2, an online generator that composes temporal dynamics through randomly sampled structural causal models. Training couples a progressive convergence schedule, which yields reusable intermediate checkpoints, with a deep quantile supervision objective for intermediate layers. The resulting 145M parameter backbone supports contexts of up to 8,192 observations and serves forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection, while a prompt-tuning module further improves in-distribution forecasting performance with the pretrained weights frozen. Tabby achieves competitive zero-shot forecasting performance on GIFT-Eval and the out-of-distribution TIME benchmark, while the same pretrained backbone also supports classification on the UCR Archive and zero-shot anomaly detection on TSB-AD-U. We release training pipeline and model as open source at huawei-noah/trustworthyAI.

</details>


### [205] [Data-Efficient Agentic Graph Domain Adaptation via Reliability-Aware Prototype Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14045)
*Yingxu Wang,Kunyu Zhang,Siyang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DEAG，一种可靠性感知的原型学习框架，用于数据高效场景下的图域自适应（GDA），通过构建稳定可复用的源锚点、原型感知的软目标关联和源先验正则，在有限源数据预算下提升自适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图域自适应通常假设源图标注充足，但在数据高效的智能体场景中，仅能保留有限的源证据。此时源语义不可靠，导致源锚定不稳定、目标关联不确定以及目标边缘校准脆弱，现有方法难以适用。

Method: DEAG基于保留的源支撑度与嵌入紧致度估计类别可靠性；将经验原型与分类器方向融合，构建稳定可复用的源锚点；以锚点引导进行原型感知的软目标关联，并将置信度加权的目标中心与源语义对齐；引入源先验正则项，锐化目标预测并保持目标边缘分布与保留的源证据一致。

Result: 在具有多样域偏移的图基准数据集上，在相同源数据预算条件下，DEAG相较具竞争力的GDA基线提升了平均自适应性能。

Conclusion: DEAG通过可靠性感知的原型学习有效缓解了有限源数据下的源语义不可靠问题，为数据高效的智能体图域自适应提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Agentic learning systems are often required to adapt after deployment by observing new data and reusing prior knowledge under limited supervision or feedback. For graph-structured prediction, Graph Domain Adaptation (GDA) naturally instantiates this setting by transferring knowledge from labeled source graphs to unlabeled target graphs under distribution shifts. However, most GDA methods assume sufficient labeled source graphs, which becomes restrictive in data-efficient agentic settings where only limited source evidence can be retained. Under such constraints, source semantics become unreliable, leading to unstable source anchoring, uncertain target association, and fragile targetmarginal calibration. To address these challenges, we propose DEAG, a reliability-aware prototype learning framework for data-efficient agentic GDA. DEAG estimates class reliability from retained source support and embedding compactness, and constructs stable reusable source anchors by blending empirical prototypes with classifier directions. Guided by these anchors, DEAG performs prototype-aware soft target association and aligns confidence-weighted target centers with source semantics. A source-prior regularizer further sharpens target predictions while keeping the target marginal consistent with retained source evidence. Experiments on graph benchmarks with diverse domain shifts show that DEAG improves average adaptation performance over competitive GDA baselines under the same source-data budget.

</details>


### [206] [Stabilizing Performative Feedback Loops with Minimal Model Deployments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14065)
*Gabriele Farina,Juan Carlos Perdomo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究预测模型与数据分布之间存在反馈回路时的"表演性稳定"（performative stability）问题，提出一种在高精度区间内以近乎最少的模型部署次数找到随机表演性稳定预测器的算法，并给出在弱表演效应与良态损失假设下将其去随机化为确定性预测器的结构性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当算法预测反过来影响人们决策时，模型具有表演性并主动塑造所观测到的数据分布。不同预测模型会诱导不同分布，因此传统的监督学习范式（分布固定）不再适用，学习者必须实际部署不同预测器并观测其诱导的分布。核心挑战在于：能否高效地学习到对自身所诱导分布最优的预测规则，即表演性稳定解，同时尽量减少昂贵的模型部署次数。

Method: 作者构建了表演性稳定与"期望变分不等式"（expected variational inequalities）之间此前未被充分探索的技术联系，并在此基础上设计新的算法流程，无需对预测如何塑造分布作任何假设，即可在高精度区间内找到随机表演性稳定预测器。此外，通过结构性分析，在损失函数良态且表演效应较弱的假设下，将该随机稳定解去随机化（derandomize）为满足经典确定性稳定概念的单一预测器。

Result: 所提算法以近乎最少的模型部署次数找到随机表演性稳定模型，且不依赖任何关于预测如何影响分布的假设；相比既有方法，其模型部署次数呈指数级减少。同时证明了在损失良态与表演效应较弱的条件下，随机稳定性可被转化为单个确定性预测器。

Conclusion: 该工作通过将表演性稳定问题重新表述为期望变分不等式，显著提升了求解表演性稳定预测器的部署效率，并在适度假设下恢复了确定性稳定解，为算法与环境的反馈回路下的社会预测提供了更高效且更具理论统一性的学习框架。

Abstract: When algorithmic predictions inform people's decisions, the models we deploy are performative and actively shape the data we see. This feedback loop between algorithms and their broader environments introduces a challenge in the mechanics of social prediction: If different predictive models induce different distributions, is it possible to efficiently learn a prediction rule that is optimal for the distribution that it induces? Formally, this solution concept is known as performative stability. A core challenge in learning a performatively stable predictor is that, unlike supervised learning where distributions are fixed, the learner must deploy different predictors and observe their induced distributions.
  The main contribution of our work is a new algorithmic procedure that, in the high-accuracy regime, finds a performatively stable model in nearly the minimum number of model deployments without making any assumptions regarding how predictions shape distributions. In particular, our procedure succeeds at finding a randomized performatively stable predictor using exponentially fewer model deployments than prior approaches. Our second main contribution is a structural result showing how this recent randomized notion of stability achieved by our algorithm can be derandomized into a single predictor satisfying the prior deterministic notion if one is willing to assume that the loss is well-conditioned and that performative effects are weak, as in early work in this area. On a technical level, our results come from building on an underexplored technical connection between performative stability and expected variational inequalities.

</details>


### [207] [Multi-Modal Tumor Survival Prediction via Graph-Guided Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14072)
*H Mathavan,H Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种图引导的混合专家（MoE）框架，将多个模型作为工具进行自动调用与集成，用于多模态肿瘤生存预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽具备少样本学习能力，但在涉及多模态与多步推理的复杂真实任务（如基于临床数据、细胞切片和基因组预测癌症患者生存期）上仍面临挑战。现有方法往往无法同时考虑所有模态，且难以处理模态缺失、模态差异与多模态数据融合问题，导致性能受限。

Method: 受LLM尤其是MoE模型的启发，提出一种图引导的MoE框架。该框架利用图结构管理预测过程，并结合多个模型以增强预测能力；不训练单一端到端基础模型，而是采用MoE引导的集成方式，将各模型作为工具进行自动调用与编排。

Result: 在TCGA-LUAD数据集上的实验与分析表明，该方法的性能优于单一模态模型和普通（vanilla）集成模型。

Conclusion: 通过借助现有模型的优势并以MoE框架进行引导，可在复杂真实任务中获得更优性能与更准确的预测，为多模态肿瘤生存预测提供有效方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have displayed impressive capabilities in handling tasks that require few demonstration examples, making them effective few-shot learners. Despite their potential, LLMs face challenges when it comes to addressing complex real-world tasks that involve multiple modalities or reasoning steps. For example, predicting cancer patients' survival period based on clinical data, cell slides, and genomics poses significant logistical complexities. Although several approaches have been proposed to tackle these challenges, they often fall short in achieving promising performance due to their inability to consider all modalities simultaneously or account for missing modalities, variations in modalities, and the integration of multi-modal data, ultimately compromising their effectiveness. This thesis proposes a novel approach for multi-modal tumor survival prediction to address these limitations. Taking inspiration from recent advancements in LLMs, particularly Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based models, a graph-guided MoE framework is introduced. This framework utilizes a graph structure to manage the predictions effectively and combines multiple models to enhance predictive power. Rather than training a single foundation model for end-to-end survival prediction, the approach leverages a MOE-guided ensemble to manage model callings as tools automatically. By leveraging the strengths of existing models and guiding them through a MOE framework, the aim is to achieve better performance and more accurate predictions in complex real-world tasks. Experiments and analysis on the TCGA-LUAD dataset show improved performance over the individual modal and vanilla ensemble models.

</details>


### [208] [To do($x$) or not to do($x$): Medical Image Counterfactuals for Dataset Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14124)
*Yasin Ibrahim,Robin J. Evans,Konstantinos Kamnitsas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文辨析医学影像增强中"反事实"的两种含义（因果干预 vs. 非因果图像编辑），系统比较确定性、无向与因果三种条件生成策略，评估其对下游性能与公平性的影响，表明因果式合成数据生成可带来实质收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像数据集常存在偏倚，导致模型有偏且临床适用性受限；用合成图像扩充训练数据是缓解策略之一，但"反事实（CF）"一词在文献中被混用（因果干预与常规条件生成/图像编辑），其区别及实际后果尚不明确。

Method: 将合成数据生成的条件策略分为三类并对比：确定性（改变选定变量、固定其余变量）、无向（依据学到的统计关联更新变量、不指定因果方向）、因果（沿有向因果图传播干预）。分析这些选择对生成图像的影响，并考察因果方法在何种情况下改善数据集增强、何时收益有限，重点评估下游性能与公平性（即跨敏感子群对数据集偏倚的敏感度降低）。

Result: 实验表明，采用因果方法生成合成训练数据可带来可测量的收益；同时揭示了因果式增强相对于确定性与无向策略的优势及其适用边界。

Conclusion: 该研究厘清了反事实生成中因果与非因果方法的区别及其对医学影像增强的实际影响，为机器学习实践者设计有效的数据生成协议提供了指导。

Abstract: Medical image analysis is often hindered by biased datasets, which can lead to biased models and limited clinical applicability. A promising strategy for mitigating such biases is to augment training data with synthetic images. Counterfactual (CF) generation is one such strategy, though the term is used in two different senses: in some works, CFs are produced through causality-based interventions derived from structural causal models, whereas in others, they are produced by non-causal image edits or conventional conditional generative models, such as altering anatomy or adding pathologies. In this work, we study this distinction and evaluate its practical consequences for medical image augmentation. We compare three conditioning strategies: $\textit{Deterministic}$, which changes selected variables while holding the remaining variables fixed; $\textit{Undirected}$, which updates variables according to learned statistical associations without assigning causal directions; and $\textit{Causal}$, which propagates interventions along a directed causal graph. We analyse how these choices affect the resulting images, and explore when causally grounded methods improve dataset augmentation or bring limited benefit. In particular, we assess downstream performance and fairness, where fairness refers to reduced sensitivity to dataset biases across sensitive subgroups. Our experiments demonstrate that using a causal approach to synthetic training data generation can lead to tangible benefits, with these insights offering valuable guidance to machine learning practitioners for the effective design of data generation protocols.

</details>


### [209] [LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14138)
*Siddharth Sharma,Nilesh Prasad Pandey,Onat Gungor,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LIMBO，一个面向终身学习LLM智能体的在线推理时内存分配框架，将经验回放视为可控制的推理资源，联合优化内存策略与推理预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在复杂工作流中需持续学习新能力并保持旧任务能力。经验回放虽能利用过往交互，但每次回放都会与检索、推理、工具使用和验证争夺有限的提示与计算预算。现有方法采用固定回放策略，不考虑回放对当前任务是否有益，导致资源浪费。

Method: 作者将问题定义为推理时内存分配（inference-time memory allocation），并提出LIMBO框架：将内存作为可控的推理时资源，针对每个新任务联合优化内存策略与推理预算；无需模型权重、教师监督或离线重训练，在单次前向过程中在线学习分配策略，显式平衡任务性能与推理成本，且不修改底层智能体。

Result: 在LifelongAgentBench上使用三种LLM主干进行实验，LIMBO相比最先进的内存增强基线取得更好的成本-准确率权衡，在推理成本降低最多约83%（平均约53%）的情况下，性能几乎匹配所有最强基线。

Conclusion: LIMBO能跨模型和环境自适应调整策略而无需重训练，表明有效的内存分配可以在线学习而非人工指定。

Abstract: As LLM agents become integrated into increasingly complex workflows, they must continually acquire new capabilities while retaining competence on previously learned tasks. Lifelong agents address this through experience replay, injecting past interactions into the prompt to leverage prior experience during inference. However, replay is not free: every replayed trajectory competes with retrieval, reasoning, tool use, and verification for the same limited prompt and compute budget, making effective resource allocation essential. Existing approaches allocate these resources using fixed replay policies, regardless of whether replay is beneficial for the current task. We identify this as inference-time memory allocation, a distinct problem class for lifelong agents, and introduce LIMBO: the first online framework to our knowledge that treats memory as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly optimizes memory strategy and inference budget for each incoming task. Unlike prior approaches that fix the replay policy or require model weights, teacher supervision, or offline retraining, LIMBO learns this allocation online in a single pass, explicitly balancing task performance and inference cost without modifying the underlying agent. Across three LLM backbones on LifelongAgentBench, LIMBO achieves better cost-accuracy tradeoffs than state-of-the-art memory-augmented baselines and nearly matches all strongest such baselines at up to ~83% lower inference cost (~53% on average). LIMBO adapts its policy across models and environments without retraining, demonstrating that effective allocation can be learned online rather than manually specified.

</details>


### [210] [T-SMART: Mechanism-Level Attribution for Tool-Augmented Time-Series Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14142)
*Ivan Delgado,Himansi Gupta,Bishal Khatri,Niharika Sapre,Lameta Shamoon,Onat Gungor,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经符号框架 T-SMART，将时间序列问答中的语言理解、数值计算与结构化感知解耦，通过配对消融实验量化各组件贡献，发现确定性计算是性能提升的主要来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具增强方法将语言推理、计算与感知交织在一起，难以判断究竟是哪些组件带来了性能增益，缺乏对神经符号时间序列系统中各组件贡献的可控分析。

Method: 提出 T-SMART 神经符号框架，明确分离各角色：冻结的 LLM 负责解析问题并选择操作，确定性工具负责数值计算，结构化感知仅在需要时调用；并通过受控的配对消融实验评估各组件的独立贡献。

Result: 确定性计算带来主导性收益，在序列化时间序列任务上相较 LLM 直接推理准确率提升 31.7 个百分点；语言理解与感知提供较小的互补增益。

Conclusion: 工具增强的时间序列问答主要受益于可靠的数值执行，而非额外的语言模型推理；该框架为分析神经符号时间序列系统中各组件的贡献提供了受控方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can struggle with time-series question answering (TS-QA), especially when numerical signals are serialized as text and require explicit computation. Tool-augmented approaches improve performance, but existing systems often intertwine language reasoning, computation, and perception, making it difficult to determine which components drive the gains. We present T-SMART, a neurosymbolic framework that separates these roles: a frozen LLM interprets questions and selects operations, deterministic tools perform numerical computation, and structured perception is invoked only when needed. Controlled paired ablations show that deterministic computation provides the dominant benefit, improving accuracy by 31.7 percentage points over direct LLM reasoning on serialized time series, while language understanding and perception offer smaller complementary gains. These results indicate that tool-augmented TS-QA benefits primarily from reliable numerical execution rather than additional language-model reasoning and provide a controlled framework for analyzing component contributions in neurosymbolic time-series systems.

</details>


### [211] [Signatures of Steerability in Activation Space of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14151)
*Prajjwal Bhattarai,Tuka Alhanai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明简单的可分性度量与语言模型激活引导（activation steering）的下游可引导性高度相关，可作为预测引导向量是否有效的实用诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导是一种常用且计算高效的控制语言模型行为的方法，但其有效性在不同概念上差异显著。现有观点认为引导向量的泛化性取决于构建它的数据集，本文旨在使这一"数据集依赖性"论断更加严谨，并寻找能预测引导效果的指标。

Method: 提出并验证"数据集依赖性"论断；计算简单分离度指标（separation metrics），在控制层数与数据集效应后，考察其与下游可引导性的相关性；并通过合成叠加（superposition）实验，分析分离度指标与经验特征方向和真实特征方向之间对齐度的关系。

Result: 在多样设置下，简单的分离度指标与语言模型的下游可引导性强烈相关，即便在控制层和数据集效应后仍成立；合成叠加实验表明，分离度指标与经验特征方向和真实特征方向之间的对齐度也强相关。

Conclusion: 简单的可分性统计量可作为实用诊断工具，用于预判引导向量何时可能奏效，从而为激活引导的可靠应用提供依据。

Abstract: Steering language models using a set of contrastive representations has been a canonical and computationally efficient method for controlling model behavior. Despite this success in controlling certain model behaviors, the effectiveness of activation steering varies markedly across concepts; the generalization properties of steering vectors are often considered a function of the dataset used to construct them. We make this dataset-dependence claim more rigorous and show that simple separation metrics strongly correlate with the downstream steerability of language models across diverse settings, even after controlling for layers and dataset effects. Beyond prediction, we provide evidence from a synthetic superposition experiment that separation metrics are strongly correlated with alignment between the empirical and true feature direction. Our results suggest that simple separability statistics can serve as practical diagnostics for when steering vectors are likely to work.

</details>


### [212] [CyFM: Cylindrical Optimal Transport for Few-Step Complex-Valued Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14171)
*Marcel Musiałek,Iga Wolanin,Damian Ryczko,Anna Grelewska,Oleksii Furman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将复值信号（MRI、音频谱图）从平坦二通道欧氏建模改为圆柱几何 $(0,\infty)\times S^1$ 上的乘积度量 $dA^2+d\theta^2$，通过解析桥接、流匹配（CyFM）与精确 minibatch 最优传输耦合，量化这一替换的代价与收益，并用合成复值场实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复值信号通常被当作平坦二通道欧氏数据建模，忽略了幅度-相位结构。作者希望探究改用解耦乘积度量的圆柱几何 $(0,\infty)\times S^1$ 会带来什么代价与收益，尤其是直角坐标路径导致的角速度重尾问题。

Method: 计算精确解析桥接，分析笛卡尔路径诱导的角速度分布；提出 Cylindrical Flow Matching（CyFM），严格约束回归目标，并以在圆柱度量下对整场联合计算的精确 minibatch 最优传输耦合噪声与数据；同时研究逐维/逐块传输分解的影响。

Result: 笛卡尔路径产生重尾角速度分布（幂律指数约1.0），独立耦合下近一半概率路径角速度超过 $\pi$，圆柱路径从未超过。传输成本降低随场维度从标量对的86%塌缩至 $64\times64$ 场的3%，但对少步生成的收益不塌缩：各分辨率下将圆柱模型少步误差降低3-60%。在该耦合下，CyFM 在 $k\le 8$ 所有步数与所有评测分辨率上误差均低于最佳笛卡尔基线，五个随机种子完全分离且无蒸馏；收敛时两种几何无显著差异。此外揭示了“Factorized Coupling Trap”：逐维或逐块传输分解会悄然破坏数据联合分布。

Conclusion: 圆柱几何配以整场精确最优传输耦合在少步复值场生成上优于笛卡尔基线，尽管其传输成本优势随维度塌缩；收敛后两几何无显著差异，且传输分解会破坏联合分布。

Abstract: Complex-valued signals, such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and audio spectrograms, are almost always modelled as flat two-channel Euclidean data. For nonzero values the amplitude-phase chart $z \mapsto (|z|, z/|z|)$ identifies the signal domain with the cylinder $(0, \infty) \times S^1$, on which we deliberately replace the inherited metric $dA^2 + A^2 dθ^2$ by the decoupled product metric $dA^2 + dθ^2$. In this empirical study we measure what that substitution costs and what it buys. By computing exact analytical bridges, we demonstrate that Cartesian paths induce a heavy-tailed distribution of angular velocity (power law index $\approx 1.0$), with nearly half of the probability paths exceeding an angular speed of $π$ under independent coupling, a rate no cylindrical path ever exceeds. To resolve this, we analyze Cylindrical Flow Matching (CyFM), which strictly bounds the regression target, and couple noise and data by exact minibatch Optimal Transport computed jointly over whole fields in the cylindrical metric. Although the transport-cost reduction of this coupling collapses with field dimension (from 86% for scalar pairs to 3% for $64\times64$ fields), its benefit to few-step generation does not: it lowers the few-step error of the cylindrical model by 3-60% at every evaluated resolution. With this coupling, CyFM has a lower error than the best Cartesian baseline at every step count up to $k = 8$ and every evaluated resolution, with all five seeds separated and without distillation, and at convergence we detect no significant difference between the two geometries. Finally, we expose the "Factorized Coupling Trap," showing that dimension-wise or patch-wise transport factorizations silently destroy the joint distribution of the data. All experiments are on synthetic complex fields.

</details>


### [213] [Inherited Heads: Audio language models track speakers with their text backbone's attention, and an attention-mass ranking retrieves a different set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14174)
*Bojro Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在"追踪指定说话人"任务上，音频语言模型仅6–16%正确率（低于16.7%的随机猜测）；对不到十分之一注意力头注入固定偏置即可把描述导向任选说话人，成功率90.7–99.0%，且这些头大多并非音频特异，可直接从纯文本同族模型的Top-100头迁移，效果80.8–95.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频语言模型在多人语音中难以正确描述被问及的说话人，作者希望以极低成本（无训练、仅少量注意力头）实现可控的说话人定向描述，并检验这种可控性是否依赖音频模态特有的机制，还是继承了底层纯文本语言模型的注意力结构。

Method: 在六说话人录音任务上，对少量注意力头的logits加入固定偏置（无训练），观察能否将输出描述重定向到指定说话人；将纯文本模型或同族公开模型在改写为文本版任务上的Top-100头原样迁移到音频模型；比较音频与文本头集合的重合度及共有部分单独的操控效果；并对比两种头发现准则——"注意力落在被问片段上的量"（既有评分）与逐头归一化的"注意力随问题变化的量"。

Result: 注入偏置后重定向成功率达90.7–99.0%；文本Top-100头零改动迁移后达80.8–95.0%；音频与文本头集合重合66–74/100（随机约20），共有部分即可复现几乎全部操控效果，但同等规模的随机抽样头效果接近，三个模型均无法区分"共享性"与"头部本身有效"两种解释。两种准则选出的Top-100头在三模型间仅重合69、37、4个；在Ultravox（重合4）中，既有评分所选头导致69.7%的试次输出无法被判定为任何片段，高于无干预的40.0%，而归一化变体仅1.0%；六个实验臂中仅此一臂上既有评分优于随机抽样。

Conclusion: 少量注意力头即可对音频语言模型的说话人描述实现强定向控制，且该能力主要继承自文本模型而非音频特异；但"跨模态共享"并非头部有效的充分解释，随机同规模头表现相近，现有模型无法辨析两种机制。头发现准则差异显著：既有评分在多数情形不优于随机，其归一化变体更稳健，提示头部选择方法本身存在可靠性问题。

Abstract: Asked to describe what one of six speakers in a recording talks about, audio language models describe the right one on 6 to 16% of trials, below the 16.7% a guess would give. Adding a fixed bias to the attention logits of a hundred heads, under a tenth of the model's and with no training, redirects the description to whichever speaker we choose, on 90.7% to 99.0% of trials. Those heads are largely not specific to audio. Rank the text-only language model an audio model was built from, or a released model of the same family, on a written version of the task, take its top hundred heads, and carry them over unchanged: they redirect the audio model on 80.8% to 95.0% of trials, with nothing about audio entering the selection. The audio and text head sets share 66 to 74 of 100 where chance would give about 20, and the shared part alone reproduces almost all of the steering. What that does not show is that sharing is what makes the heads work: an equal-sized draw from the same discovered hundred does nearly as well, and none of our three models separates the two explanations. A second finding concerns how such heads are found. Ranking heads by how much attention they place on the segment asked about, as an established score does, or by how much of their attention moves with the question, as a per-head normalised variant does, gives top hundreds that share 69, 37 and 4 heads across our three models. In Ultravox, where they share 4, the established score's heads leave output the judge cannot place on any segment on 69.7% of trials, against 40.0% with no intervention and 1.0% for the normalised variant. That is one arm of six; on the other five the established score steers above a random draw.

</details>


### [214] [A Machine Learning Framework for Fault Detection, Isolation, and Severity Prediction of Autonomous VTOL Aircraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14180)
*Ripon C. Sarker,Pedram H. Dabaghian,Raman Goyal,Atanu Halder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于CNN的机器学习框架，利用真实飞行数据实现自主VTOL多旋翼的旋翼故障检测、隔离与损伤程度预测，实验分类准确率超99%、严重度估计准确率达96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主VTOL飞行器在复杂安全攸关环境中，即使微小部件退化也可能迅速导致多旋翼失稳，因此需要能识别旋翼损伤早期迹象的鲁棒故障检测与估计策略；但真实飞行中的故障检测受传感器噪声、环境扰动及非线性气动特性影响，仍具挑战性。

Method: 构建综合性机器学习框架，设计卷积神经网络（CNN）架构，从多元飞行动力学数据中学习时空模式，直接推断故障旋翼及其损伤等级；先用数据生成模型产生的仿真数据验证，再在六旋翼飞行器上通过受控桨尖断裂开展实验验证。

Result: 训练模型在实验数据上实现逐旋翼故障分类准确率超过99%，在1%容差内严重度估计准确率达96%，表现出较强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该框架可支撑自主VTOL系统的实时健康监测，为真实飞行条件下的旋翼故障检测、隔离与严重度评估提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Fault detection in autonomous VTOL aircraft is critical because even minor component degradations can rapidly destabilize multirotor vehicles operating in complex, safety-critical environments, motivating robust fault detection and estimation strategies capable of identifying early signs of rotor damage; however, real-flight fault detection remains challenging due to sensor noise, environmental disturbances, and the nonlinear aerodynamics of multirotor platforms. This study proposes a comprehensive machine-learning framework for rotor fault detection, isolation, and severity prediction using real flight data. A convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture is developed to learn spatio-temporal patterns from multivariate flight dynamics, enabling direct inference of both the faulted rotor and its damage level. The framework is first validated using simulated data generated by a data-generative model, and experimental validation is then performed on a hexacopter by introducing controlled blade-tip breakage. The trained model achieves rotor-wise fault classification accuracies above 99% and severity estimation accuracy of 96% within a 1% tolerance in experimental data, demonstrating strong generalization and supporting real-time health monitoring for autonomous VTOL systems.

</details>


### [215] [ZAPS: Zero-Cost Active Proxy Search for Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14184)
*Hassan Touayouch,Rabie Najem,Mohammed Benjelloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZAPS是一个四阶段零成本代理主动搜索框架，首次在同一主动学习流程中融合代理信号与架构拓扑，在NAS-Bench-201上以B=200预算取得优于随机搜索、局部搜索、REA、BANANAS、TPE的top-100召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS需训练至收敛才能评估单个候选，穷举搜索不可行；零成本代理虽秒级估计架构质量，但单一代理噪声大，而多个代理高度相关，朴素聚合会叠加共同误差而非相互抵消。已有方法或仅利用代理信号、或仅利用架构拓扑，未在单一主动学习框架中同时使用两者。

Method: ZAPS四阶段流程：(i) 离线用ProxyFit（贪心抗冗余准则）选出紧凑非冗余的代理子集；(ii) 用混合K-means策略初始化搜索，平衡利用与探索；(iii) 随标注集增长，每轮通过bootstrap投票重选代理；(iv) 用XGBoost集成联合学习代理排名与one-hot拓扑编码进行候选排序，并通过UCB采集函数查询。

Result: 在NAS-Bench-201、B=200预算下，ZAPS在CIFAR-10上召回真实top-100的52.3%、CIFAR-100上65.8%，优于Random Search、Local Search、REA、BANANAS与TPE，且在CIFAR-10上运行间标准差不到最强基线的二分之一。优势在评估稀缺时最大：NAS-Bench-201上随预算增大而收窄，而在更难、无方法接近饱和的NAS-Bench-101上反而扩大。所有方法统一以"实际评估的架构中包含多少真实top-100"为评价标准。

Conclusion: 将抗冗余代理选择、动态代理重选与拓扑感知的代理-拓扑联合建模结合进主动学习，可在极少评估预算下显著提升NAS候选排序质量，尤其在评估稀缺场景优势突出。

Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) automates network design, but evaluating a single candidate requires training it to convergence, making exhaustive search intractable. Zero-cost proxies estimate architecture quality at initialization in seconds, yet a single proxy is noisy, and combining several does not straightforwardly help: proxies are strongly correlated, so naive aggregation compounds their shared errors instead of averaging them out. Existing methods exploit either proxy signals or architectural topology - never both within a single active-learning framework. We introduce ZAPS (Zero-cost Active Proxy Search), a four-stage pipeline that closes this gap. ZAPS (i) selects a compact, non-redundant proxy subset offline via ProxyFit, a greedy anti-redundancy criterion; (ii) seeds the search with a hybrid K-means strategy that balances exploitation and exploration; (iii) re-selects proxies at every iteration by a bootstrapped vote as the labeled set grows; and (iv) ranks candidates with an XGBoost ensemble trained jointly on proxy ranks and one-hot topological encodings, queried through an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) acquisition function. On NAS-Bench-201 under a budget of B=200 evaluations, ZAPS recovers 52.3% of the true top-100 architectures on CIFAR-10 and 65.8% on CIFAR-100, ahead of every baseline we consider - Random Search, Local Search, REA, BANANAS and TPE - and, on CIFAR-10, with less than half the run-to-run standard deviation of the strongest of them. The advantage is largest where evaluations are scarce: on NAS-Bench-201 it narrows as the budget grows, whereas on the harder NAS-Bench-101, which no method comes close to saturating, it widens instead. All methods are scored by a single criterion: how much of the true top-100 lies among the architectures they actually evaluated.

</details>


### [216] [Entropy-Punctured Bloom Filters for Memory-Efficient Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14187)
*John Cartmell,Mihaela Cardei,Ionut Cardei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出熵穿孔布隆过滤器（entropy-punctured Bloom Filter），通过经验熵移除低变化比特位，实现紧凑特征表示，在回归任务中保持预测精度的同时提升存储效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在存储、传输成本、带宽或隐私受限的场景下，机器学习需要内存高效的特征表示。布隆过滤器编码虽能提供紧凑的概率表示，但其在结构化压缩下的行为及在回归任务中的适用性尚缺乏研究。

Method: 基于量化特征的定长布隆过滤器编码，利用经验熵识别并移除低变化性的比特位，生成缩减表示；在无泄漏评估协议下，将原始特征、PCA、随机投影与布隆过滤器变体在近似匹配的表示大小下进行对比，采用岭回归、XGBoost和神经网络评估，以每样本编码表示大小的R2衡量预测效率。

Result: 布隆过滤器编码与经典压缩表示具有竞争力，同时实现显著存储节省；基于熵的穿孔进一步缩小表示大小，预测保真度损失极小，预测效率得到提升。

Conclusion: 熵穿孔布隆过滤器为内存受限的机器学习提供了一种有效的表示级压缩方法。

Abstract: Memory-efficient feature representations are increasingly important in machine learning settings where storage, transmission cost, bandwidth, or privacy constraints limit access to raw data. Bloom Filter (BF) encodings provide compact probabilistic representations of engineered features, but their behavior under structural compression and their applicability to regression tasks remain underexplored.
  In this work, we propose entropy-punctured Bloom Filters, a memory-aware encoding strategy that removes low-variability bit positions identified using empirical entropy. Starting from fixed-length BF encodings of quantized features, the proposed approach produces reduced representations that preserve predictive structure while improving predictive efficiency relative to encoded representation size.
  We evaluate the approach on diverse regression datasets, comparing raw features, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Random Projection (RP), and Bloom Filter variants under leakage-free evaluation protocols and approximately matched representation sizes. Performance is assessed using ridge regression, XGBoost, and neural networks, with predictive efficiency measured as R2 relative to encoded representation size per sample.
  Results show that Bloom Filter encodings remain competitive with classical compressed representations while achieving substantial storage savings. Entropy-based puncturing further reduces representation size with minimal loss in predictive fidelity, yielding improved predictive efficiency. These findings demonstrate that entropy-punctured Bloom Filters provide an effective representation-level compression approach for memory-constrained machine learning.

</details>


### [217] [Data-free On-policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14193)
*Gengsheng Li,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Jie Sun,Zeyuan Liu,Ruiqi Liu,Qiyong Zhong,Haiyun Guo,Junfeng Fang,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现on-policy distillation (OPD)对训练数据近乎不敏感，其数据单元是prompt引发的状态而非prompt本身；据此提出无数据OPD（DF-OPD），由教师自生成问题，性能匹配甚至超越真实数据，多教师场景下1k自生成问题即达98.5%可用空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD已成为前沿后训练流程的标准组件，但其训练数据究竟贡献多少尚未被系统考察。作者希望厘清数据在OPD中的作用，并检验是否可以在无外部数据条件下完成蒸馏。

Method: 在两种常见teacher-student配对上实证：8个prompt即可匹配17k问题数据集；三个难度与KL差异数倍的数据集训练曲线几乎一致。进一步用competitive programming替换数学仍保留90%以上域内收益，说明OPD传递的是教师的推理模式而非数据相关知识。据此提出DF-OPD，教师用简单prompt自生成训练问题，无外部数据、无过滤，仅含两个策略。并扩展到多教师蒸馏场景。

Result: 8个prompt匹配17k数据集；不同数据集训练曲线几乎无差别；跨域替换保留>90%域内增益。DF-OPD匹配甚至超过真实数据，其自生成问题在三个训练动态诊断上贴合教师自身后训练数据（其他真实数据集不具备）。多教师蒸馏中1k自生成问题填补98.5%可用空间，超过7k真实样本的96.6%。

Conclusion: OPD的数据边际价值在极少prompt后即崩溃，其本质是迁移教师的推理模式；数据在OPD中的角色需要被重新评估，无数据的DF-OPD是可行且高效的替代方案。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a standard component of frontier post-training pipelines, yet how much its training data actually contributes has gone largely unexamined. On the two teacher-student pairings most common in practice, we find OPD almost indifferent to its data: eight prompts already match a 17k-problem dataset, and three independently built datasets whose difficulty and teacher-student KL differ several-fold produce nearly indistinguishable training curves. Two causes account for this. First, the unit of data in OPD is the state a prompt leads to, not the prompt itself: a single prompt keeps exposing new teacher correction as sampling continues, while the marginal value of additional prompts collapses after eight. Second, replacing mathematics with competitive programming still recovers over ninety percent of the in-domain gain, indicating that OPD transfers the teacher's mode of reasoning rather than knowledge related to the data. We take this to its limit with Data-free On-policy Distillation (DF-OPD), in which the teacher writes its own training questions under a simple prompt -- no external data, no filtering -- leaving a system of just two policies. DF-OPD matches and even surpasses real data, and the questions it produces track the teacher's own post-training data on three key diagnostics of training dynamics, which other real datasets do not. Applied to multi-teacher distillation, where the (prompt, domain) pairs normally have to be derived from post-training data that is often out of reach, 1k self-generated questions close 98.5% of the available headroom, even surpassing the 96.6% reached with 7k real examples. Moreover, together these results invite a reassessment of the role data plays in OPD.

</details>


### [218] [Graph-Transformer Fraud Detection with Self-Supervised Pretraining and Conformal Risk Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14234)
*Sergei,Komarov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GTFD：融合图结构与时序证据的图-Transformer 企业交易欺诈检测器，AUROC 0.990、F1 96.1%，误报率较最强基线降低约29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业交易网络中的财务欺诈日益呈现协同化特征，而基于规则的引擎和将每笔交易孤立处理的经典学习模型难以检测此类协同欺诈。

Method: GTFD 融合企业支付图的拓扑与时间证据：采用多头图注意力网络编码图结构，用门控 Transformer 编码有序交易序列，并通过跨模态门控层融合两路视图；由 conformal 风险控制头将融合表示转化为无阈值异常分数并具有限样本覆盖保证；训练采用自监督链路掩码预训练与对抗增强，以在标签稀缺和对抗扰动下保持稳定。

Result: 在包含协同欺诈团伙的企业交易基准上：AUROC 0.990，F1 96.1%（精确率 96.3%，召回率 95.9%），准确率 98.4%；较最强基线误报率降低约29%，协同欺诈团伙召回率由 85.1% 提升至 96.5%。消融显示自监督预训练贡献约 2.0 AUROC 点，conformal 头贡献约 1.9 AUROC 点；对抗压力测试中，扰动幅度 0.20 时 GTFD 保持 89.2% 准确率，而次优模型降至 76.4%。

Conclusion: GTFD 通过图结构与时序双视图融合、conformal 风险控制及自监督与对抗训练，在企业交易协同欺诈检测中同时提升了检测精度、团伙召回率与对抗鲁棒性。

Abstract: Financial fraud in corporate transaction networks has grown more coordinated and harder to detect with rule-based engines and with classical learning models that treat each transaction in isolation. This paper presents GTFD, a graph-transformer fraud detector that fuses structural and temporal evidence from a corporation's payment graph. GTFD encodes the graph with a multi-head graph attention network, encodes ordered transaction sequences with a gated transformer, and combines both views through a cross-modal gating layer. A conformal risk-control head converts the fused representation into threshold-free anomaly scores with finite-sample coverage guarantees, and the network is trained with self-supervised link-mask pretraining plus adversarial augmentation so it remains stable under scarce labels and under adversarial perturbation. On a corporate transaction benchmark enriched with coordinated fraud rings, GTFD reaches an AUROC of 0.990, an F1-score of 96.1% (precision 96.3%, recall 95.9%), and an accuracy of 98.4%. It reduces the false-positive rate by about 29% relative to the strongest baseline while raising coordinated fraud-ring recall from 85.1% to 96.5%. Ablations attribute roughly 2.0 AUROC points to self-supervised pretraining and 1.9 AUROC points to the conformal head, and adversarial stress tests show GTFD retains 89.2% accuracy at perturbation magnitude 0.20 where the next-best model falls to 76.4%.

</details>


### [219] [CoArena: Evaluating Computer-Use and Multi-Agent Systems in Real Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14239)
*Nitish Kovuru,Prateek Jannu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoArena 提出以真实用户提交任务、双系统并发同环境执行、盲评投票驱动排行榜实时更新的评测范式，并形式化定义"实时评测"的五个可度量属性，给出完整 Bradley-Terry 评分方法论及一个 211 票的五系统示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态基准在发布时固定任务集，虽可复现，却会老化、泄漏进训练语料，且无法跟随用户对智能体使用方式的逐周变化，因而与实际使用脱节。作者希望建立一种能直接度量真实使用、并持续演化的评测方式。

Method: 1) CoArena 机制：真实用户提交任务，两个系统（单模型或多智能体流水线，共用同一工具接口）在相同沙箱桌面中并发执行同一任务，用户在不知系统身份的情况下评判两个结果，公开排行榜据此重新拟合。2) 将"实时性"定义为五个可度量属性，各配方程与实例：任务连续到达、实时并发执行、在线评分更新、具备抗污染能力的新鲜度、从失败运行到可复用训练环境的反馈时延有界。3) 评分方法：Bradley-Terry 成对模型，带权重与平局的对数似然，惩罚最大似然估计，以及单票到达时的流式更新（同一似然的随机梯度步，可退化为 Elo）；并给出基于观测信息与聚类稳健三明治的置信区间、参数自助法得到的排名带、新系统入榜规则与估计收敛速率。4) 投票质量通过评审者间一致性统计、冗余评判、平局与弃权的显式处理来保障。5) 用五系统、211 票的示例贯穿从投票矩阵到评分、区间与排名带的全流程。

Result: 给出一个五系统、211 票的完整示例，从投票矩阵推导出评分、置信区间与排名带；文中所有数值均由给定输入推导或标注为示例性，并非对任何已部署系统的实测结果。

Conclusion: 该工作以 CoArena 为核心，将实时评测形式化为五项可测属性，并提供从投票到评分、区间、排名带的完整统计流程，为持续、抗污染、贴近真实使用的智能体评测建立了方法论基础；当前示例为方法论演示而非部署系统测量。

Abstract: Static benchmarks for computer-use agents fix a task set at release and score every system against it once. That makes them reproducible, and it lets them drift from what they should measure: a fixed task set ages, leaks into training corpora, and cannot follow how people actually use agents from week to week. CoArena measures use directly. Real users submit tasks; two systems, each a single model or a multi-agent pipeline behind the same tool interface, execute the same task concurrently in identical sandboxed desktops; users judge the two outcomes without knowing which system produced them; and a public leaderboard is refit from those judgments. The central contribution is a formal account of what makes such an evaluation real-time. We define real-time as five measurable properties, each with an equation and a worked example: continuous task arrival, live concurrent execution, online rating updates, freshness with contamination resistance, and bounded feedback latency from a failed run to a reusable training environment. The rating methodology follows in full: the Bradley-Terry pairwise model, its likelihood with weighted observations and ties, the penalized maximum-likelihood estimator, and the streaming update applied when a single vote arrives (a stochastic-gradient step on the same likelihood, recovering Elo). It gives confidence intervals from the observed information and a cluster-robust sandwich, rank bands from a parametric bootstrap, the rule by which a new system enters the board, and the convergence rate of the estimate. Vote quality is treated with inter-judge agreement statistics, redundant judging, and explicit handling of ties and abstentions. A five-system example with 211 votes is carried from the vote matrix to ratings, intervals, and rank bands. Every number is derived from stated inputs or labeled illustrative; none is a measurement of a deployed system.

</details>


### [220] [Bayesian optimization with kernel ensembles and disagreement-based acquisition for source localization and acoustic inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14262)
*Heng Zhang,Haotian Xiang,Florian Meyer,Qin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多核高斯过程加权集成代理与最优条件采集函数的贝叶斯优化方法，用于联合声源定位与地声反演，在模拟及SWellEx-96实测数据上取得最低平均最终目标值并降低多数坐标的参数估计误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合声源定位与地声反演的目标函数由昂贵的简正波传播模型构建，计算成本高。基于高斯过程代理的贝叶斯优化虽能在有限前向模型评估次数内获得较准的参数估计，但其性能高度依赖核函数族的选择；在七维搜索空间、观测样本稀少的条件下，任何单一核都难以在所有反演任务中稳定表现，因此需要降低对核选择的依赖。

Method: 采用不同核函数族的高斯过程加权集成作为代理模型，使其能根据观测到的目标函数自适应调整，而无需预先锁定单一核；同时结合最优条件采集函数（optimum-conditioned acquisition function）决定下一个昂贵目标评估的位置。

Result: 在模拟数据与SWellEx-96实测数据上的实验表明，该方法在所比较的贝叶斯优化策略中取得最低的平均最终目标值，并在大多数坐标上降低了参数估计误差。消融实验进一步显示，集成策略提供了对核选择的鲁棒性，而采集函数贡献了大部分优化增益。

Conclusion: 多核高斯过程加权集成与最优条件采集函数相结合，可有效缓解贝叶斯优化对核函数族的依赖，在联合声源定位与地声反演任务中提升优化效果与参数估计精度；其中采集函数是性能提升的主要来源，集成主要带来鲁棒性。

Abstract: Joint source localization and geoacoustic inversion requires optimizing an objective built from an expensive normal mode propagation model. Bayesian optimization (BO) with a Gaussian process (GP) surrogate can obtain accurate parameter estimates within a limited number of forward model evaluations, but its performance depends on the choice of kernel family. With few observations in a seven-dimensional search space, no single kernel can be expected to perform consistently well across individual inversions. To reduce this dependence, we use a weighted ensemble of GPs with different kernel families, allowing the surrogate to adapt to the observed objective without committing to one kernel in advance. The ensemble is combined with an optimum-conditioned acquisition function that determines where the expensive objective should be evaluated next. Experiments on simulated and measured SWellEx-96 data show that the resulting method achieves the lowest mean final objective among the considered BO strategies and reduces parameter estimation error on most coordinates. Ablation results further show that the ensemble provides robustness to kernel choice, while the acquisition function accounts for most of the optimization gain.

</details>


### [221] [Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14279)
*Rushan Geng,Cuicui Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BSCA，一种在双四元数框架内结合圆旋转与双曲旋转的时序知识图谱嵌入模型，并用复值注意力机制自适应融合时间条件与关系条件的实体表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TKGE模型多采用单一几何空间，难以刻画多样的关系模式；同时常将实体表示视为静态，无法随时间与关系上下文变化。作者希望同时解决这两个局限。

Method: BSCA在统一的双四元数空间中同时进行圆旋转（circular rotation）与双曲旋转（hyperbolic rotation），以兼容不同关系模式；并设计复值注意力机制（complex-valued attention），自适应融合时间条件（time-conditioned）与关系条件（relation-conditioned）的实体表示，使其随时间和关系上下文动态变化。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上取得有竞争力的性能；在GDELT上提升最大，MRR达到52.1%，而对比中最强基线为38.1%。

Conclusion: 在统一双四元数框架中整合两种旋转并结合复值注意力融合动态实体表示，是提升时序知识图谱推理的有效途径，且在时间敏感数据集（如GDELT）上优势尤为明显。

Abstract: Temporal knowledge graph embedding (TKGE) models infer missing facts in knowledge graphs that evolve over time. Many existing models use a single geometric space, which can limit their ability to represent diverse relational patterns, or treat entity representations as static. We propose Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention (BSCA), a TKGE model that combines circular and hyperbolic rotations within a unified biquaternionic framework. A complex-valued attention mechanism adaptively fuses time-conditioned and relation-conditioned entity representations, allowing them to vary with temporal and relational context. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show competitive performance across datasets, with the largest improvement on GDELT: BSCA achieves an MRR of 52.1\%, compared with 38.1\% for the strongest baseline in our comparison.

</details>


### [222] [Learning Source Acquisition Policies by Offline Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14299)
*Ziqi Zhao,Run Xu,Qingjian Ni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: O-MPAC将有限时域的风险-成本目标从完整训练记录迁移到共享的源-动作打分器，在推理时利用部分观测与源元数据、逐次查询重打分并施加硬成本掩码，从而在采集预算下预测特征组价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在采集预算约束下进行预测时，需要选择特征组，而其特征价值依赖于后续查询。因此需要一种能在部分观测下动态决策、并兼顾成本与风险目标的策略。

Method: 提出O-MPAC：把完整训练记录中的有限时域风险-成本目标迁移到共享的源-动作打分器；推理阶段使用部分观测和源元数据，每次查询后重新打分，并应用硬成本掩码。同时分析绑定的教师目标与剩余规划时域对决策的影响，并用对绑定最小值的均匀监督来保证源重标记下的目标分布不变。

Result: 五种子路由实验中，在原始顺序和上下文最后顺序下均达到0.965准确率；六个真实任务的三十个划分中，验证均选择不含动作交叉熵的H1；在五个任务上，O-MPAC的预算积分平均准确率高于源适配的GDFS、DIME、AACO+NN及静态策略。

Conclusion: O-MPAC在采集预算下实现了稳定且具竞争力的动态特征选择决策，其目标迁移与均匀监督设计有助于提升鲁棒性与预算效率。

Abstract: Predicting under an acquisition budget requires choosing feature groups whose value can depend on later queries. O-MPAC transfers finite-horizon risk-cost targets from complete training records into a shared source-action scorer. At inference time, the scorer uses partial observations and source metadata, re-scores after each query, and applies a hard cost mask. We analyze how tied teacher targets and the remaining planning horizon affect the learned decisions. Uniform supervision over tied minima preserves the target distribution under source relabeling. In a five-seed routing experiment, it achieves 0.965 accuracy under both original and context-last orders. On six real tasks, validation selects H1 without action cross-entropy in all thirty splits. O-MPAC has the highest mean budget-integrated accuracy on five tasks against source-adapted GDFS, DIME, AACO+NN and a static policy.

</details>


### [223] [Nonparametric Variance-Penalized Actor-Critic: Statistical Inference for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14327)
*Saunak Kumar Panda,Tong Li,Yisha Xiang,Ruiqi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出非参数方差惩罚演员-评论家框架（VPAC），用基于自举与随机缩放的在线方差估计器替代方差评论家网络，保持单评论家架构，并在温和有界性条件下证明几乎必然收敛；实验表明其方差降低效果达到或超越双评论家基线，并在高温超导制造案例中大幅降低稳态临界电流波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险敏感强化学习需要通过方差惩罚在期望回报与策略稳定性之间权衡，但现有方法依赖专用第二评论家网络在线估计回报方差，导致架构复杂、估计误差叠加。论文希望消除额外网络开销，同时保持理论可分析性和实用性。

Method: 提出非参数方差惩罚演员-评论家（VPAC）框架，用来自随机逼近统计推断文献的自举（bootstrapping）和随机缩放（random scaling）在线估计器替代方差评论家；估计器无需辅助网络、维持单评论家架构，且构造上方差惩罚有界。通过常微分方程（ODE）方法，在仅要求方差估计有界（而非一致）的条件下，证明方差惩罚Q学习与双时间尺度演员-评论家变体的几乎必然收敛。

Result: 在离散与连续随机环境中评估，所提方法达到或超过现有双评论家VPAC基线的方差降低效果，同时消除第二评论家开销；在高温超导（HTS）制造案例中，VPAC-RS（随机缩放）实现稳态临界电流变异性降低74%、回合回报标准差降低63%，直接改善良率一致性。

Conclusion: 结果确立非参数统计推断作为风险敏感强化学习中辅助评论家的实用且理论完备的替代方案。

Abstract: Variance penalization is a principled approach to risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) that explicitly trades expected return for policy stability. Existing methods require a dedicated second critic to estimate return variance online, adding architectural complexity and compounding estimation error during learning. We propose a nonparametric variance-penalized actor-critic (VPAC) framework that replaces the variance critic with statistically grounded online estimators based on bootstrapping and random scaling, techniques drawn from the statistical inference literature for stochastic approximation. These estimators require no auxiliary network, maintain a single-critic architecture, and produce variance penalties that are bounded by construction, enabling clean convergence analysis. We establish almost-sure convergence for both a variance-penalized Q-learning algorithm and a two-timescale actor-critic variant via the ordinary differential equation (ODE) method, requiring only that variance estimates remain bounded rather than consistent. Empirically, we evaluate across discrete and continuous stochastic environments, demonstrating that the proposed methods match or exceed the variance reduction achieved by the existing dual-critic VPAC baseline while eliminating the overhead of a second critic. We further validate on a high-temperature superconductor (HTS) manufacturing case study, where VPAC-RS (Random Scaling) achieves a 74% reduction in steady-state critical current variability and a 63% reduction in episode return standard deviation, translating directly to improved yield consistency. Our results establish nonparametric statistical inference as a practical and theoretically sound alternative to auxiliary critics for risk-sensitive RL.

</details>


### [224] [Communication-Efficient LLM Adaptation over Decentralized GPU Meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14339)
*Sameera Ramasinghe,Shamane Siriwardhana,Thalaiyasingam Ajanthan,Hadi Mohaghegh Dolatabadi,Chamin P Hewa Koneputugodage,Gil Avraham,Violetta Shevchenko,James Snewin,Karol Pajak,Harry Xi,Alexander Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出异步双回路系统（快速压缩训练回路+慢速锚定回路）与谱校正优化器，在低端GPU与互联网级带宽下实现去中心化后预训练适配，压缩激活与梯度而不损失密集训练性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化训练可让大模型在低端GPU和互联网级连接上训练，但数据并行与流水线并行两个轴向上的通信成为主要瓶颈；而以往研究认为激进的激活压缩不可靠，因此需要新的通信压缩机制来支撑后预训练适配。

Method: 提出异步双回路系统：快速压缩训练回路通过激活掩码进行流水线并行（PP）传输，并对数据并行（DP）同步做压缩以提升吞吐；慢速锚定回路在关键路径之外偶尔执行未掩码的前向-反向传播。同时引入谱校正优化器，利用延迟的锚定先验对掩码梯度去噪，且不阻塞快速流。

Result: 仅流水线并行压缩即带来最高9倍吞吐提升；与数据并行压缩结合后，在约200Mbps互联网级连接上吞吐提升超过40倍，并在域适配与持续预训练任务上匹配密集未压缩的性能。

Conclusion: 在锚定机制支持下，激活掩码可在高压缩率下可靠支撑后预训练适配，说明此前关于激进激活压缩不可靠的结论在特定框架下可被突破。

Abstract: Decentralized training enables large-model training over low-end GPUs and internet-grade connections, but communication along both data-parallel and pipeline-parallel axes becomes the primary bottleneck. We study post-pretraining adaptation in this setting. We propose an asynchronous two-circuit system: a fast compressed training circuit drives throughput using activation masking for pipeline-parallel (PP) transfer and compressed data-parallel (DP) synchronization, while a slow anchor circuit runs occasional unmasked forward--backward passes off the critical path. Then, we introduce a spectral correction optimizer that uses these delayed anchor priors to denoise masked gradients without blocking the fast stream. Although prior work has found aggressive activation compression unreliable, we show that masking supports post-pretraining adaptation at high compression rates when anchored this way. Pipeline-parallel compression alone yields up to a $9\times$ throughput gain, and combining it with data-parallel compression increases beyond $40\times$ over internet-grade $\sim 200$Mbps connections, while matching dense uncompressed performance across domain adaptation and continual pretraining.

</details>


### [225] [Multimodal deep learning from spectra for small-molecule structure identification: enhancing robustness with mixed-condition training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14360)
*Bowen Gao,Lei Zhu,Yiying Wang,Wenjie Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将光谱学与化学领域的先验知识引入混合条件训练，并结合专家混合（MoE）融合，用于小分子候选结构重排序；在30种预设条件下评估约7.9万测试样本，混合条件训练是性能提升的主要来源，MoE进一步带来增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际分子表征中，小分子结构鉴定依赖互补的光谱证据，但光谱缺失、退化或与分子不匹配等问题会严重挑战多模态模型，因此需要提升模型在非理想光谱条件下的鲁棒性。

Method: 采用可复现评估协议与MoE融合，将领域知识融入混合条件训练以进行候选结构重排序。协议包含针对各光谱模态定制的扰动，以及化学信息驱动的谱图替换，用以覆盖光谱可用性、质量和一致性的变化。使用MSSD模拟的MS、IR、1H NMR和13C NMR谱，对79,462个测试样本在30个预设条件下评估，每样本最多128个困难候选结构；并开展"完整输入训练 vs 混合条件训练"与"朴素拼接 vs MoE融合"的2×2析因对比。

Result: 混合条件训练在两种架构下均带来主要增益。采用MoE时，跨条件等权平均的MRR由0.9203提升至0.9763（相对提升6.08%）；平均R@1由89.50%提升至96.36%（提升6.86个百分点，相对提升7.67%）。仅IR和仅MS/MS条件下的MRR分别由0.4337升至0.9307、由0.3711升至0.8575，达到基线值的2.15倍和2.31倍，同时完整输入性能保持较高水平。

Conclusion: 将领域知识纳入训练条件设计可有效提升模型鲁棒性，且在混合条件训练下MoE融合能带来进一步增益，表明训练条件设计与融合机制协同是提升多模态光谱结构鉴定可靠性的有效途径。

Abstract: In practical molecular characterization, small-molecule structure identification benefits from complementary spectroscopic evidence, but missing, degraded, or mismatched spectra challenge multimodal models. Herein, we incorporate domain knowledge from spectroscopy and chemistry into mixed-condition training for candidate structure reranking, using a reproducible evaluation protocol and mixture-of-experts (MoE) fusion. The protocol incorporates perturbations tailored to each spectroscopic modality and chemically informed spectrum replacements to cover variations in spectral availability, quality, and consistency. A total of 79,462 test samples were evaluated across 30 predefined conditions using simulated spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset (MSSD) for mass spectrometry (MS), infrared (IR) spectroscopy, and 1H and 13C nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), with up to 128 hard candidate structures per sample. A controlled two-by-two factorial comparison of complete-input training versus mixed-condition training and vanilla concatenation versus MoE fusion, with matched evaluation conditions, showed that mixed-condition training provided the main gains in both architectures. For MoE, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), averaged equally across conditions, increased from 0.9203 to 0.9763, a relative increase of 6.08%. Recall at rank 1 (R@1), averaged over the same conditions, increased from 89.50% to 96.36%, an increase of 6.86 percentage points and a relative increase of 7.67%. IR-only and MS/MS-only MRR increased from 0.4337 to 0.9307 and from 0.3711 to 0.8575, reaching 2.15 and 2.31 times their respective baseline values, while complete-input performance remained high. These results support integrating domain knowledge into training-condition design to improve robustness, with further gains from MoE under mixed-condition training.

</details>


### [226] [Towards Identifying the Dataset Biases Causing Phantom Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14449)
*Jonas Jürß,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Sentence BERT嵌入的简单特征，可在数据被过滤掉显式偏见引用的情况下，识别教师模型植入学生模型的偏见主题，已知教师模型时MCC达0.83，未知时为0.46，并发现不同教师模型用不同词汇表达同一偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明教师模型可通过经过偏见过滤的数据集将偏见传递给学生模型，且数据级防御即使知道目标偏见也难以检测或消除。为揭示这类偏见的隐藏痕迹，作者希望找到可识别偏见主题的方法。

Method: 利用Sentence BERT嵌入构建简单签名（特征表示），据此对偏见主题进行识别；分别在已知与未知攻击者所用教师模型的条件下评估该签名的判别能力。

Result: 已知教师模型时，该签名识别偏见主题的Matthews相关系数为0.83；未知教师模型时为0.46。此外观察到不同教师模型似乎通过不同词汇表达同一偏见。

Conclusion: Sentence BERT嵌入签名能有效捕捉数据中被过滤后仍残留的偏见痕迹，教师模型知识显著提升识别性能，且偏见的表达具有模型特异性词汇特征。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that a teacher model can transfer a bias to a student through a dataset from which every explicit reference to that bias has been filtered out, and that no data-level defense reliably removes or detects it even when knowing what bias to look for. Aiming to shed light on the hidden traces of these biases, we show that a simple signature based on Sentence BERT embeddings can identify the topic of such a bias with a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.83 if the teacher model used by the attacker is known and 0.46 if it is not. Additionally, we observe that different teacher models appear to express the same bias through different vocabulary.

</details>


### [227] [Follow the Geometry, Not the Model: Cold Start Semi-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14451)
*Itai David,Daphna Weinshall*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VAST通过解耦伪标签生成与分类器训练，从冻结自监督嵌入的几何结构直接推断无标注样本的概率信念，再蒸馏为归纳式分类器，在冷启动半监督场景下显著优于图基与置信度门控基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代半监督学习将伪标签生成与分类器训练耦合，依赖分类器自身置信度筛选伪标签来更新模型。在每类仅有极少量标签的冷启动场景中，该耦合是病态的：分类器在学到有效决策边界前无法自我监督。

Method: 提出VAST（Veracity-Aware Semi-Supervised Training），将两阶段解耦：先直接从冻结自监督嵌入的几何结构推断无标注集的概率信念，再将其蒸馏进归纳式分类器。核心构造是Veracity Matrix——一种基于核的结构，沿数据流形聚合标签证据，并可解释为逐观测幂似然模型下的Dirichlet后验；同时引入Veracity Propagation，一种自终止的信念传播步骤，将覆盖范围扩展到有标签集核邻域之外。

Result: 在受控协议下（所有方法使用相同冻结嵌入与有标签集），VAST在三个数据集的每个操作点均优于最强的图基半监督基线，9组比较中7组增益统计显著，且产出可部署的归纳式分类器而非依赖直推式图推理。相比之下，端到端置信度门控半监督方法在该设置下表现不佳，实验中未能稳定超越仅用标签的基线。

Conclusion: 解耦伪标签推断与分类器训练是应对冷启动半监督问题的有效途径；以VAST为代表的几何驱动信念推断在少标签条件下优于耦合式置信度门控方案，并兼具归纳式部署优势。

Abstract: Modern semi-supervised learning (SSL) couples pseudo-label generation and classifier training, using the classifier's own confidence to select the pseudo-labels that are then used to update the model. In the cold-start regime, where at most a few labels per class are available, this coupling is ill-posed, since the classifier cannot supervise itself before it has learned.
  To address this problem, we propose VAST (Veracity-Aware Semi-Supervised Training), which decouples these two stages. Probabilistic beliefs over the unlabeled set are first inferred directly from the geometry of a frozen self-supervised embedding and only then distilled into an inductive classifier.
  The construction rests on the Veracity Matrix, a kernel-based structure that aggregates label evidence across the data manifold and admits an interpretation as a Dirichlet posterior under a per-observation powered-likelihood model. Additionally, we introduce Veracity Propagation, a self-terminating belief-spreading step that extends coverage beyond the kernel neighborhood of the labeled set.
  Under a controlled protocol in which all methods receive identical frozen embeddings and labeled sets, VAST outperforms the strongest graph-based SSL baselines at every operating point across three datasets, with statistically significant gains in 7 of 9 comparisons, while producing a deployable inductive classifier rather than requiring transductive graph inference. Compared with end-to-end confidence-gated SSL, we further find that these methods underperform in this setting and, in our experiments, do not consistently exceed labeled-only performance.

</details>


### [228] [Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning as Noisy Estimation: Risk bounds and Architectural Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14485)
*Bhargav Lad,Yifan Hao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在多任务线性回归框架下研究检索引导微调（RAG-FT）中噪声检索的统计后果，证明检索失败风险随任务可分性指数衰减，并指出不稳定源于线性自注意力前向传播的固定无权聚合，而非检索噪声本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG-FT将检索数据直接纳入训练目标，但训练中噪声检索的统计后果在理论上刻画不足，缺乏对检索失败、检索质量随排序退化以及估计器偏差的有限样本分析。

Method: 将RAG-FT建模为多任务线性回归中的估计问题，用OLS代理单层线性自注意力（LSA）以获得有限样本风险界；在均匀同方差检索噪声下推导检索失败率与风险界；进一步提出随排序质量下降的距离比例噪声（DPN）模型，并在同一检索过程下对比OLS代理与字面均匀权重LSA前向传播两种估计器。

Result: 同方差噪声下，检索失败风险相对任务可分性呈指数衰减，并给出RAG-FT风险低于仅目标训练和全语料训练的显式有限样本条件；在DPN模型中，即使精确检索，注意力估计器偏差也以Θ(n^{2q})发散，而OLS风险对所有噪声指数q>0保持Θ(d/n)。

Conclusion: 不稳定性的来源不是噪声检索本身，而是字面LSA前向传播中固定、无权的聚合方式；按可靠性重加权可经验性地消除该问题，DPN模型直接模拟验证了预测的速率分离。

Abstract: Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning (RAG-FT) incorporates retrieved data directly into the training objective, but the statistical consequences of noisy retrieval during training remain theoretically undercharacterized. We study this question by modeling RAG-FT as an estimation problem in a multi-task linear regression framework, using an OLS proxy for single-layer linear self-attention to obtain finite-sample risk bounds. Under homoscedastic retrieval noise, we show that retrieval failure decays exponentially with task separation relative to noise, and derive explicit finite-sample conditions under which RAG-FT achieves lower risk than both target-only and full-corpus training. We then introduce a Distance-Proportional Noise (DPN) model, in which retrieval quality degrades with rank, and compare two estimators under the same retrieval process: the OLS proxy and the literal, uniform-weight forward pass of linear self-attention. We prove that the attention estimator's bias diverges as $Θ(n^{2q})$ even under exact retrieval, while OLS risk remains $Θ(d/n)$ for every noise exponent $q>0$. These results locate the instability not in noisy retrieval itself, but in the fixed, unweighted aggregation of the literal LSA forward pass, which reweighting by reliability empirically removes. We validate the predicted rate separation through direct simulation of the DPN model.

</details>


### [229] [EdgeHAR: An Edge-Native Compact Sensor Foundation Model for Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14498)
*He Zhang,Siyu Yuan,Siyu Liu,Sizhen Bian,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EdgeHAR：面向可穿戴的边端原生紧凑传感器基础模型，通过将信号分解为活动语义、运动动态与采集上下文三个隐码，实现跨用户/设备/采样率/佩戴位置的鲁棒迁移，并在边端约束下保持竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于传感器的人体活动识别基础模型主要面向云端规模部署，难以应对真实世界的感知偏移，包括未见用户、设备、采样率和传感器佩戴位置；同时活动知识与采集变化相互纠缠，导致迁移困难且部署成本高。

Method: 提出EdgeHAR边端原生紧凑传感器基础模型。核心是解耦表征学习：将传感器信号分解为三个隐码——(i)活动语义码（可复用的活动知识）、(ii)运动动态码（时序模式）、(iii)采集上下文码（传感器相关变化）。并引入轻量适配模块，以有限目标域数据实现对新用户、设备、佩戴位置和活动类别的高效适配。

Result: 在异构HAR数据集上的实验表明，EdgeHAR在分布偏移下保持具竞争力的识别性能，同时显著降低部署成本（计算、内存、时延与隐私满足边端约束）。

Conclusion: EdgeHAR实现了基础模型级迁移能力与边端约束的兼顾，为普适感知系统提供了紧凑、边端优先的基础模型实用范式。

Abstract: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) is fundamental to ubiquitous and wearable computing, yet existing foundation models are largely designed for cloud-scale deployment and struggle with real-world sensing shifts, including unseen users, devices, sampling rates, and sensor placements. We present \textbf{EdgeHAR}, an edge-native compact sensor foundation model designed for wearable intelligence. Unlike conventional models that entangle activity knowledge with acquisition variations, EdgeHAR learns transferable representations by factorizing sensor signals into three latent codes: an \textbf{(i)Activity-Semantic Code} capturing reusable activity knowledge, a \textbf{(ii)Motion-Dynamics Code} modeling temporal patterns, and an \textbf{(iii)Acquisition-Context Code} representing sensor-specific variations. This disentangled design enables efficient adaptation to new users, devices, placements, and activity classes with limited target-domain data. By incorporating lightweight adaptation modules, EdgeHAR achieves foundation-model-level transferability while satisfying edge constraints in computation, memory, latency, and privacy. Experiments across heterogeneous HAR datasets demonstrate that EdgeHAR maintains competitive recognition performance under distribution shifts with substantially reduced deployment cost. EdgeHAR establishes a practical paradigm for compact, edge-first foundation models for ubiquitous sensing systems.

</details>


### [230] [Should All Noises Be Treated Equally: Impact of Input Noise Variability on Neural Network Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14504)
*Salma Alsinan,Maksim Makarenko,Sixiu Liu,Ali Aldawood,Ibrahim Hoteit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统考察了噪声类型、尺度与复杂度对神经网络在初至拾取和去噪任务中的性能、泛化性与鲁棒性的影响，提出"鲁棒性矩阵"评估框架，发现大噪声尺度与复合噪声训练有助于提升OOD泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野外地球物理数据常受复杂异质噪声污染，淹没弱地震事件并干扰自动解释。深度学习虽有潜力，但其性能对训练噪声特性高度敏感，尤其在分布外（OOD）条件下表现脆弱。因此需要明确噪声参数如何影响模型的泛化与鲁棒性。

Method: 模拟随钻地震（seismic-while-drilling）数据，利用随机生成器施加可控的震源噪声增强，调节噪声类型、尺度与复杂度。针对初至拾取与去噪两个任务训练多种网络，先在固定噪声类型和尺度下训练，再在可见与未见噪声场景下评估；逐步引入复合噪声混合以增加难度，构建鲁棒性矩阵刻画各模型相对其训练配置的泛化能力。

Result: 较大的噪声尺度能提升泛化能力；噪声类型、任务复杂度与网络架构之间的有效匹配是最大化泛化增益的关键；复合噪声训练可缓解单一噪声训练的缺陷，起到额外的隐式正则化作用，从而增强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了影响噪声地球物理环境下模型韧性的关键因素，并为开发能在多样且不可预测噪声条件下有效泛化的深度学习模型提供了指导。

Abstract: Geophysical data collected from active field sites are often contaminated by complex and heterogeneous noise, obscuring weak seismic events, and complicating automated interpretation. Although deep learning offers promising solutions for seismic processing, its performance is highly sensitive to the nature of training noise, especially under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions. This study investigates the influence of noise parameters, such as type, scale, and complexity on the performance, generalization and robustness of neural networks in two geophysical tasks: first break picking and denoising. We simulate seismic-while-drilling data and apply controlled input source noise augmentation using stochastic generators to vary the noise characteristics. Different neural networks are trained on fixed noise types and scales, then evaluated across both seen and unseen noise scenarios. We incrementally increase the complexity of the noise by introducing compound noise mixtures and assess the performance of the model under increasingly challenging OOD conditions. This yields a robustness matrix that captures the generalizability of each model relative to its training configuration. Results indicate that larger noise scales boost generalization, and that effective alignment between noise type, task complexity, and architecture is key for maximizing generalization gains. In addition, training with compound noises mitigate weaknesses associated with single-noise training, acting as an additional implicit regularizer to improving robustness. These findings highlight key factors influencing model resilience in noisy geophysical environments and offer guidance for developing deep learning models that generalize effectively across diverse and unpredictable noise conditions.

</details>


### [231] [GNN4PPM: Multi-Target Predictive Process Monitoring with Relational Graph Convolutional Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14534)
*Ana Costa,Johannes Mäkelburg,Luise Pufahl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GNN4PPM：将事件日志建模为异构知识图谱（RDF语义），用R-GCN学习嵌入，一次性预测后续全部事件及其完整数据载荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测性流程监控（PPM）方法多从已执行活动、时间戳和案例标识的角度表示事件，忽略了事件日志中记录的其它丰富信息；在真实场景下，这些被忽略的信息对预测任务具有价值。

Method: 提出GNN4PPM，将事件信息表示为捕捉事件日志的异构知识图谱（RDF语义），并采用关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）训练嵌入；预测目标为一次性输出所有下一事件及其完整数据载荷。

Result: 与现有解决方案相比具有前景，实验表明GNN4PPM在复杂场景下具备准确性与适用性。

Conclusion: 通过知识图谱表示与R-GCN嵌入，可同时预测下一事件及完整数据载荷，弥补传统PPM对日志信息利用不足的问题，并在复杂环境中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) aims at predicting at runtime and as early as possible the future states of a process execution. Common tasks include predicting the next event, the time to completion of a trace, and outcomes. Existing approaches typically consider an event from the perspective of the executed activities along with their timestamps and case identifiers. This leads to the disadvantage that in real-life settings, there is much more information recorded in the event log that is not captured or completely ignored when performing prediction tasks. We introduce GNN4PPM, an approach that predicts all next events along with their complete data payload at once. We represent event information in a heterogeneous knowledge graph that captures the event log as an RDF semantics, and train the embeddings with a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN). Our approach is promising in comparison to existing solutions, and experiments with state-of-the-art solutions prove the accuracy and applicability of GNN4PPM in complex settings.

</details>


### [232] [Selecting k Paths with the Minimum Longest Path Length in the Stochastic Semi-Bandit Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14557)
*Shunsuke Aoki,Atsuyoshi Nakamura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在容量约束与随机传输时间下，每步从源到宿在线选择k条路径以最小化最大遍历时间的半强盗（semi-bandit）问题，并提出求解算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行多路径数据传输中，端到端完成时间由最慢路径决定，因此需最小化所选路径中的最大传输时间；而传输时间具有随机性且边容量对每步经过的路径数有限制，需要在线的路径集合选择方法。

Method: 将问题建模为有向图上的在线序贯决策：每个时间步选择满足边容量约束的k条源-宿路径；仅能观测所选路径的传输时间（半强盗反馈）；形式化为最小化所选路径最大遍历时间的半强盗问题，并给出相应选择算法。

Result: 提出了面向该半强盗问题的路径集合选择算法。（摘要未给出具体性能界与实验数据。）

Conclusion: 该工作将多路径并行传输中的最大时延最小化刻画为带容量约束的半强盗路径选择问题，为在线选路提供了算法框架。

Abstract: When performing parallel data transmission through a network using multiple paths, it is practically important to minimize the maximum transmission time among the selected paths. This study addresses an online problem in which $k$ paths from an origin vertex to a destination vertex must be selected at each time step within a network represented as a directed graph. Here, the number of paths going through each edge in each parallel data transmission is limited to its capacity, and the time required for transmission is determined stochastically. We formulate the semi-bandit problem of selecting a set of paths to minimize the maximum traversal time among the selected paths and propose an algorithm to solve it.

</details>


### [233] [Pathwise Individual Rationality in Federated Learning: A Mechanism-Architecture Co-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14591)
*Amin Meghrazi,Srinivasan Parthasarathy,Andrew Perrault*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中的个体理性（IR）问题：客户端参与联邦不应比本地训练更差。作者发现按轮累计盈余路径上客户端可能长期低于本地基线，证明对每轮贡献设上限会导致学习崩溃，进而提出结合短期参与保证与个性化模型评估的新设计，兼顾公平激励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习参与有成本（隐私、通信、计算），客户端只有在收益不低于本地训练（autarky）时才愿参与，即个体理性。既有工作多关注渐近均衡保证，忽视了逐轮路径上客户端短期可能持续亏损的问题。

Method: 将FL路径性能刻画为每轮累计盈余的界，在不同客户端数据分布异质性模型下分析。针对短期亏损提出限制每轮贡献上限的直观方案并加以证明其失效；随后提出新设计，将短期参与保证与个性化模型评估结合，并给出理论依据。

Result: 客户端可在数百轮中低于本地训练基线；对每轮贡献设上限会适得其反，即使低至中等异质性也会导致学习崩溃。新设计在中等异质性下可避免短期损失且不损害整体性能；严重异质性下相对本地基线仍有较好表现，但牺牲部分精度。

Conclusion: 个体理性需在逐轮路径层面而非仅渐近层面保障；限制每轮贡献不可行。所提结合短期参与保证与个性化评估的设计为FL公平激励提供了可行路径，但严重异质性下精度与IR存在权衡。

Abstract: Participation in federated learning (FL) comes at a cost. Clients trade off privacy, communication, and compute costs for potentially greater gains in model efficacy. This paper explores this tradeoff under the aegis of individual rationality (IR) versus autarky, the basic game-theoretic requirement that the federation provide utility no worse than local training. Using the above as the design target, we examine pathwise performance of FL, as a per-round bound on cumulative surplus, not just as an asymptotic equilibrium guarantee under different models of client data distribution heterogeneity. Along this path, clients can remain below their local-training baseline for hundreds of rounds. The natural remedy is to cap each client's per-round contribution so that this shortfall stays bounded, and we prove that it backfires, collapsing learning even at low-to-modest heterogeneity.
  We then propose a novel design that combines short-term participation guarantees with personalized model evaluation, while maintaining fair incentives. We provide a theoretical basis for this new approach and empirically demonstrate that clients can avoid short-term losses without harming overall performance, even under moderate data distribution heterogeneity; under severe heterogeneity, the design shows promising outcomes for clients compared to their local baseline at some cost in accuracy.

</details>


### [234] [Diagnosing Temporal Misalignment in Multichannel Time-Series Classification with Minimum Description Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14595)
*Sebastian Buschjäger,Michael Frichert,Daniel Kuhe,Jian-Jia Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于最小描述长度（MDL）的、与分类器和标签无关的诊断方法，用于检测多通道时间序列中的时间错位，并可用于纠正部署时的漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道时间序列分类通常假设传感器流已同步，但延迟、时钟漂移和预处理会在采集或部署阶段引入相对时延。现有同步方案多依赖特定硬件、难以回溯应用，导致错位常被忽视而分类性能次优。

Method: 对传感器分组施加候选时间偏移，测量一组通道经由其余通道表示进行编码的效率：码长增加说明该偏移破坏了共享时间结构，码长最小处即数据支持的对齐。该方法无需重训练，也不需要可信的对齐参考，因此可同时审计训练与部署数据。

Result: 在两个受控合成任务和九个真实数据集上，该指标能揭示对齐结构，并可在人为引入的部署漂移下恢复精度。全数据集审计在 FordChallenge、Opportunity、PAMAP2 和 UCIActivity 等基准中发现稳定的非零 MDL 最优值，揭示出常规模型评估未暴露的系统性偏移。

Conclusion: 该方法为在整个时间序列学习流程中检测、理解并纠正时间错位提供了通用工具，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multichannel time-series classification commonly assumes synchronized sensor streams, although latency, clock drift, and preprocessing can introduce relative delays during data collection or after deployment. Existing synchronization solutions are often hardware-specific and difficult to apply retrospectively. Consequently, synchronization problems may remain undetected while classification performance is suboptimal. We introduce a classifier- and label-free diagnostic based on minimum description length (MDL). Our method applies candidate temporal shifts to sensor groups and measures how efficiently one group can be encoded through a representation of the remaining channels. An increased codelength indicates that the shift destroys shared temporal structure, whereas the minimum identifies the alignment most strongly supported by the data. Unlike learned synchronization methods, the diagnostic requires neither retraining nor a trusted aligned reference and can therefore test both training and deployment data for misalignments. Experiments on two controlled synthetic tasks and nine real-world datasets show that the metric exposes alignment structure and can recover accuracy under induced deployment drift. A whole-dataset audit further identifies stable nonzero MDL optima in established benchmarks including FordChallenge, Opportunity, PAMAP2, and UCIActivity, revealing potential systematic offsets that conventional model evaluation does not expose.
