### [479] [NOC NOC, who's there? Clustering systems of tree-child and normal networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13336)
*Anna Lindeberg,Marc Hellmuth*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文引入“非重叠覆盖”(NOC)集合系统性质，证明其等价于inclusion-visibility，并用NOC刻画normal网络与tree-child网络的聚类系统，给出二次上界与多项式识别算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统发育网络的聚类系统可编码其结构信息。已有研究用strict-compatibility条件刻画tree-child聚类系统，但缺乏统一的、基于集合系统重叠性质的简洁刻画，且tree-child/normal网络可区分的聚类数量与识别算法尚需更清晰的界与工具。

Method: 采用集合系统重叠关系（overlap）视角，定义not-overlap-covered(NOC)性质；证明NOC等价于inclusion-visibility（strict-compatibility的逐成员表述）；用NOC刻画semi-regular网络中的normal网络，并借助Hasse图构造规范normal实现。

Result: 证明normal网络恰为满足NOC的semi-regular网络；聚类系统可由normal网络实现当且仅当满足NOC（等价于每个簇inclusion-visible），且此时与tree-child网络可实现的聚类系统一致；得到tree-child与normal网络不同簇数量的紧二次上界，并给出直接的多项式时间识别算法；还给出normal网络枚举、inclusion-visibility的序论解释、NOC集合系统结构性质及Minimum Set Cover可解特例等推论。

Conclusion: NOC为tree-child/normal网络的聚类系统提供了统一、简洁的刻画框架，兼具结构性、算法性与组合计数等外延意义，并延伸至系统发育之外的集合覆盖问题。

Abstract: Clustering systems provide a natural way to encode structural information contained in phylogenetic networks. In this note, we study the clustering systems of normal and tree-child networks through an overlap-based property of set systems, called not-overlap-covered (NOC). We show that the NOC property is equivalent to inclusion-visibility, a memberwise formulation of the strict-compatibility condition previously used for tree-child clustering systems.
  We characterize normal networks as precisely the semi-regular networks whose clustering systems satisfy NOC. Consequently, a clustering system is realized by a normal network if and only if it satisfies NOC, or equivalently, if every one of its clusters is inclusion-visible. In this case, the Hasse diagram provides a canonical normal realization. These are exactly the clustering systems realized by tree-child networks.
  The NOC formulation yields a sharp quadratic upper bound on the number of distinct clusters of tree-child and normal networks and a direct polynomial-time recognition algorithm. Finally, we explore several consequences of the NOC perspective beyond the phylogenetic setting. These include connections to the enumeration of normal networks, an order-theoretic interpretation of inclusion-visibility, structural properties of NOC set systems, and a tractable special case of Minimum Set Cover, which is NP-hard in general.

</details>


### [480] [Prefix Sharing Is a Sorting Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13692)
*Rong He*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM服务中KV缓存的前缀匹配复用问题，证明基于单一全局顺序的排序策略只有在请求包含至多两个片段时才最优，并提出将排块顺序选择等价为请求上的层次结构选择的结构定理，给出精确算法与近似算法，并在检索场景中验证了显著收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM服务通过精确前缀匹配复用KV缓存，但每个部署系统都用单一全局约定固定可复用片段（检索段落、工具定义、few-shot示例）的拼接顺序。作者指出这种全局顺序只有在请求含至多两个片段时才最优，一般情况下渐近错误，因此需要重新刻画最优排块顺序问题。

Method: 论文证明结构定理：最小前缀树代价等于在所有请求的二叉层次结构H上最小化 sum_x w(x) t_x(H)，其中t_x(H)为需要块x的请求集合的典范分解大小，从而将排块顺序问题等价为层次结构选择问题。基于该等价给出O(3^m)精确算法；指出两片段情形等价于最小顶点覆盖；对leave-one-out族证明最优解为最小外部路径长度（归并排序递归）。作者提出按公共交集的自底向上凝聚聚类作为紧的1/2近似算法，并利用层次结构的DFS顺序服务请求。

Result: 全局顺序在leave-one-out族上付出Theta(n^2)，而真实代价为Theta(n log n)。在三个BEIR语料库的BM25检索轨迹上，所提布局相较生产RAG排序将prefill减少17-36%，且随检索深度增加差距扩大，与理论预测一致。按层次DFS顺序服务请求时，仅缓存一个请求上下文的容量即可精确达到无界缓存最优，说明缓存容量与重排窗口可互为替代。

Conclusion: 单一全局排块约定一般不是最优的；最优排块等价于请求上的层次结构选择，可用精确或1/2近似算法求解，并在检索增强生成场景中带来显著prefill节省，同时揭示缓存容量与重排窗口之间的替代关系。

Abstract: LLM serving reuses KV cache by exact prefix match, so when a prompt is assembled from a set of reusable pieces -- retrieved passages, tool definitions, few-shot exemplars -- the order chosen for those pieces determines how much computation can be shared. Every deployed system fixes that order by a single global convention. We prove this is optimal only when requests contain at most two pieces, and asymptotically wrong in general. Our main result is a structure theorem: the minimum prefix-trie cost equals min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H) over binary hierarchies H on the requests, where t_x(H) is the canonical decomposition size of the set of requests needing chunk x. Choosing chunk orders is therefore equivalent to choosing one hierarchy over requests. The identity yields an O(3^m) exact algorithm, identifies the two-chunk case as minimum vertex cover, and shows that on the leave-one-out family the optimum is the minimum external path length of a binary tree -- the merge-sort recursion -- so a global order pays Theta(n^2) against a true cost of Theta(n log n). Agglomerative clustering by common intersection is a tight 1/2-approximation for the achievable saving. On BM25 retrieval traces over three BEIR corpora the resulting layout reduces prefill by 17-36% against production RAG ordering, and the margin widens with retrieval depth as the theory predicts. Serving requests in the hierarchy's DFS order finally lets a cache holding one request's context attain the unbounded-cache optimum exactly, so cache capacity and reorder window act as substitutes.

</details>


### [481] [Beyond Kruskal: Polynomial-Time Tensor Decomposition under the Lovitz-Petrov Condition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13693)
*Shiri Sivan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文首次在 Lovitz–Petrov 可辨识性条件下给出 3 路张量分解的多项式时间算法，并结合该条件的多项式时间验证，实现了端到端的唯一性认证流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Kruskal 条件虽是最著名的确定性可辨识性判据，但既无已知多项式时间分解算法，其验证本身也是 NP-hard；Lovitz–Petrov 条件更一般且可多项式验证，却长期缺乏对应的多项式时间分解算法。本文旨在填补这一算法空白，并解决张量分解结果无法高效验证唯一性的问题。

Method: 提出一个在 Lovitz–Petrov 可辨识性条件下运行的 3 路张量分解多项式时间算法，并将其与该条件的多项式时间验证算法相结合，构造端到端的认证流程：先计算分解，再在多项式时间内确定性地证明该分解唯一。

Result: 获得了 Lovitz–Petrov 条件下的多项式时间 3 路张量分解算法，并由此得到高效端到端认证程序：可在多项式时间内确定性验证所计算的分解是唯一的，因而达到最小秩。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，在比 Kruskal 条件更一般且可高效验证的条件下，张量分解不仅能高效求解，还能附带唯一性证书；这区别于任意分解仅能给出张量秩的上界（而一般情形下确定张量秩为 NP-hard）。

Abstract: Identifiability criteria certify that a given tensor decomposition is a unique rank decomposition. Kruskal's classical condition is one of the best-known deterministic criteria for identifiability. However, no polynomial-time decomposition algorithm is known under the Kruskal condition, and verifying the condition itself is NP-hard. Lovitz and Petrov introduced a strictly more general identifiability condition which, in contrast, is polynomial-time verifiable, but no polynomial-time decomposition algorithm was previously known under this condition.
  We give a polynomial-time algorithm for 3-way tensor decomposition under the Lovitz--Petrov condition. Moreover, combining our algorithm with polynomial-time verification of the Lovitz--Petrov condition yields an efficient end-to-end certification procedure: after computing a decomposition, one can deterministically certify in polynomial time that it is unique and therefore of minimum rank. This contrasts with an arbitrary tensor decomposition, which certifies only an upper bound on the tensor rank, while determining tensor rank is NP-hard in general.

</details>


### [482] [Tight Hardness for Temporal Path Covers at Vertex-Cover Number Two](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13877)
*Alp Par*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文解决TPC与TDPC在底层无向图顶点覆盖数为2时的计算复杂性，并研究TDPC在时序有向星图上的边界情形与跨度参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cioni等已证明TPC与TDPC在底层无向图顶点覆盖数为3的时序DAG上NP难，但顶点覆盖数为2的情形悬而未决；同时TDPC在时序有向星图上的可解边界也不清楚。

Method: 从Distinct Numerical Matching with Target Sums出发构造多项式时间归约，证明顶点覆盖数恰为2时两问题NP完全；对TDPC的时序有向星图，采用重用归一化论证将最优解约化为叶唯一的两边合并，并引入跨度参数分析可行合并实现。

Result: TPC与TDPC在底层无向图顶点覆盖数恰为2时NP完全；TPC获得精确阈值：顶点覆盖数≤1多项式可解、为2时NP完全。对TDPC星图，若入侧或出侧为单标签则最优仍多项式可解（即使另一侧多标签）；任意k个合并的可行族强制实现跨度至少2k-2。

Conclusion: TDPC在时序有向星图上以最大跨度为参数的XP算法，且对任意固定跨度界多项式可解；完全多标签星图情形仍开放。

Abstract: Temporal Path Cover (TPC) and Temporally Disjoint Path Cover (TDPC) ask for minimum-cardinality covers of a temporal digraph by temporal paths, with TDPC additionally requiring pairwise temporal disjointness. Cioni et al. proved both problems NP-hard on temporal DAGs whose underlying undirected graph has vertex-cover number three and left the vertex-cover-two case open. We resolve this question affirmatively for both problems. Using polynomial-time reductions from Distinct Numerical Matching with Target Sums, we show that TPC and TDPC are NP-complete already when the underlying undirected graph has vertex-cover number exactly two. For TPC, this yields an exact vertex-cover threshold: polynomial-time solvability at vertex-cover number at most one and NP-completeness at two. For TDPC, we further study the boundary case of temporal oriented stars. A reuse-normalization argument reduces optimum solutions to leaf-unique two-edge merges. If either the incoming or outgoing side is single-label, the optimum remains polynomial-time computable even when the opposite side is multi-label. We also introduce a span parameter for feasible merge realizations and prove that any feasible family of k merges forces a realization of span at least 2k-2. Hence TDPC on temporal oriented stars is in XP parameterized by maximum span, and is polynomial-time solvable for every fixed span bound. The unrestricted multi-label star case remains open.

</details>


### [483] [Should Tables Be Sorted? Revisited with a Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14032)
*Songhua He*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文重新审视 Yao 全表模型下的隐式成员问题，首次对 45 年前的 Ramsey 界给出定量改进：将两探针界从 tower 型降为多项式 $O(n^2(\log n)^2)$，并对任意固定 $q\ge3$ 给出高度 $q-1$、顶部为 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的 tower 上界；同时证明隐式成员与隐式搜索在多项式损失下等价，即 $H_q(n)\le G_q(n)\le n^q(H_q(n)+1)^{q+1}$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Yao (1981) 在全表模型中精确确定了一探针情形 $G_1(n)=2n-2$，但 $q\ge2$ 的行为长期悬而未决；Fiat 与 Naor (1993) 仅对足够大的常数 $q$ 构造了宇宙大小为 $\exp(n^c)$ 的方案。本文旨在对 $q=2$ 及一般固定 $q$ 给出显著更优的定量上界，并厘清成员问题与搜索问题之间的内在联系。

Method: 两探针情形完全避开 Ramsey 理论：通过非 Ramsey 的组合论证直接证明 $G_2(n)=O(n^2(\log n)^2)$。对固定 $q\ge3$，仅用 Ramsey 理论使前 $q-1$ 次探针遵循固定模式，最后一次探针复用上述非 Ramsey 论证，从而得到高度 $q-1$、顶部 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的 tower 上界。此外，通过对隐式搜索阈值 $H_q(n)$ 与成员阈值 $G_q(n)$ 的双向归约，建立二者的多项式等价关系。

Result: $G_2(n)=O(n^2(\log n)^2)$；对任意固定 $q\ge3$，$G_q(n)$ 不超过高度 $q-1$、顶部 $n^{1+o(1)}$ 的 tower，特别地 $G_3(n)\le\exp(n^{1+o(1)})$。同时证明对每个固定 $q$，$H_q(n)\le G_q(n)\le n^q(H_q(n)+1)^{q+1}$，故两阈值同为 $\exp(n^{O(1)})$ 或同非 $\exp(n^{O(1)})$。

Conclusion: 本文首次在 45 年后显著改进 Yao 的 Ramsey 界，将两探针界从 tower 型降至多项式，并给出一般固定 $q$ 的 tower 型上界；证明过程显示成员问题与搜索问题在多项式因子内等价，成员-搜索等价性亦在改进四探针界的过程中自然浮现。

Abstract: We revisit the implicit membership problem in Yao's full-table model [Yao, 1981] and obtain, to our knowledge, the first quantitative improvements to his 45-year-old Ramsey bounds, most notably reducing the two-probe bound from tower-type to polynomial. In this model, an $n$-set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,m\}$ is stored as a permutation in an $n$-cell table, and queries decide whether $x\in S$. Let $G_q(n)$ be the largest universe size admitting a $q$-probe membership scheme for all $n$-sets. Yao determined the one-probe case exactly, proving $G_1(n)=2n-2$ for $n>2$, but the behavior for $q\ge2$ remained wide open. Fiat and Naor [1993] constructed schemes for universes of size $\exp(n^c)$ for some constant $c>0$ and sufficiently large constant $q$. For the first adaptive case, $q=2$, we prove $G_2(n)=O(n^2(\log n)^2)$. For every fixed integer $q\ge3$, we show that $G_q(n)$ is at most a tower of height $q-1$ with top $n^{1+o(1)}$; in particular, $G_3(n)\le\exp(n^{1+o(1)})$. The two-probe proof avoids Ramsey theory altogether; for larger fixed $q$, we use Ramsey theory only to make the first $q-1$ probes follow a fixed pattern, and then handle the last probe by the same non-Ramsey argument. Somewhat surprisingly, for each fixed $q$, we also show that implicit membership is as hard as implicit search up to a polynomial loss in universe size. Implicit search must return the cell containing $x$ when present and reject otherwise. For the analogous search threshold $H_q(n)$, we prove $H_q(n)\le G_q(n)\le n^q(H_q(n)+1)^{q+1}$ for every $q,n$. Thus, for every fixed $q$, one threshold is at most $\exp(n^{O(1)})$ if and only if the other is. The proofs were first generated by ChatGPT 5.5 Pro without mathematical hints; the membership-search equivalence emerged while pursuing an improved four-probe bound. The authors have validated and edited the proofs and assume responsibility for all content.

</details>


### [484] [Colored Interaction-Profile Realization: Complexity of Matching-Match on Spiders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14113)
*Ilie Dumitru,Adrian Miclaus,Alexandru Popa*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究Matching-Match问题的计算复杂性，证明其双色下NP完全、蜘蛛图上按颜色数W[1]-hard及特定结构下的FPT与NP完全结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络模体与着色局部交互模式是描述复杂网络结构的有效工具；受逆实现视角启发，研究为固定图顶点着色以使边实现规定彩色成对交互多重集的问题（Matching-Match Puzzle）。

Method: 分析Matching-Match问题在颜色数与宿主图结构影响下的计算复杂性：归约证明双色NP完全；对蜘蛛图，用参数化复杂性分析按颜色数研究W[1]-hard性，并针对腿长受限的蜘蛛图设计FPT算法与NP完全归约。

Result: 双色时Matching-Match为NP完全，即使无预着色且最大度为3；蜘蛛图上按颜色数W[1]-hard，即使仅body预着色；腿长不超过2的蜘蛛图可按颜色数FPT（允许任意预着色）；腿长恰为3且允许预着色时为NP完全。

Conclusion: 颜色数与宿主图结构显著决定Matching-Match的计算复杂性，呈现NP完全、W[1]-hard与FPT之间的精细分界。

Abstract: Network motifs and colored local interaction patterns provide a useful way to describe the structure of complex networks. Motivated by an inverse realization perspective, we study the problem of assigning colors to the vertices of a fixed graph so that its edges realize a prescribed multiset of colored pairwise interactions. This problem is formalized by the Matching-Match Puzzle, introduced by Iburi and Uehara.
  We investigate how its computational complexity depends on the number of colors and on the structure of the host graph. We first prove that Matching-Match is NP-complete with only two colors, even when no vertex is precolored and the graph has maximum degree three. We then focus on spiders. We show that the problem is W[1]-hard parameterized by the number of colors even on spiders with only the body precolored. In contrast, for spiders whose legs have length at most two, we give a fixed-parameter tractable algorithm parameterized by the number of colors, allowing arbitrary precoloring. Finally, we prove NP-completeness for spiders whose legs all have length exactly three when precoloring is allowed.

</details>


### [485] [Maximum Matching on Regular Nonbipartite Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14126)
*Varsha Dani,Thomas P. Hayes,Seth Pettie*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明：任何基于最短增广路的阻塞流型最大匹配算法在 d-正则二部图与非二部图上均可在 O(n^2) 时间内运行，无需新算法即可超越已有结果，并扩展到近似正则图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典阻塞流最大匹配算法时间为 O(m√n)，但在输入受限（如 d-正则图）时可更快。已有 d-正则二部图近线性/亚线性结果；d-正则非二部图有 O(n^2 log n) 确定性算法和 O(n^2) 高概率随机算法，作者希望给出统一且更优的确定性 O(n^2) 界。

Method: 分析基于寻找最短增广路的最大集合的阻塞流型最大匹配算法，在 d-正则二部图与非二部图上的时间复杂度；并将结果推广到度分布在 [d, Δ] 范围内的“近似正则”图。

Result: 证明任何阻塞流型最大匹配算法在 d-正则图（二部与非二部）上均运行于 O(n^2) 时间。对非二部图，这改进了 O(n^2 log n) 的确定性界，并在 d=ω(√n) 时优于 O(m√n)，同时把 [DH25] 的 O(n^2) 界确定化。

Conclusion: 主要结论是无需设计新算法：经典匹配算法在正则图上自动优于 [Yus13, DH25]，且该分析可扩展到近似正则图。

Abstract: Blocking flow-type maximum matching algorithms are based on finding maximal sets of shortest augmenting paths. They run in $O(m\sqrt{n})$ time, on both bipartite [HK73, Din70, Kar73a, Kar73a] and nonbipartite graphs [GT91, Gab17, Vaz24], but this time bound can be improved if the input is constrained. In this paper we consider $d$-regular bipartite and nonbipartite graphs. Previous algorithms show that a perfect matching in $d$-regular bipartite graphs can be computed in near-linear time deterministically [COS01] or sublinear time with high probability [GKK13]. On $d$-regular non-bipartite graphs, a $(1-1/(d+1))$-approximation can be computed in sublinear time $O(n \log n)$ with high probability [DH25], and hence a maximum matching can be computed in $O(n^2)$ time, w.h.p., which is slightly faster than the best deterministic algorithm for regular graphs [Yus13], running in O(n^2 log n) time. We prove that any blocking flow-type maximum matching algorithm based on finding shortest augmenting paths runs in $O(n^2)$ time on d-regular graphs, both bipartite and nonbipartite. On nonbipartite graphs this is an asymptotic improvement over $O(n^2 \log n)$ [Yus13] and an improvement over $O(m\sqrt{n})$ [GT91, Gab17, Vaz24] when $d = ω(\sqrt{n})$. It also improves [DH25] by making its $O(n^2)$ bound deterministic. However, the main take-away message is that no new algorithms are needed: the "classic" matching algorithms automatically outperform [Yus13, DH25]. We also consider extensions of our results to graphs that are only "nearly regular," meaning that their degrees all lie within a specified range, $[d, Δ]$.

</details>


### [486] [A $(p+q)^{O(pq)}$-approximation for $(p, q)$-Flexible Graph Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14243)
*Karthekeyan Chandrasekaran,Raymond Jiang,Krishna Kalathur*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 针对 (p,q)-Flexible Graph Connectivity 问题，给出 (p+q)^{O(pq)} 近似算法，固定常数 p,q 时为常数近似，其核心是 (p,q−1)→(p,q) 增广问题的同阶近似算法及缺陷割的结构刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: (p,q)-Flexible Graph Connectivity 推广了经典生存网络设计问题（安全/不安全边混合），需要一个统一且对固定 p,q 为常数的近似算法。

Method: 将原问题归约为增广问题：在 (p,q−1)-Flex-Connected 图上加边使其成为 (p,q)-Flex-Connected，并设计 (p+q)^{O(pq)} 近似算法；关键结构结果表明所有缺陷割可由 (p+q)^{pq} 个有向图中的最小根割表示。

Result: 得到 (p+q)^{O(pq)} 近似，固定常数 p,q 下为常数因子近似，并给出缺陷割的表征结构定理。

Conclusion: 该工作为 Flexible Graph Connectivity 提供了统一近似框架，并用有向图最小根割刻画缺陷割，显著推进了该问题的近似算法研究。

Abstract: In the $(p,q)$-Flexible Graph Connectivity problem, the input consists of non-negative integers $p$ and $q$ and a graph $G=(V, E)$ whose edges are classified into safe and unsafe edges with non-negative edge costs. A subgraph H of G is $(p,q)$-Flex-Connected if every non-empty proper subset of vertices has either at least $p$ safe edges or at least $p+q$ total edges crossing it. The goal is to find a minimum cost subset $F\subseteq E$ of edges such that the subgraph $(V, F)$ is $(p,q)$-Flex-Connected. We give a $(p+q)^{O(pq)}$-approximation for this problem, which in particular implies a constant approximation for every fixed constants $p$ and $q$. We achieve this by designing a $(p+q)^{O(pq)}$-approximation for the augmentation problem of finding a minimum cost subset of edges to add to make a (p,q-1)-Flex-Connected graph into a (p,q)-Flex-Connected graph. Underlying the augmentation algorithm is a structural result showing that all deficient cuts can be represented by min rooted-cuts in a $(p+q)^{pq}$-sized collection of digraphs. This structural result was discovered by ChatGPT Astra.

</details>


### [487] [Private Graph Property Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14394)
*Hendrik Fichtenberger,Abigail Gentle,Tamalika Mukherjee,Sayantan Sen*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究差分隐私图性质测试，针对稠密图与有界度图模型，通过建立多种图采样过程的隐私放大定理，设计出查询复杂度与非私有测试器相当的私有测试器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图性质测试通常只随机检查输入的很小一部分，看似天然契合差分隐私与子采样隐私放大，但两领域间鲜有结果连接。本文旨在填补这一空白，为稠密图和有界度图模型设计具有形式化隐私保证的高效测试器。

Method: 为诱导子图采样、随机游走和k-disc采样等常用图采样过程开发新的隐私放大定理；并利用这些技术构造稠密图模型下的私有规范测试器（canonical tester），以及稠密图与有界度图模型下的私有二部性测试器和子图无含性（subgraph freeness）测试器；最后借助k-disc采样的隐私放大定理证明超有限图（hyperfinite graphs）的任意性质均可私有测试。

Result: 为多种图采样程序建立了隐私放大定理；在稠密图模型下得到私有规范测试器，并在稠密图与有界度图模型下得到私有二部性测试器和子图无含性测试器；证明了超有限图的任意性质均可私有测试。所设计私有测试器的查询复杂度与非私有对应算法相当。

Conclusion: 差分隐私图性质测试可高效实现，隐私与子采样放大机制可有效应用于图采样；证明了包括超有限图性质在内的一大类性质可被私有测试，且查询复杂度不显著劣于非私有测试器。

Abstract: Graph property testing asks whether a massive graph satisfies a given property, or is far from doing so, using only a sublinear number of queries to the graph. Since property testers typically inspect only a small, randomly sampled portion of the input, they appear naturally compatible with differential privacy and privacy amplification by subsampling. Despite this, few results link these two fields. We initiate a systematic study of differentially private graph property testing with the goal of designing efficient testers with formal privacy guarantees in the dense and bounded-degree graph models. We develop new privacy amplification theorems for several widely used graph-sampling procedures such as induced subgraph sampling, random walks and k-disc sampling. We then leverage these privacy amplification techniques to design a private canonical tester in the dense graph model, as well as private bipartiteness testers and subgraph freeness testers in the dense and bounded-degree graph models. Finally, using the new privacy amplification theorem for k-disc sampling, we prove that every property of hyperfinite graphs is privately testable. The resulting query complexities of our private testers are comparable to those of their non-private counterparts.

</details>


### [488] [Toward Optimal Time-Space Tradeoffs for Set Reconciliation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14442)
*Rui Xu,Kangyang Zhou,Jiachen Xu,Jiarui Guo,Boyu Xian,Kaicheng Yang,Tong Yang,Yong Cui*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 提出XYZ-Sketch，在集合调和问题中同时实现近最小通信空间与O(1)更新时间复杂度，并给出固定支撑规范模型下的渐近最优性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合调和（set reconciliation）需兼顾时间（计算成本）与空间（通信成本）两个指标，但以往工作多以牺牲一方为代价优化另一方，难以同时兼顾。

Method: 设计XYZ-Sketch，支持O(1)插入时间、O(d log V)解码时间，通信量仅为(1+ε)d个元素；并建立广泛适用的固定支撑规范模型（fixed-support canonical model）进行理论分析。

Result: 对足够大的d，XYZ-Sketch以(1+ε)d通信量完成调和，插入O(1)、解码O(d log V)；在某一开放极值猜想下，证明其在该规范模型内渐近最优；实验验证了近最优性能。

Conclusion: XYZ-Sketch首次同时实现近最小空间与O(1)更新时间，理论分析与实验均支持其近最优性，并为该问题提供了通用规范模型框架。

Abstract: Set reconciliation, where two parties each holding a large set of elements aim to identify their set difference, is a fundamental task in many areas. There are two important metrics in this problem: time (computation cost) and space (communication cost). Most previous work focuses on optimizing one metric at the expense of the other. We present XYZ-Sketch, proving that it is possible to achieve near-minimal space and $O(1)$ time updates simultaneously. Specifically, for sufficiently large $d$, XYZ-Sketch reconciles sets with only $(1+\varepsilon)d$ elements for communication, while achieving $O(1)$ insertion time and $O(d\log V)$ decoding time. Here, $d$ and $V$ denote the size of the difference between two sets and the universe size, respectively. We further establish a broad fixed-support canonical model for the problem, showing that, under an open extremality conjecture, XYZ-Sketch is asymptotically optimal within this model. Experiments validate the predicted near-optimal performance of XYZ-Sketch. The source code is available at https://github.com/djwj233/XYZ-Sketch.

</details>


### [489] [Degree-Parameterized Analysis of Sampling-Based Online Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14486)
*Pan Xu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究随机到达顺序下的边加权在线二分匹配问题，以最大离线度 $d$ 和采样比例 $\theta$ 为参数，分析两类基于采样的框架，给出紧的竞争比、匹配数方差界与迁移定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典在线二分匹配分析（如 $1/e$、$1/8$）未充分刻画最大离线度 $d$ 与采样比例 $\theta$ 对竞争比的影响，需在参数化视角下重新审视采样类策略的极限与最优性。

Method: （1）确定性贪心采样：用固定规模初始样本计算价格，再施加局部阈值规则；（2）黑箱采样—匹配：引入依赖前缀的重加权，接任意近似离线匹配求解器。

Result: 确定性贪心采样给出显式最坏情形竞争比，并证明其在固定 $d\ge2,\theta\in[0,1]$ 下于该策略族内紧；最优采样在 $d=1,2$ 时不采样与稠密极限约 $0.2562$ 之间过渡，优于经典 $1/8$ 且保持每到达线性时间；给出匹配离线代理数的方差最坏界，含 $\theta\to1_-$ 的阶紧行为与固定 $m,d$ 时 $\theta\to0_+$ 的 $O(\theta)$ 界。黑箱框架得到迁移定理：保证为离线近似比乘以 $d,\theta$ 的显式函数；精确匹配时在无界度极限恢复经典 $1/e$。

Conclusion: 在 $d,\theta$ 参数化下刻画了采样式在线匹配的紧竞争比与方差，并通过迁移定理把离线近似算法统一转化为在线保证，稠密与无界度极限分别给出 $0.2562$ 与 $1/e$。

Abstract: We study edge-weighted online bipartite matching under random arrival order, parameterized by the maximum offline degree $d$ and sampling fraction $θ$. We analyze two sampling-based frameworks. For \emph{Deterministic Greedy Sampling}, which computes prices from a fixed-size initial sample and then applies a local threshold rule, we derive an explicit worst-case competitive ratio and prove it tight within this policy family for every fixed $d\ge2$ and $θ\in[0,1]$. The optimal sampling choice interpolates between no sampling for $d=1,2$ and a dense-limit guarantee of approximately $0.2562$, improving on the classical $1/8$ analysis while retaining linear per-arrival time. We also derive worst-case bounds on the variance of the number of matched offline agents, including order-tight behavior as $θ\to1_-$ and an $O(θ)$ bound as $θ\to0_+$ for fixed $m,d$. For \emph{Black-Box Sampling--Matching}, we introduce prefix-dependent reweighting followed by an arbitrary approximate offline matching solver and prove a transfer theorem whose guarantee is the offline approximation ratio times an explicit function of $d$ and $θ$. With exact matching, the framework recovers the classical $1/e$ guarantee in the unbounded-degree limit.

</details>


### [490] [The Matroid Secretary Conjecture is True](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14555)
*Sahil Singla*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文解决了拟阵秘书猜想（matroid secretary conjecture），提出了一个在线算法，其期望性能保证达到离线最优的1/4，且仅需预先知道元素个数与已到达子集的独立预言机访问，无需事先知道拟阵结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拟阵秘书问题长期存在未解的核心猜想：是否存在常数竞争比的在线算法，无需知晓拟阵本身。本文旨在彻底解决这一猜想，给出具有常数竞争保证并弱化假设条件的算法。

Method: 算法为在线选择策略，接受每个元素的概率设定保证使其对离线最优解的覆盖率至少为1/4；仅要求预先知道元素总数，并通过独立预言机（independence oracle）查询已到达元素子集的独立性，不依赖对拟阵的先验知识。

Result: 证明了拟阵秘书猜想的正确性：所提算法能够以至少1/4的概率接受离线最优解中的每个元素，从而在常数竞争比下实现近似最优在线选择。

Conclusion: 该成果确立了拟阵秘书问题存在常数竞争比的通用在线算法，并在信息假设上实现了显著弱化（仅需元素数量与独立预言机），推进了在线算法与拟阵理论交叉领域的基础性认识。

Abstract: We resolve the matroid secretary conjecture, giving an online algorithm that accepts each element of the offline optimum with probability at least $1/4$. The algorithm only needs the number of elements in advance and independence-oracle access to subsets of already-arrived elements; it does not need to know the matroid upfront.

</details>


### [491] [Online matching games in bipartite expanders: applications to bitprobes and dictionaries with non-adaptive probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14559)
*Bruno Bauwens,Marius Zimand*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文构造了查询/操作非自适应的字典与动态1-bitprobes方案：用(1+o(1))K个单元存储K对键值，查询为非自适应探测；并提出所有操作均非自适应的字典（O(nK)单元）以及首个动态1-bitprobes方案，其规模优于此前所有静态构造，核心技术是二分图上的在线匹配博弈策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统字典查询与更新通常需要自适应访问存储位置，而自适应探测在并行/硬件实现中受限；同时1-bitprobes（读一位比特判定成员）此前仅有静态方案，规模较大。作者希望实现非自适应探测的高空间效率字典，并把1-bitprobes推广到动态（支持插入删除）且更紧凑。

Method: 采用单元位宽为n+m+1（n、m为键与值的位宽）的模型；构造显式字典使存储K对仅用(1+o(1))K个单元，查询进行非自适应探测（静态为Õ(n²)次探测，动态为Õ(n²logK)次）。另给出三种操作全非自适应、规模O(nK)单元的字典。对1-bitprobes引入动态版本：查询运行时间n^{O(1)}，插入删除运行时间n^{O(log n)}。证明依赖伙伴论文提出的在线匹配博弈——对手开关左侧节点，策略须在节点被打开时给出不可撤销匹配——并针对（无损）扩展图给出高效策略，在每节点经多项式轮后被关闭的假设下成立。

Result: 得到两类字典：静态查询Õ(n²)次探测、动态查询Õ(n²logK)次探测，均以(1+o(1))K单元存储K对；以及所有操作非自适应但需O(nK)单元的字典。1-bitprobes：给出动态方案，规模小于以往所有静态构造；查询n^{O(1)}，更新（insert/delete）n^{O(log n)}。所有构造显式，各操作时间为poly(n,m)（或上述界）。

Conclusion: 非自适应探测可在近最优空间下实现字典，且能扩展到操作全非自适应（以更大空间为代价）；1-bitprobes可由静态推广到动态且更省空间。核心工具是扩展图上的在线不可撤销匹配博弈策略，为后续动态存储方案提供通用证明框架。

Abstract: A dictionary is a data structure which stores pairs (key, value). The operation query on input key returns value if the dictionary contains a pair (key, value) and nil otherwise. A dynamic dictionary also supports the insert and delete operations.
  The model with cells of bitsize $n + m + 1$ is used, where $n$ and $m$ are the bitsizes of keys and values.
  We give 2 dictionaries that use $(1+o(1))K$ cells to store $K$ pairs and in which query makes \emph{non-adaptive probes} to the data structure:
  a static one in which query makes $\smash{\widetilde O(n^2)}$ probes, and a dynamic one in which it makes $\smash{\widetilde O(n^2 \log K)}$ probes.
  Also, for the first time, a dictionary is given in which all 3 operations are non-adaptive, but the size is larger: $O(nK)$ cells.
  The constructions are explicit and, consequently, all operations run in time $\poly(n,m)$.
  1-bitprobes storage schemes store a set $S \subseteq \{0,1\}^n$ and answer a membership query by reading a single bit.
  We introduce 1-bitprobes that are {\em dynamic}.
  Such a scheme is given whose size is smaller than in all previous constructions which are static.
  The \textsf{query} operation has runtime $n^{O(1)}$. The operations delete and insert have runtime $n^{O(\log n)}$.
  The proofs rely on a strategy for an online matching game played on a given bipartite graph.
  An opponent switches left nodes {\em on} and {\em off}.
  The strategy needs to assign an irrevocable match to a node when it is turned {\em on}. Such games were introduced in the companion paper~\cite{companion-Hall}.
  The applications in this paper rely on efficient strategies assuming that each node is turned {\em off} after a polynomial number of rounds.
  We present efficient strategies for (lossless) expanders.

</details>


### [492] [Counting Paths and Trees via Exterior Algebra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14682)
*Fahad Panolan,Saket Saurabh,Meirav Zehavi,Jie Xue*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文给出计数宿主图中k-路径与k-森林的随机近似算法；路径算法达2^k k^{O(1)}(n+m)ε^{-2}log(2/δ)算术运算量，森林算法达(2+η)^k n^{O_η(1)}ε^{-2}log(2/δ)，解决了Koutis–Williams猜想及Lokshtanov–Saurabh–Zehavi开问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计数宿主图中的k-路径与k-森林是参数化计数复杂性中的核心问题。已有工作（Koutis–Williams猜想、Lokshtanov–Saurabh–Zehavi的开问题）期望获得2^k poly(n, ε^{-1})时间的近似计数方案，本文旨在实现该目标并给出森林版本的近似算法。

Method: 方法上结合外代数（exterior algebra）与随机矩阵估计器（random matrix estimators），并利用Rakhshan–Rabusseau的tensor-train矩界；对森林情形，引入小分量分离器（small-component separator）以高效计算估计量。

Result: 1. 路径：以2^k k^{O(1)}(n+m)ε^{-2}log(2/δ)算术运算量近似计数k个顶点的有向路径数。2. 树与森林：对任意固定η>0，以(2+η)^k n^{O_η(1)}ε^{-2}log(2/δ)算术运算量近似计数给定k顶点森林的非诱导副本数。

Conclusion: 路径算法证实了Koutis–Williams [CACM 2016]的猜想，并以2^k poly(n, ε^{-1})时间的近似方案回答了Lokshtanov、Saurabh与Zehavi [SODA 2021]的开问题；森林算法给出了指数基接近2的近似计数方案。

Abstract: We give randomized approximation algorithms for counting k-paths and k-forests in a host graph. Here k denotes the number of pattern vertices, n and m denote the numbers of host vertices and edges or arcs, ε is the relative error, and δ is the failure probability. Our main results are:
  1. Paths: We approximate the number of directed paths on $k$ vertices in $2^k k^{O(1)}(n+m)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(2/δ)$ arithmetic operations.
  2. Trees and forests: For every fixed $η>0$, we approximate the number of non-induced copies of a given forest on $k$ vertices in $(2+η)^k n^{O_η(1)}\varepsilon^{-2}\log(2/δ)$ arithmetic operations.
  Our path algorithm resolves a conjecture of Koutis and Williams~[CACM 2016] and answers an open question of Lokshtanov, Saurabh, and Zehavi~[SODA 2021] by giving a $2^k poly(n,\varepsilon^{-1})$-time approximation scheme. Our algorithms combine exterior algebra with random matrix estimators, using the tensor-train moment bound of Rakhshan and Rabusseau~[AISTATS 2020]. For forests, we use a small-component separator to evaluate the estimator efficiently.

</details>


### [493] [Fast and Theoretically-Efficient Batch-Parallel Link-Cut Trees, Euler Tour Trees, and Treaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14746)
*Quinten De Man,Laxman Dhulipala*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出MOJOS统一框架，通过基于treap的最优批量动态序列，首次实现理论上高效且实践性能优越的批量并行link-cut tree，填补了该领域40余年的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在动态图算法中，并行批量动态树是核心构件，但现有并行批量动态树（如Euler tour tree、UFO tree、topology tree、rake-compress tree）在性能上均显著落后于顺序场景下40余年保持最优的link-cut tree。设计高效的批量并行link-cut tree一直是重要未解难题。

Method: 作者利用Euler tour tree与link-cut tree共同依赖的、支持分裂与合并的动态序列抽象，提出MOJOS框架。基于treap设计了一种新的批量动态序列，达到最优工作量与深度，并在批量更新、查询及内存占用上优于现有并行跳表和treap实现。该序列可作为即插即用组件替换任意批量动态序列结构。基于此，作者开发了新的批量并行Euler tour tree和首个批量并行link-cut tree。

Result: MOJOS的批量并行Euler tour tree在支持子树查询的场景下优于先前实现；与依赖跳表表示循环序列的先前Euler tour tree不同，MOJOS允许任意批量动态序列结构直接替换。所提出的首个批量并行link-cut tree是首个在二叉分叉模型下实现批量更新O(log n)深度的支持路径查询的批量动态数据结构，其实现优于所有已知支持路径查询的并行批量动态树结构。

Conclusion: MOJOS通过统一的动态序列抽象成功弥合了并行批量动态树与顺序link-cut tree之间的性能差距，实现了理论上高效且实践优越的并行批量动态树框架。

Abstract: Parallel batch-dynamic trees are a fundamental building block in recent theoretical and practical advances in dynamic graph algorithms. However, all existing parallel batch-dynamic tree data structures, including Euler tour trees, UFO trees, topology trees, and rake-compress trees, are all significantly outperformed in the sequential setting by link-cut trees, which have been the sequential state-of-the-art for over 40 years. Despite their excellent performance in the sequential setting, designing efficient batch-parallel link-cut trees has remained a major open problem.
  In this paper, we close this gap by introducing MOJOS, a unified framework for theoretically- and practically-efficient parallel batch-dynamic trees. We exploit the fact that both Euler tour trees and link-cut trees rely on a common dynamic sequence abstraction that supports splitting and joining. We introduce a new batch-dynamic sequence built using treaps that achieves optimal work and depth, and outperforms existing parallel skip list and treap implementations for batch updates, queries, and memory usage.
  With MOJOS, we develop a new batch-parallel Euler tour tree algorithm that outperforms prior batch-dynamic tree implementations supporting subtree queries. Unlike prior batch-parallel Euler tour trees which rely on skip list's ability to represent cyclic sequences, MOJOS allows any batch-dynamic sequence data structure to be used as a drop-in replacement. Finally, we develop the first theoretically-efficient batch-parallel link-cut tree, which is also the first batch-dynamic data structure supporting path queries to achieve $O(\log n)$ depth for batch updates in the binary-forking model. Our link-cut tree implementation outperforms all known parallel batch-dynamic tree data structures supporting path queries.

</details>


### [494] [A rooted tree framework for linear time ultrabubble detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14852)
*Athanasios E. Zisis,Pål Sætrom*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文对前期基于LCA的ultrabubble枚举方法提出三项改进，并组合成六种方法进行基准测试，以提升实际运行效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 泛基因组图（如biedged graph）中ultrabubble是重要变异结构，因其具有有限路径且无死端；此前方法以O(Kn)时间枚举ultrabubbles，仍有改进空间以提升实用性。

Method: 提出三项改进：（1）混合方法，依据snarl规模与图中tips及闭环节点数量的关系，在LCA法与朴素法之间选择；（2）基于BFS树遍历biedged二分图，证明可在O(n+m+K)时间内找到全部ultrabubbles；（3）证明共享frontier节点的两个候选ultrabubble snarl不可能均为ultrabubble，所得snarl集合相容、数量上界为n，并定义互斥的嵌套snarl族。将三者组合为六种方法。

Result: 理论上将全ultrabubble枚举复杂度降至O(n+m+K)；给出六种组合方法的基准测试结果，展示了上述改进对识别ultrabubbles实际运行时间的影响。

Conclusion: 通过混合策略、BFS树线性枚举及候选snarl相容性分析，显著优化了ultrabubble识别的时间效率，并具备实际可行性。

Abstract: Pangenomics uses graphs to show genetic differences within or between species. In these graphs, a path can represent one genome, while regions with different paths show genetic variation. Biedged graphs use black edges for sequences and grey edges for links between them. Snarls are minimal subgraphs of a biedged graph that are separated from the rest of the graph by removing two black edges. Ultrabubbles are minimal acyclic and tip-free snarls and thus are important variant structures because they have finite paths and lack dead ends.
  In our previous work, we showed that in linear time every bidirected graph can be transformed to a rooted biedged bipartite one, and that in these graphs, ultrabubbles can be enumerated with a lowest common ancestor (LCA)-based method in $O(Kn)$ time, where $n$ and $K$ are the number of nodes and given snarls, respectively, of the graph.
  Here, we present a series of practical and theoretical improvements to our previous LCA-based approach. First, we present a hybrid method that selects between the LCA-based method and the naive approach for evaluating a snarl, depending on the size of the snarl in relation to the number of tips and cycle-closing nodes in the graph. Second, by using the theoretical framework from our previous paper, we show that all ultrabubbles can be found in $O(n + m + K)$ time, where $m$ is the number of edges, by traversing the breadth-first search (BFS) tree of the biedged bipartite graph. Third, we show that any two snarls that are candidate ultrabubbles and share a frontier node cannot be ultrabubbles; the resulting set of snarls is compatible, bound by $n$, and defines exclusive families of nested snarls.
  We combine these three results into six methods and present benchmarking results that illustrate how the above improvements affect practical run-times for identifying ultrabubbles.

</details>


### [495] [A Strongly Subquadratic $(3+\varepsilon)$-Approximation for Weighted Edit Distance over Arbitrary Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14873)
*Ethan Mader,Borna Tavasoli,Jihan Wang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文首次给出任意度量诱导编辑代价下加权编辑距离的常数因子近似算法，运行时间为强亚二次的 $\widetilde{O}(n^{7/4}/\varepsilon^8)$，近似比为 $(3+\varepsilon)$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权编辑距离中编辑代价由任意度量给出，此前的近似算法要么近似比随 $n$ 增长（如 Kuszmaul 2019 的 $O(n^\delta)$ 近似），要么局限于特定代价结构；对于任意度量，尚无强亚二次时间内达到常数近似比的结果。

Method: 提出随机化近似算法，针对总长为 $n$ 的字符串计算加权编辑距离，允许输入长度不等且对编辑代价之间的比值不加任何限制。

Result: 对任意 $0<\varepsilon\le 1$，算法在 $\widetilde{O}(n^{7/4}/\varepsilon^8)$ 时间内以至少 $1-n^{-10}$ 的概率返回 $(3+\varepsilon)$-近似解；适用于不等长输入且编辑代价比值无界。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在强亚二次运行时间内实现任意度量加权编辑距离的常数因子近似，改进了此前等长输入下近似比随规模增长的既有结果。

Abstract: We study weighted edit distance between two strings of total length $n$, where edit costs are induced by an arbitrary metric. For equal-length inputs, Kuszmaul (2019) gave an $O(n^δ)$-approximation with $\widetilde{O}(n^{2-δ})$ running time for every fixed $0 < δ< 1$. We give the first constant-factor approximation for weighted edit distance over arbitrary metrics in strongly subquadratic running time. For every $0 < \varepsilon \le 1$, our randomized algorithm runs in $\widetilde{O}(n^{7/4}/\varepsilon^8)$ time and returns a $(3+\varepsilon)$-approximation with probability at least $1-n^{-10}$. The algorithm allows unequal input lengths and places no bound on the ratio between edit costs.

</details>


### [496] [Fast Stencil Computations on a Single Arbitrarily Moving Interval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14879)
*Aaron Gregory*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究一维三点、系数时变模板计算在自由边界（计算区域为端点任意移动的单区间、在线揭示）下的快速算法：以 B=时域+边界轨迹总变差为参数，给出工作量 O((B+N)log T log(N+B))、跨度 O(T log T log(N+B)) 且结果精确的调度，突破既有结果"边界每步至多移动一格"的限制，并用 Lean 4 完成机器验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模板计算朴素模拟代价为 Theta(NT)。自 Ahmad 等起，一类方法将多个时间步复合为单一线性算子并用 FFT 施加，以降低代价，但该方法需预知复合步结束时仍遵循同一算子的单元集合；在自由边界问题中该区域由解决定并随之移动，无法预知。已有针对移动区域的最优界要求边界每时间步最多移动一个单元，过于严格。

Method: 限定一维空间、三点模板（系数随步变化），计算区域为单个区间，两端点每步可按任意幅度移动且在线揭示。以 B = 时域长度 T 加边界轨迹总变差为复杂度参数，构造调度算法，其复杂度来源于：任意长度时间窗内两端点触及的所有单元必落在每端点各一个区间内。

Result: 所给调度工作量为 O((B+N) log T log(N+B))，跨度为 O(T log T log(N+B))，并证明计算结果精确。去掉"每步至多移动一格"限制不带来损失：满足该限制的轨迹有 B <= 3T，故新界在旧结果覆盖的所有轨迹上仍近线性；其他情形的 B 仅按边界实际移动距离增长（一步跳 N 宽仅耗 T+2N）。该界不可任意放松：p 个区域使界退化 p 倍，当 p = sqrt(T) 时存在实例工作量为 Theta(T^{3/2})，而 B+N = Theta(T)。除经典卷积界作为接口导入外，全部结果在 Lean 4 中机器验证。

Conclusion: 以边界轨迹总变差 B 为核心的调度在一维时变三点模板的自由边界问题上达到近线性复杂度且结果精确，严格弱化了既有方法的边界移动约束而不损失性能，并给出不可放松的下界实例；理论结果经 Lean 4 形式化验证。

Abstract: A stencil computation repeatedly updates every cell of a grid from its neighbours' values at the previous timestep. Simulating T steps on N cells directly costs Theta(NT), and a line of work beginning with Ahmad et al. reduces this by composing many timesteps into one linear operator and applying it with a Fast Fourier Transform. That technique needs to know which cells will still obey the same operator when the composed step ends, and in a free-boundary problem they do not: the region governed by a given rule is determined by the solution and moves as it evolves.
  We study one spatial dimension, a three-point stencil with time-varying coefficients, and a computed region that is a single interval whose two endpoints move by arbitrary amounts at every step, revealed online. Let B be the horizon plus the total variation of the boundary trajectory. We give a schedule whose work is O((B+N) log T log(N+B)) and whose span is O(T log T log(N+B)), and we prove that the values it computes are exact.
  The best existing bound for a region that moves requires its boundary to travel at most one cell per timestep. We drop that requirement and lose nothing by it: a boundary obeying it has B <= 3T, so our bound stays near-linear on every trajectory the earlier result covers. Elsewhere, B grows only by the distance the boundary actually travels -- one jump of width N costs T + 2N.
  The reason total variation suffices is that everything the two endpoints touch over a time window of any length lies in two intervals, one per endpoint. This cannot be relaxed: with p regions the bound degrades by a factor p, and at p = sqrt(T) there is an instance on which the work is Theta(T^{3/2}) while B + N = Theta(T).
  All results are machine-checked in Lean 4, apart from the classical convolution bound, which is imported as an interface.

</details>


### [497] [Accelerated Local Algorithms for Personalized and Regularized PageRank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14918)
*Baojian Zhou*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出确定性与随机两类局部 PageRank 算法：确定性算法在 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/(\rho\sqrt{\alpha}))$ 局部工作量内以加性精度 $\varepsilon$ 逼近正则化个性化 PageRank，精度仅以多对数形式进入；随机算法借助支撑安全阈值批次与 SDD 求解达到期望工作量 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(V_*\min\{k_*,\alpha^{-1/2}\})$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部 PageRank 旨在获得与图规模无关工作量的稀疏近似，避免图级预处理与预先给定的解支撑；本文进一步追求确定性局部加速，并仅付出多对数级开销、无需 SDD 预言机。

Method: 确定性算法结合正则化延拓（regularization continuation）与受度缩放盒（degree-scaled box）及质量上限（mass cap）约束的加速修正；用同一递推的两个能量分别控制目标收敛与激活坐标的响应，借助 selected-flow 论证限制累计扫描体量，并用稀疏阈值报告器实现该界；另给出有理输入的有界算术实现。随机算法采用支撑安全阈值批次，通过块 Cholesky 与 Chebyshev 论证控制批次深度，并以经验证的 SDD 求解获得期望工作量界。

Result: 确定性算法以 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/(\rho\sqrt{\alpha}))$ 局部工作量达到加性目标精度 $\varepsilon$，精度仅多对数级影响；随机算法期望工作量为 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(V_*\min\{k_*,\alpha^{-1/2}\})$，其中 $k_*$、$V_*$ 分别为最优支撑的基数与度体量。两种方法均蕴含相应的加速度归一化 PPR 近似。与 Cui、Wei、Yang 2026 年 9 月同期预印本相比，二者在随机工作量尺度上一致，本文主要区别在于确定性局部加速、仅多对数开销且不依赖 SDD 预言机。

Conclusion: 本文实现了正则化个性化 PageRank 的确定性局部加速近似，在仅多对数精度开销、无需 SDD 预言机和图级预处理的条件下达到与随机算法相当的局部工作量尺度，并同时给出随机变体与有界算术实现。

Abstract: Local PageRank algorithms seek sparse approximations with work independent of graph size. We give a deterministic algorithm for regularized personalized PageRank with additive objective accuracy $ε$ in $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/(ρ\sqrtα))$ local work, where $α$ is the lazy teleportation parameter and $ρ$ is the regularizer. Accuracy enters only polylogarithmically. The bound charges discovery, repeated neighborhood scans, numerical updates, certification, and output, without graph-wide preprocessing or a supplied solution support.
  The algorithm combines regularization continuation with accelerated corrections constrained by a degree-scaled box and a mass cap. Two energies for the same recurrence control objective convergence and the response that activates coordinates. A selected-flow argument bounds cumulative scanned volume, and a sparse threshold reporter realizes the bound. We also specify a bounded-arithmetic implementation for rational inputs.
  A second, randomized algorithm uses support-safe threshold batches. A block-Cholesky and Chebyshev argument bounds their depth, and certified SDD solves give expected work $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(V_*\min\{k_*,α^{-1/2}\})$, where $k_*$ and $V_*$ are the optimal support's cardinality and degree volume. Both methods imply the corresponding accelerated degree-normalized PPR approximation. The concurrent September 2026 preprint of Cui, Wei, and Yang also attains the randomized work scale. Our principal distinction is deterministic local acceleration with only polylogarithmic overhead and no SDD oracle.

</details>


### [498] [The Complexity of Weak Partition Connectivity in Hedgegraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14932)
*Yuanhao Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明了hedgegraphs上弱划分连通性的整数阈值判定问题是NP完全的，并给出了分数目标的矩阵刻画公式，由此导出精确算法、PTAS及不可近似性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱划分连通性在hedgegraphs上的整数阈值判定问题的计算复杂性此前是未解问题；作者旨在确定其复杂性并刻画分数目标的结构，从而理解该问题何时可精确求解、何时可近似。

Method: 采用二元矩阵表示，将分数弱划分连通性表达为 m-ρ(A)，其中 ρ(A) 最大化"所选行数"与"不同投影列数减一"之比；利用该公式构造归约以证明硬度，并设计确定性算法（在参考列给出满足线性相交条件的行支撑时精确计算，包括最小行支撑数 s(A)≤2 的情形），以及对full-support split systems上整数与分数目标的划分输出PTAS。

Result: 整数阈值判定问题为NP完全，且硬度即使在连通无权hedgegraphs（每个hedge由两个非空、顶点不相交且并集为整个顶点集的超边组成）上仍成立；在同一实例类上hedge连通性有简单精确公式；矩阵公式同时给出硬度归约与上述算法；除非P=NP，该实例类上两个目标均不存在FPTAS。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了hedgegraphs上弱划分连通性整数阈值判定的复杂性开放问题，并通过矩阵表示统一了分数目标的精确刻画、可解情形与近似可能性，明确了精确与近似之间的界限。

Abstract: We prove that the integer-threshold decision problem for weak partition connectivity in hedgegraphs is NP-complete, answering an open question about its computational complexity. Hardness holds even for connected unweighted hedgegraphs in which every hedge consists of exactly two nonempty, vertex-disjoint hyperedges whose union is the entire vertex set. On the same class of instances, hedge connectivity has a simple exact formula. Using a binary matrix representation, we express fractional weak partition connectivity as $m-ρ(A)$, where $ρ(A)$ maximizes the ratio of the number of selected rows to one less than the number of distinct projected columns. This formula yields both the hardness reduction and deterministic algorithms: exact computation when some reference column gives row supports satisfying a linear intersection condition, including the case of minimum row-support number $s(A)\le2$, and a partition-output polynomial-time approximation scheme (PTAS) for both the integer and fractional objectives on all full-support split systems. Unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$, neither objective admits a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme (FPTAS) on this class.

</details>


### [499] [Matrix Spencer: Eight Standard Deviations Suffice and an Almost-Linear Time Algorithm for Dense Input](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15025)
*Zhao Song,Lichen Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明了矩阵 Spencer 猜想：对任意谱范数不超过 1 的对称矩阵 $A_1,\ldots,A_n$，存在符号使 $\|\sum_i\varepsilon_iA_i\|=O(\sqrt n)$；并给出找到偏差低于 $12\sqrt n$ 的随机算法，运行时间 $n^{3+o(1)}\operatorname{polylog}(1/p)$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机符号仅给出 $O(\sqrt{n\log n})$ 的矩阵集中界，矩阵 Spencer 猜想此前仅在秩、块对角或 Frobenius 范数限制下成立。本文旨在完全证明该猜想并把常数压到 8 以下，同时给出接近稠密输入规模 $n^3$ 的高效算法。

Method: 存在性证明采用部分染色论证，其核心是一个新的估计：谱体 $\{x:\|\sum_ix_iA_i\|\le R\}$ 的遗传高斯小-ball界，通过在矩阵加权 Poincaré 不等式下将对数配分函数从对角模型插值到非交换模型得到。为降低常数，作者用高斯测度到符号的无损编码消除联合界损失，用带认证系数的光滑谱障碍消除半径过大的损失。算法将高斯点投影到光滑化的谱体上，其导数表示为对某个 Gibbs 矩阵的迹；通过四种逐步更廉价的维护该矩阵的方法将运行时间降至 $n^{3+o(1)}$。

Result: 证明存在偏差低于 $8\sqrt n$ 的符号；给出随机算法可找到偏差低于 $12\sqrt n$ 的符号，失败概率至多 $p$，使用 $n^{3+o(1)}\operatorname{polylog}(1/p)$ 次实数算术运算，与稠密输入规模 $n^3$ 在次多项式因子内匹配。

Conclusion: 矩阵 Spencer 猜想获证；证明猜想与把常数降到 8 以下是两个不同问题，通过消除两类损失分别实现。算法借助光滑谱体投影与 Gibbs 矩阵的高效维护达到了接近最优的运行时间。

Abstract: The Matrix Spencer conjecture asserts that for all symmetric matrices $A_1,\ldots,A_n\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ with $\|A_i\|\le1$ there are signs $\varepsilon_1,\ldots,\varepsilon_n\in\{-1,1\}$ with $\|\sum_{i=1}^n\varepsilon_iA_i\|=O(\sqrt n)$. Random signs give only the matrix-concentration bound $O(\sqrt{n\log n})$, and the conjecture was known only under rank, block-diagonal, or Frobenius-norm restrictions. We prove it: a signing of discrepancy below $8\sqrt n$ always exists. We also give a randomized algorithm that finds a signing of discrepancy below $12\sqrt n$ with failure probability at most $p$ using $n^{3+o(1)}\operatorname{polylog}(1/p)$ arithmetic operations in the real-arithmetic model, which matches the size $n^3$ of the dense input up to subpolynomial factors.
  The existence proof is a partial-coloring argument with one new estimate: a hereditary Gaussian small-ball bound for the spectral body $\{x\in \mathbb{R}^n:\|\sum_ix_iA_i\|\le R\}$, proved by interpolating a log-partition function from a diagonal model to the noncommutative one under a matrix-weighted Poincaré inequality. Proving the conjecture and bringing the constant below $8$ are different problems. The partial-coloring argument loses a large factor twice, when it turns Gaussian measure into signs through a union bound and when it proves the small-ball estimate at a radius far larger than necessary. We remove the first loss by a lossless coding of Gaussian measure into signs and the second by smooth spectral barriers with certified coefficients. The algorithms project Gaussian points onto a smoothed version of the spectral body, whose derivatives are traces against one Gibbs matrix. Four successively cheaper ways of maintaining that matrix bring the running time down to $n^{3+o(1)}$.

</details>


### [500] [A Deterministic $(2+\varepsilon)$-Approximation for Weighted Feedback Vertex Set in Tournaments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15220)
*Hanqing Li,Zihan Wu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究锦标赛中的加权反馈顶点集问题，针对每个固定整数 k≥2 给出确定性 (2+1/k)-近似算法，运行时间为 n^{2^{O(k)}}（不计权值编码长度的多项式因子），从而对任意固定 ε>0 得到运行时间 n^{2^{O(1/ε)}} 的 (2+ε)-近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锦标赛中的（加权）反馈顶点集问题是经典组合优化问题，与最大权传递子锦标赛互补。目标是在近似比与运行时间之间取得可控权衡：以略微超过 2 的近似比换取仅依赖 k 的指数级运行时间，避免对一般图近似困难性的限制。

Method: 算法结合两个要素：(1) 当锦标赛的三角形图的团数有界时，对其传递补图作链分解，得到求最大权传递子锦标赛的精确动态规划；(2) 当团数较大时，利用三角形图的结构定理得到一个常数规模的强好代价向量，并借助该向量进行局部比（local-ratio）归约以获得近似保证。

Result: 对每个固定 k≥2 得到确定性 (2+1/k)-近似，运行时间 n^{2^{O(k)}}；由此对每个固定 ε>0 得到 (2+ε)-近似，运行时间 n^{2^{O(1/ε)}}。作为副产品，该动态规划在 B_7-free 锦标赛上以 O(n^7) 时间精确求解加权反馈顶点集，其中 B_7 为反馈顶点集数至少为 3 的七顶点锦标赛族。

Conclusion: 该工作为锦标赛上加权反馈顶点集问题提供了近似比趋近 2 的确定性算法，并提供了一种精确算法适用的受限锦标赛类，验证了结构分解与局部比归约相结合的有效性。

Abstract: We study the weighted feedback vertex set problem in tournaments. For every fixed integer $k\geq 2$, we give a deterministic $(2+1/k)$-approximation algorithm with running time $n^{2^{O(k)}}$, apart from polynomial dependence on the encoding length of the weights. Consequently, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, weighted feedback vertex set in tournaments has a deterministic $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximation running in time $n^{2^{O(1/\varepsilon)}}$. The algorithm combines two ingredients. When the triangle graph of the tournament has bounded clique number, a chain decomposition of its transitive complement yields an exact dynamic program for a maximum-weight transitive subtournament. When the clique number is large, a structural theorem for triangle graphs supplies a constant-size strongly good cost vector. A local-ratio reduction with this cost vector gives the claimed guarantee. As a by-product, the dynamic program solves weighted feedback vertex set exactly in $\mathcal B_7$-free tournaments in time $O(n^7)$, where $\mathcal B_7$ is the family of seven-vertex tournaments with feedback vertex set number at least three.

</details>


### [501] [A Faster Undirected Single-Source Shortest Path Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15247)
*Avi Kadria,Liam Roditty*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对非负权无向图单源最短路（SSSP）问题，提出运行时间为 $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/4} n \log\log\log^{1/4} n)$ 的算法，较此前的 $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/2} n)$ 提升因子 $(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n})^{1/4}$，是自 FOCS'23 突破以来的首次改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较-加法模型下 SSSP 长期由 Dijkstra 配 Fibonacci 堆的 $O(m+n\log n)$ 界主导。近年来 Duan 等人相继给出随机化亚线性对数因子算法（FOCS'23 无向、STOC'25 有向、ICALP'26 有向匹配无向），本文旨在进一步降低无向加权图 SSSP 的运行时间，寻求对 FOCS'23 结果的首次改进。

Method: 提出一个简单且高效的工具，能够为每个顶点计算其到随机样本中最近顶点的距离；该工具作为核心技术支撑，可能具有独立价值。

Result: 算法运行时间达到 $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/4} n \log\log\log^{1/4} n)$，相比此前无向图最优的 $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/2} n)$ 改进了 $(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n})^{1/4}$ 倍。

Conclusion: 本文首次改进了 FOCS'23 无向加权图 SSSP 的突破性运行时间，并贡献了一个可能具有独立意义的“到随机样本最近顶点距离”计算工具。

Abstract: The single-source shortest paths (SSSP) problem in graphs with non-negative edge weights is one of the most classic problems in algorithms. For decades, the best known running time in the comparison-addition model was the $O(m+n\log n)$ bound of Dijkstra's algorithm with Fibonacci heaps.
  Recently, Duan, Mao, Shu, and Yin (FOCS'23) gave a randomized $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/2} n)$-time algorithm for SSSP in weighted undirected graphs. For weighted directed graphs, Duan, Mao, Mao, Shu, and Yin (STOC'25) gave an $O(m\log^{2/3} n)$-time algorithm for SSSP. Very recently, Duan, Mao, Shu, and Yin (ICALP'26) obtained an algorithm for directed graphs whose running time matches the $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/2} n)$ time of the undirected case.
  In this paper, we present a faster algorithm for SSSP in weighted undirected graphs, giving the first improvement in running time since the FOCS'23 breakthrough of Duan, Mao, Shu, and Yin. Our algorithm runs in $O(m\log^{1/2} n \log\log^{1/4} n \log\log\log^{1/4} n)$ time, improving the previous running time by a factor of $(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n})^{1/4}$.
  Our main contribution is a simple and efficient tool that computes, for every vertex, its distance to the nearest vertex in a random sample; this tool may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [502] [Single-Machine Scheduling with Interval Predictions and Costly Preemption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15492)
*Lachlan Bridges*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究处理时间未知但给出区间报告的单机总完工时间问题：按报告上界非降序加工，超期则触发可抢占几何回退策略，中断需付罚κ。推导残差规模m、尺寸比D、归一化罚λ、几何深度K下的最坏情形系数与精确界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 $1||\sum C_j$ 依赖已知处理时间，而实际中处理时间常未知，仅有区间估计。作者希望在区间报告不可靠（违反上界）时仍能给出最坏情形性能保证，并量化中断惩罚与回退深度之间的权衡。

Method: 采用"按报告上界非降序"的初始列表调度；当某作业在收到其报告上界服务后仍未完成，即判定违反并切换为可抢占的几何回退策略，每次中断未完成作业施加加性惩罚κ。对残差集合定义尺寸比 $D=s_1/s_0$、归一化中断惩罚 $\lambda=\kappa/s_0$、几何深度K，推导显式最坏情形系数 $\Psi_{m,D,\lambda}(K)$；并推导任意非抢占列表在已知有界处理时间范围下的精确最坏情形系数 $R_{n,D}$。

Result: 当 $\lambda>0$ 时存在有限的使系数最小的深度，可在触发后依据观测到的未完成作业数选择；最优深度随中断惩罚增大而减小、随残差集规模增大而增大。所得界覆盖有效区间、单区间失效、任意报告、无触发情形与随机实例；在单失效情形下给出回退保证小于有界范围续做保证的精确条件。

Conclusion: 该工作为处理时间未知、仅有区间报告的调度提供了可证明的最坏情形保证，并刻画了几何回退深度与中断惩罚间的定量关系，扩展了有界范围与随机实例下的性能分析。

Abstract: We study the single-machine total-completion-time problem $1||\sum C_j$ when processing times are unknown but each job comes with a reported interval. Jobs are initially processed in nondecreasing order of reported upper bound. If a job is still unfinished after receiving that much service, the reported upper bound has been violated and the policy switches to a resumable geometric fallback. Each interruption of an unfinished job incurs an additive penalty $κ$.
  For a residual set of $m$ jobs, known size ratio $D=s_1/s_0$, normalized interruption penalty $λ=κ/s_0$, and geometric depth $K$, we derive an explicit worst-case coefficient $Ψ_{m,D,λ}(K)$. When $λ>0$, a finite minimizing depth exists and can be chosen after the trigger from the observed number of unfinished jobs; the optimal depth decreases with the interruption penalty and increases with the residual set size. We also derive the exact worst-case coefficient $R_{n,D}$ for an arbitrary nonpreemptive list when all processing times lie in a known bounded range. These bounds give guarantees for valid intervals, a single interval failure, arbitrary reports, no-trigger outcomes, and random instances. In the single-failure regime, they also give a precise condition under which the proved fallback guarantee is smaller than the bounded-range continuation guarantee.

</details>


### [503] [Strong and Compact Policies for Submodular Markov Decision Processes via LP-Based Submodular Orienteering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15539)
*Lars Rohwedder,Rico Zenklusen*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对单调子模奖励下的子模定向问题与子模马尔可夫决策过程,提出基于Sherali-Adams层级与Round-or-Cut的新LP算法,在多项式时间内实现O(n^ε)近似(子模MDP为O(H^ε)),并揭示近似比与决策所依赖历史顶点数之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典MDP的奖励为可加函数,难以刻画覆盖、多样性等实际应用;推广到单调子模奖励后,去随机化即子模定向问题。已有子模定向仅有拟多项式时间的对数近似,而子模MDP此前最优近似比随H线性增长,多项式时间内的亚线性(乃至O(n^ε))近似尚属空白。

Method: 将问题建模为有向图上带长度约束、最大化单调子模函数的s-t游走(子模定向),利用Sherali-Adams层级构造强化LP松弛,并结合Round-or-Cut框架进行舍入与割生成,再将该框架推广至子模MDP的随机转移设定。

Result: 算法保证与已有的拟多项式时间对数近似相当,并推广到子模MDP;在多项式时间下对任意ε>0给出O(n^ε)近似,子模MDP为O(H^ε),突破了此前依赖H线性的近似比;同时揭示近似比与智能体决策所条件化的历史访问顶点数之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在子模定向与子模MDP上给出多项式时间的O(n^ε)/O(H^ε)近似,统一并改进了既有结果;其LP与Round-or-Cut方法还刻画了近似质量与决策记忆规模之间的内在权衡,为后续研究提供了新工具与视角。

Abstract: Finding policies for Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) is a central problem in areas such as Reinforcement Learning and Operations Research. Here, we have to repeatedly choose an action that should be performed by an agent. Depending on the action and the current state of the agent, the agent collects a reward and randomly transitions into a new state. The goal is to maximize the reward in expectation over a finite time horizon of length $H$. We consider a recently introduced variant that generalizes the traditionally additive reward function in the model to a monotone submodular one, which allows for capturing a range of interesting applications.
  Without the stochastic component, this problem is equivalent to the Submodular Orienteering problem, where the goal is to find an $s$-$t$ walk in a directed graph maximizing a monotone submodular function under a length constraint. We present a novel LP-based algorithm for Submodular Orienteering using ideas from the Sherali-Adams hierarchy and Round-or-Cut. Our guarantees are comparable to the known quasi-polynomial time logarithmic approximation for Submodular Orienteering, but also extend to the setting of Submodular Markov Decision Processes. In the polynomial time regime, we present an $O(n^{\varepsilon})$-approximation (and $O(H^{\varepsilon})$ for Submodular MDPs) for every $\varepsilon >0$, where $n$ is the number of vertices, which was unknown even for Submodular Orienteering. Prior to our work, the best known approximation guarantee for Submodular MDPs had an approximation ratio linear in $H$.
  Beyond these algorithmic results, our methods reveal a trade-off between the approximation guarantee and the number of previously visited vertices on which an agent conditions its decision.

</details>


### [504] [Breaking the 1/3 Barrier for $\boldsymbol{k}$-Submodular Maximization under Matroid and Knapsack Constraints: A Proportional Top-2 Randomized Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15677)
*Siyuan Chen,Shengminjie Chen,Suixiang Gao,Zheyu Jiang,Chenhao Wang,Wenguo Yang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究非负、非单调的 k-子模函数在单拟阵约束和单背包约束下的最大化问题，首次突破长期存在的 1/3 近似比障碍，给出达到 √2−1≈0.4142 的随机多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: k-子模性是子模性的推广，允许每个被选元素从 k 个标签中选一个，而非仅“选/不选”。在非单调约束 k-子模最大化中，即使基数和、拟阵、背包等基本设置，此前最好的近似比长期停留在 1/3 或 1/3−ε。作者旨在探究该 1/3 障碍是否本质存在。

Method: 针对单拟阵约束与单背包约束，作者提出随机多项式时间算法，采用简洁的随机贪心规则：元素一旦被选中，其标签仅从边际增益最大的两个标签中选取，选取概率正比于这两个增益的正部。价值预言机查询复杂度在拟阵设置下为 O(n²k)，在背包设置下为 O(n³k²)。

Result: 在拟阵和背包两种设置下，算法均达到 √2−1≈0.4142 的近似比；相应查询复杂度分别为 O(n²k) 与 O(n³k²)。

Conclusion: 结果表明 1/3 障碍并非本质：这是非单调 k-子模最大化在拟阵与背包约束下首个超过 1/3 的近似保证。

Abstract: $k$-submodularity generalizes submodularity by allowing each selected element to be assigned one of $k$ labels, rather than being merely selected or not selected. We study the problem of maximizing a nonnegative non-monotone $k$-submodular function, where $k\ge 2$, under classical support constraints, including a single matroid constraint and a single knapsack constraint. Previously, the best known approximation guarantees for non-monotone constrained $k$-submodular maximization had long remained at $1/3$ or $1/3-\varepsilon$, even in basic settings such as cardinality, matroid, and knapsack constraints. We show that this $1/3$ barrier is not inherent: for both the matroid and knapsack settings considered here, we give randomized polynomial-time algorithms achieving an approximation ratio of $\sqrt{2}-1\approx 0.4142$. The algorithms use a simple randomized greedy rule: once an element is selected, its label is chosen only from the two labels with the largest marginal gains, with probabilities proportional to the positive parts of these two gains. The value-oracle query complexity is $O(n^2k)$ in the matroid setting and $O(n^3k^2)$ in the knapsack setting. These results give the first approximation guarantees exceeding $1/3$ for non-monotone $k$-submodular maximization under matroid and knapsack constraints.

</details>


### [505] [Consistency-Robustness Tradeoffs for Online Bipartite Allocation with Multiple Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15837)
*Alexander Lindermayr,Nicole Megow,Lauren Paul*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究多阶段学习增强在线二分分配问题，首次给出 $k$ 阶段顶点加权分数二分匹配的一致性-鲁棒性权衡，并扩展到分数 AdWords 及经典在线设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两阶段情形已有紧的一致性-鲁棒性权衡，但任意阶段数 ($k$) 下尚无任何非平凡权衡，需填补这一空白。

Method: 基于逐阶段凸规划，配合精细校准的顶点相关惩罚项，为每个供给顶点维护动态安全储备 (dynamic safety reserve)，以平衡对未来对抗性到达的防护与对预测分配的利用。

Result: 对每个 $k\ge2$ 给出首个权衡：给定 $R_k=1-(1-1/k)^k$，对任意 $R\in[0,R_k]$，算法 $R$-鲁棒且 $C_k(R)$-一致，其中 $C_k(R)=k(1-R)^{1/k}+R-(k-1)$；同时恢复已知两阶段紧权衡与无预测最优 $k$ 阶段竞争保证，并严格优于随机抛硬币基线。经典在线设置下一致性至少为 $C_\infty(R)=1+R+\ln(1-R)$，$R\in[0,1-1/e]$，改进已有最佳权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了 $k$ 阶段与经典在线设置的一致性-鲁棒性权衡，并可扩展到分数 AdWords 与分数预测。

Abstract: We study learning-augmented online bipartite allocation with multiple stages. In the $k$-stage vertex-weighted fractional bipartite matching problem, demand vertices arrive in $k$ stages, and the algorithm receives possibly inaccurate predictions of the allocation in each stage. While tight consistency-robustness tradeoffs were known for the two-stage case, no nontrivial tradeoff was known for an arbitrary number of stages.
  Our main result is the first consistency-robustness tradeoff for $k$-stage vertex-weighted fractional bipartite matching with predictions, for every $k\ge2$. Let $R_k=1-(1-1/k)^k$. For every $R\in[0,R_k]$, our algorithm is $R$-robust and $C_k(R)$-consistent, where $C_k(R)=k(1-R)^{1/k}+R-(k-1)$. This simultaneously recovers the known tight two-stage tradeoff and the optimal prediction-free $k$-stage competitive guarantee $R_k = C_k(R_k)$, while strictly dominating the natural randomized coin-flip baseline between these endpoints.
  We also present an algorithm for the classical online setting, where demands arrive one by one and the number of demands is unknown in advance. It has a consistency ratio of at least $C_\infty(R)=1+R+\ln(1-R)$ for a given robustness $R\in[0,1-1/e]$, improving the best previously known tradeoff for this problem. Finally, we extend the framework to fractional AdWords and fractional predictions.
  Our algorithms are based on stage-wise convex programs with carefully calibrated vertex-dependent penalties. The penalties maintain a dynamic safety reserve for each supply vertex, balancing protection against adversarial future arrivals with the ability to exploit the predicted allocation.

</details>


### [506] [Scalable Triangle Counting: The Threshold Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15848)
*Asaf Etgar,Anna Gilbert,Quanquan C. Liu,Andrew McGregor*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 提出一种极简的单遍随机顺序边流三角形计数算法：读取前缀直到观察到 Q 个三角形，输出 Q(m/S)^3，无需 T 的先验估计或内存预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于采样率的算法（McGregor & Vorotnikova, PODS 2020；Tsourakakis et al., KDD 2009）需要 T 的先验估计，且通常需要预设内存预算，难以在流式场景中实用。研究希望在随机顺序边流上实现无需先验知识的单遍三角形计数。

Method: 算法极简：从流中读取边，直至前缀内观察到 Q 个三角形，设停止长度为 S，输出 Q(m/S)^3。证明基于 Schudy–Sviridenko 集中不等式，针对独立边采样估计量，并结合算法产生的不放回前缀。条件为任意边关联的最大三角形数 η ≤ T^{2/3}。

Result: 在假设下以概率 1-δ 给出 (1±ε) 近似，内存为 O(ε^{-2} log(1/δ) m/T^{1/3})。六个真实时序流上，停止前缀符合预测的立方根缩放，在 10% 前缀处误差至多 6%，且不使用 T。在固定存储边预算下，方差缩减蓄水池采样更准确但需读完整个流。在 1.8×10^9 边的大图上，阈值算法仅读 0.46% 流即给出 3.8% 误差，而最强蓄水池基线在时间上限内未完成一遍。

Conclusion: 该停止规则自适应选择前缀长度，可提前返回估计，无需 T 先验与内存预算；在精度—速度权衡中优于需完整读流的采样方法，适合大规模流式场景。

Abstract: We study one-pass triangle counting on random-order edge streams. We present a remarkably simple algorithm---read edges from the stream until $Q$ triangles are observed in the prefix, then output $Q\,(m/S)^3$ where $S$ is the stopping length---and prove that, when the maximum number of triangles incident to any edge satisfies $η\le T^{2/3}$, this is a $(1\pm\varepsilon)$-approximation of $T$ with probability $1-δ$ using $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)\, m/T^{1/3})$ memory. Crucially, the algorithm does not need any a priori estimate of $T$, in sharp contrast with state-of-the-art sampling-rate based algorithms (McGregor and Vorotnikova, PODS 2020; Tsourakakis et al., KDD 2009). It also does not need a prescribed memory budget: the stopping rule self-selects the prefix length and can return an estimate before reading the entire stream.
  The proof rests on a Schudy--Sviridenko concentration argument for an independent-edge-sampling estimator, coupled to the without-replacement prefix produced by the algorithm. On six real temporal streams, the algorithm's stopping prefix follows the predicted cube-root scaling and achieves at most $6\%$ error at a $10\%$ prefix, without using $T$. At a fixed stored-edge budget, variance-reduced reservoir samplers are often more accurate, but only after reading the entire stream. On a separate, much larger, $1.8\times10^9$-edge graph, the threshold algorithm reads $0.46\%$ of the stream and returns $3.8\%$ error, while the strongest reservoir baselines do not finish a pass within the wall-clock cap.

</details>


### [507] [Thin-shell stability of Gaussian cooling: logconcave sampling with sesteric complexity from a cold start](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15884)
*Yunbum Kook,Santosh S. Vempala*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明高斯冷却路径上的对数凹概率测度具有薄壳稳定性，推广了薄壳定理，并借此改进冷启动下任意对数凹分布采样的复杂度至近 n^{2.5}。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对数凹分布采样是基本问题，其冷启动复杂度受限于薄壳性质的理解；已有方法的复杂度为 n^{2.75}，存在进一步优化的空间。

Method: 证明高斯冷却路径上对数凹概率测度沿路径的薄壳稳定性，推广经典薄壳定理，并将其应用于冷启动采样算法分析。

Result: 对（近）各向同性对数凹分布，冷启动采样复杂度达到近 n^{2.5}，优于此前 n^{2.75} 的界，并匹配抽象 Speedy walk 的复杂度。

Conclusion: 薄壳稳定性为改进对数凹分布冷启动采样复杂度提供了新工具，将上界提升至近 n^{2.5}，达到与 Speedy walk 相同水平。

Abstract: We show that logconcave probability measures along the Gaussian cooling path have thin-shell stability, generalizing the thin-shell theorem. This result leads to improved complexity for the fundamental problem of sampling an arbitrary logconcave distribution from a cold start. For (near-)isotropic logconcave distributions, the complexity is nearly $n^{2.5}$, improving the previous bound of $n^{2.75}$, and matching the complexity of the abstract Speedy walk.

</details>


### [508] [The $k$-server conjecture is true](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15979)
*Christian Coester,Elias Koutsoupias,Marek Zbysiński*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明了 k-server 猜想：存在确定性在线算法在每个度量空间上达到竞争比 k，并具体证明工作函数算法（WFA）满足该竞争比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: k-server 猜想长期未决，其核心是判定确定性在线算法能否在所有度量空间上达到竞争比 k，且 WFA 是否为该最优算法。本文旨在给出该猜想的完整证明。

Method: 将工作函数表示为矩阵，使可行路径被编码其中；在该表示下，最优代价定义中的 min 与加法分别对应形式表达式的加法与乘法，每个工作函数值对应矩阵 k 列的行列式。请求到达时通过基变换与行替换更新表示。摊还分析基于一个势函数，该势函数定义在坐标取原矩阵表示坐标对的更大矩阵上。

Result: 证明了 k-server 猜想成立，并证明工作函数算法满足竞争比 k。

Conclusion: 通过工作函数的代数矩阵表示及相应势函数摊还分析，作者完成了对 k-server 猜想的证明，确立 WFA 为达到 k 竞争比的确定性在线算法。

Abstract: The $k$-server conjecture states that a deterministic online algorithm can achieve competitive ratio $k$ on every metric space. We prove the conjecture. Specifically, we show that the work function algorithm satisfies it.
  Our proof uses a natural algebraic representation of the work function as a matrix, which encodes all feasible paths to reach a configuration. In this representation, the minimum and addition operations arising in the definition of optimal costs correspond to addition and multiplication of formal expressions, and each work function value corresponds to the determinant of $k$ columns of the matrix. A request arrival updates the representation via a change of basis and row replacement. The amortized analysis is based on a potential function defined in terms of a larger matrix whose coordinates are pairs of coordinates of the original matrix representation.

</details>
